    31	var actx = null;
    32	function audio(){
    33	  if (!actx){
    34	    var C = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
    35	    if (C) actx = new C();
    36	  }
    37	  if (actx && actx.state === 'suspended') actx.resume();
    38	  return actx;
    39	}
    40	function beep(freq, dur, type, vol, slide){
    41	  var a = audio(); if (!a) return;
    42	  var o = a.createOscillator(), g = a.createGain(), t = a.currentTime;
    43	  o.type = type || 'square'; o.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, t);
    44	  if (slide) o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(40, slide), t + dur);
    45	  g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, t);
    46	  g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(vol || 0.08, t + 0.012);
    47	  g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t + dur);
    48	  o.connect(g); g.connect(a.destination); o.start(t); o.stop(t + dur + 0.02);
    49	}
    50	function noise(dur, vol){
    51	  var a = audio(); if (!a) return;
    52	  var n = Math.floor(a.sampleRate * dur), buf = a.createBuffer(1, n, a.sampleRate), d = buf.getChannelData(0);
    53	  for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) d[i] = (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * Math.pow(1 - i / n, 2);
    54	  var src = a.createBufferSource(), g = a.createGain(), f = a.createBiquadFilter();
    55	  src.buffer = buf; f.type = 'lowpass'; f.frequency.value = 900;
    56	  g.gain.value = vol || 0.3;
    57	  src.connect(f); f.connect(g); g.connect(a.destination); src.start();
    58	}

   126	function entryBlocked(){

   134	function gapAhead(tr){
   135	  var net = G.net, e = net.edges[tr.edge];
   136	  var kids = childrenIdx(net, tr.edge), best = Infinity;
   137	  for (var i = 0; i < G.trains.length; i++){
   138	    var o = G.trains[i]; if (o === tr) continue;
   139	    if (o.edge === tr.edge){ if (o.s > tr.s) best = Math.min(best, o.s - tr.s); }
   140	    else if (kids.indexOf(o.edge) >= 0) best = Math.min(best, (e.len - tr.s) + o.s);
   141	  }
   142	  return best;
   143	}

   145	function deliver(tr, seg){
   146	  var st = G.net.stations[seg];
   147	  if (st.color === tr.color){
   148	    var onTime = tr.patience > 0;
   149	    var pts = onTime ? Math.round(100 * (1 + Math.min(G.combo, 12) * 0.1)) : 40;
   150	    G.score += pts;
   151	    if (onTime) G.combo++; else G.combo = 0;
   152	    G.delivered++;
   153	    tr.done = true;
   154	    burst(st.x, st.y, tr.color, onTime ? 22 : 12);
   155	    flash(onTime ? 'rgba(103,232,249,.16)' : 'rgba(251,191,36,.14)');
   156	    popup(st.x, st.y, '+' + pts, onTime ? '#a7f0fb' : '#fbbf24');
   157	    beep(onTime ? 620 : 400, 0.11, 'triangle', 0.09, onTime ? 940 : 430);
   158	    if (onTime) setTimeout(function(){ beep(880, 0.09, 'triangle', 0.06); }, 70);
   159	    G.shake = Math.min(G.shake + 2.5, 7);
   160	    if (G.delivered % GROW_EVERY === 0) grow();
   161	  } else {
   162	    burst(st.x, st.y, '#64748b', 8);
   163	    popup(st.x, st.y, 'WRONG STOP', '#94a3b8');
   164	    beep(150, 0.14, 'sawtooth', 0.05, 90);
   165	  }
   166	}

   168	function grow(){
   169	  var net = G.net;
   170	  if (net.n >= NET_MAX) return;
   171	  var sw = net.sw.slice();
   172	  var nn = buildNet(spine, net.n + 1, COLORS);
   173	  for (var i = 0; i < sw.length; i++) nn.sw[i] = sw[i];
   174	  G.net = nn;
   175	  var st = nn.stations[nn.n - 1];
   176	  burst(st.x, st.y, st.color, 26);
   177	  popup(st.x, st.y, 'NEW STATION', st.color);
   178	  beep(300, 0.16, 'triangle', 0.07, 700);
   179	  fitCam(false);
   180	}

   183	function burst(x, y, color, n){
   184	  for (var i = 0; i < n; i++){
   185	    var a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2, sp = 30 + Math.random() * 110;
   186	    G.parts.push({ x: x, y: y, vx: Math.cos(a) * sp, vy: Math.sin(a) * sp,
   187	      life: 0.5 + Math.random() * 0.5, max: 1, c: color, r: 1.5 + Math.random() * 2.5, txt: null });
   188	  }
   189	}
   190	function popup(x, y, txt, color){
   191	  G.parts.push({ x: x, y: y - 8, vx: 0, vy: -26, life: 1.1, max: 1.1, c: color, r: 0, txt: txt });
   192	}
   193	var flashT = 0;
   194	function flash(color){ elFlash.style.background = color; elFlash.style.opacity = '1'; flashT = 0.18; }
   195	
   196	/* ---------- update ---------- */
   197	function update(dt){
   198	  if (G.tween){
   199	    var T = G.tween;
   200	    T.k = Math.min(1, T.k + dt / 0.55);
   201	    var k = smoothstep(0, 1, T.k);
   202	    G.cam.x = T.x0 + (T.x - T.x0) * k;
   203	    G.cam.y = T.y0 + (T.y - T.y0) * k;
   204	    G.cam.s = T.s0 + (T.s - T.s0) * k;
   205	    if (T.k >= 1) G.tween = null;
   206	  }
   207	  if (flashT > 0){ flashT -= dt; if (flashT <= 0) elFlash.style.opacity = '0'; }
   208	  if (G.shake > 0) G.shake = Math.max(0, G.shake - dt * 14);
   209	
   210	  for (var i = G.parts.length - 1; i >= 0; i--){
   211	    var p = G.parts[i];
   212	    p.life -= dt; p.x += p.vx * dt; p.y += p.vy * dt;
   213	    if (!p.txt){ p.vx *= 0.94; p.vy *= 0.94; p.vy += 40 * dt; }
   214	    if (p.life <= 0) G.parts.splice(i, 1);
   215	  }
   216	  if (G.over) return;
   217	
   218	  G.time += dt;
   219	  if (G.hintT < 99){ G.hintT += dt; if (G.hintT > 11) elHint.style.opacity = '0'; }
   220	
   221	  /* spawns */
   222	  while (G.queue.length && G.queue[0].t <= G.time){
   223	    if (entryBlocked()){ for (var q = 0; q < G.queue.length; q++) G.queue[q].t += 0.6; break; }
   224	    spawnTrain(G.queue.shift().color);
   225	    G.interval = Math.max(1.7, 6.4 - G.delivered * 0.115);
   226	    retimeQueue();
   227	    fillQueue();
   228	  }
   229	  if (G.queue.length < 4) fillQueue();
   230	
   231	  /* trains */
   232	  for (var ti = G.trains.length - 1; ti >= 0; ti--){
   233	    var tr = G.trains[ti], net = G.net, e = net.edges[tr.edge];
   234	    if (!e){ G.trains.splice(ti, 1); continue; }
   235	    tr.patience -= dt;
   236	
   237	    if (tr.dwell > 0){
   238	      tr.dwell -= dt; tr.v = 0;
   239	      if (tr.dwell <= 0){
   240	        tr.stationDone = true;
   241	        deliver(tr, e.seg);
   242	      }
   243	    } else {
   244	      var base = tr.done ? BASE_SPEED * 1.35 : BASE_SPEED;
   245	      var cap = base;
   246	      var lim = function(d){ var a = Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, 2 * DECEL * d)); if (a < cap) cap = a; };
   247	
   248	      if (e.stationS !== null && !tr.stationDone && tr.s <= e.stationS) lim(e.stationS - tr.s);
   249	      if (tr.hold){
   250	        if (e.signalS !== null && tr.s <= e.signalS) lim(e.signalS - tr.s);
   251	        else {
   252	          var ni = nextEdgeIdx(net, tr.edge);
   253	          if (ni >= 0 && net.edges[ni] && net.edges[ni].signalS !== null)
   254	            lim((e.len - tr.s) + net.edges[ni].signalS);
   255	        }
   256	      }
   257	      var g = gapAhead(tr);
   258	      if (g < Infinity) lim(Math.max(0, g - FOLLOW_GAP));
   259	
   260	      if (cap > tr.v) tr.v = Math.min(cap, tr.v + ACCEL * dt);
   261	      else tr.v = Math.max(cap, tr.v - DECEL * 1.6 * dt);
   262	      if (tr.v < 0) tr.v = 0;
   263	
   264	      tr.s += tr.v * dt;
   265	
   266	      /* station arrival */
   267	      if (e.stationS !== null && !tr.stationDone && tr.s >= e.stationS - 0.8){
   268	        tr.s = e.stationS; tr.v = 0; tr.dwell = DWELL;
   269	      }
   270	      /* signal hold */
   271	      if (tr.hold && e.signalS !== null && tr.s >= e.signalS - 0.8 && tr.s <= e.signalS + 2){
   272	        tr.s = e.signalS; tr.v = 0;
   273	      }
   274	      /* edge transition */
   275	      if (tr.s >= e.len){
   276	        var over = tr.s - e.len;
   277	        var nx = nextEdgeIdx(net, tr.edge);
   278	        if (nx < 0){
   279	          if (!tr.done){ G.missed++; G.combo = 0; flash('rgba(239,68,68,.12)');
   280	            popup(tr.x, tr.y, 'MISSED', '#f87171'); beep(120, 0.2, 'sawtooth', 0.06, 70); }
   281	          G.trains.splice(ti, 1); continue;
   282	        }
   283	        tr.edge = nx; tr.s = over; tr.stationDone = false;
   284	      }
   285	    }
   286	    var pt = polyAt(G.net.edges[tr.edge].poly, tr.s);
   287	    tr.x = pt.x; tr.y = pt.y; tr.tx = pt.tx; tr.ty = pt.ty;
   288	  }
   289	
   290	  /* collisions */
   291	  for (var a = 0; a < G.trains.length; a++){
   292	    for (var b = a + 1; b < G.trains.length; b++){
   293	      var A = G.trains[a], B = G.trains[b];
   294	      if (Math.abs(A.x - B.x) > COLLIDE_DIST || Math.abs(A.y - B.y) > COLLIDE_DIST) continue;
   295	      if (Math.hypot(A.x - B.x, A.y - B.y) < COLLIDE_DIST){ gameOver(A, B); return; }
   296	    }
   297	  }
   298	}
   299	
   300	function gameOver(A, B){
   301	  G.over = true; G.shake = 26;
   302	  var mx = (A.x + B.x) / 2, my = (A.y + B.y) / 2;
   303	  burst(mx, my, '#fb923c', 34); burst(mx, my, '#f87171', 26); burst(mx, my, '#fde68a', 18);
   304	  flash('rgba(239,68,68,.35)');
   305	  noise(0.5, 0.42); beep(90, 0.5, 'sawtooth', 0.12, 40);
   306	  if (G.score > best){
   307	    best = G.score;
   308	    try { localStorage.setItem('steamline.best', String(best)); } catch (e) {}
   309	  }
   310	  elOScore.textContent = G.score;
   311	  elOBest.textContent = 'BEST ' + best;
   312	  setTimeout(function(){ elOver.classList.add('on'); }, 460);
   313	}
   314	
   315	/* ---------- render ---------- */
   316	function render(){
   317	  ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
   318	  ctx.fillStyle = '#0b1118'; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, vw, vh);
   319	  var g = ctx.createRadialGradient(vw * 0.5, vh * 0.42, 20, vw * 0.5, vh * 0.42, Math.max(vw, vh) * 0.78);
   320	  g.addColorStop(0, '#152232'); g.addColorStop(1, '#0b1118');
   321	  ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, vw, vh);
   322	
   323	  var sx = 0, sy = 0;
   324	  if (G.shake > 0){ sx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * G.shake * 2; sy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * G.shake * 2; }
   325	  ctx.save();
   326	  ctx.translate(vw / 2 + sx, vh / 2 + sy);
   327	  ctx.scale(G.cam.s, G.cam.s);
   328	  ctx.translate(-G.cam.x, -G.cam.y);
   329	
   330	  var S = G.cam.s, net = G.net;
   331	  var lwBase = Math.max(11, 7 / S), lwCore = Math.max(2.6, 1.8 / S);
   332	  ctx.lineCap = 'round'; ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
   333	
   334	  /* track bed - one combined path, three passes */
   335	  var i, k, e;
   336	  ctx.strokeStyle = '#1c2836'; ctx.lineWidth = lwBase + 5; ctx.stroke(net.allPath);
   337	  ctx.strokeStyle = '#33465c'; ctx.lineWidth = lwBase; ctx.stroke(net.allPath);
   338	  ctx.strokeStyle = '#5d7590'; ctx.lineWidth = lwCore; ctx.stroke(net.allPath);
   339	
   340	  /* signals */
   341	  var off = lwBase * 0.62 + 4;
   342	  for (i = 0; i < net.edges.length; i++){
   343	    e = net.edges[i];
   344	    if (!e.signalPt) continue;
   345	    var sp = e.signalPt, held = false;
   346	    for (k = 0; k < G.trains.length; k++){
   347	      var t2 = G.trains[k];
   348	      if (t2.edge === i && t2.hold && Math.abs(t2.s - e.signalS) < 6){ held = true; break; }
   349	    }
   350	    ctx.fillStyle = held ? '#ef4444' : '#22c55e';
   351	    ctx.globalAlpha = held ? 1 : 0.45;
   352	    ctx.beginPath();
   353	    ctx.arc(sp.x - sp.ty * off, sp.y + sp.tx * off, 3.4, 0, 6.2832);
   354	    ctx.fill();
   355	  }
   356	  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   357	
   358	  /* switch highlight + node */
   359	  var pulse = 0.55 + 0.45 * Math.sin(performance.now() / 320);
   360	  for (i = 0; i < net.n; i++){
   361	    var ce = net.edges[childIdx(net, i)];
   362	    ctx.strokeStyle = '#67e8f9'; ctx.lineWidth = lwCore + 2.6; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.9;
   363	    ctx.stroke(ce.headPath); ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   364	
   365	    var nd = net.nodes[i];
   366	    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(nd.x, nd.y, 12, 0, 6.2832);
   367	    ctx.fillStyle = '#0e1a26'; ctx.fill();
   368	    ctx.strokeStyle = '#67e8f9'; ctx.lineWidth = 2.4; ctx.stroke();
   369	    var dir = ce.dirPt;
   370	    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(nd.x, nd.y);
   371	    ctx.lineTo(nd.x + (dir.x - nd.x) * 0.42, nd.y + (dir.y - nd.y) * 0.42);
   372	    ctx.strokeStyle = '#a7f0fb'; ctx.lineWidth = 3.4; ctx.stroke();
   373	    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(nd.x, nd.y, 3, 0, 6.2832); ctx.fillStyle = '#a7f0fb'; ctx.fill();
   374	  }
   375	
   376	  /* depot (line entry) and terminus (line exit) */
   377	  cap(net.entryPt, '#22c55e', 'in');
   378	  cap(net.exitPt, '#ef4444', 'out');
   379	
   380	  /* stations - dark box, thick colour ring, colour disc: distinct from solid trains */
   381	  for (i = 0; i < net.stations.length; i++){
   382	    var st = net.stations[i];
   383	    var want = false;
   384	    for (k = 0; k < G.trains.length; k++)
   385	      if (!G.trains[k].done && G.trains[k].color === st.color){ want = true; break; }
   386	    ctx.save(); ctx.translate(st.x, st.y); ctx.rotate(Math.atan2(st.ty, st.tx));
   387	    if (want){
   388	      ctx.globalAlpha = 0.14 + 0.16 * pulse; ctx.fillStyle = st.color;
   389	      roundRect(-34, -24, 68, 48, 13); ctx.fill(); ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   390	    }
   391	    ctx.fillStyle = '#0d1620'; roundRect(-26, -17, 52, 34, 8); ctx.fill();
   392	    ctx.strokeStyle = st.color; ctx.lineWidth = 3.2; roundRect(-26, -17, 52, 34, 8); ctx.stroke();
   393	    ctx.fillStyle = st.color;
   394	    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 0, 8.5, 0, 6.2832); ctx.fill();
   395	    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,.22)';
   396	    ctx.fillRect(-20, -13, 40, 2.6); ctx.fillRect(-20, 10.4, 40, 2.6);
   397	    ctx.restore();
   398	  }
   399	
   400	  /* trains */
   401	  for (i = 0; i < G.trains.length; i++) drawTrain(G.trains[i], i === G.sel);
   402	
   403	  /* particles */
   404	  for (i = 0; i < G.parts.length; i++){
   405	    var p = G.parts[i], al = Math.max(0, p.life / p.max);
   406	    if (p.txt){
   407	      ctx.globalAlpha = Math.min(1, al * 1.6);
   408	      ctx.fillStyle = p.c; ctx.font = '700 ' + (14 / S + 5) + 'px ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif';
   409	      ctx.textAlign = 'center'; ctx.fillText(p.txt, p.x, p.y);
   410	    } else {
   411	      ctx.globalAlpha = al; ctx.fillStyle = p.c;
   412	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r * (0.4 + al), 0, 6.2832); ctx.fill();
   413	    }
   414	  }
   415	  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   416	  ctx.restore();
   417	}
   418	
   419	/* end-of-line marker drawn across the rails */
   420	function cap(p, color, kind){
   421	  ctx.save(); ctx.translate(p.x, p.y); ctx.rotate(Math.atan2(p.ty, p.tx));
   422	  ctx.fillStyle = '#0d1620'; roundRect(-7, -17, 14, 34, 5); ctx.fill();
   423	  ctx.strokeStyle = color; ctx.lineWidth = 2.4; roundRect(-7, -17, 14, 34, 5); ctx.stroke();
   424	  ctx.fillStyle = color;
   425	  for (var i = -1; i <= 1; i++){
   426	    ctx.beginPath();
   427	    if (kind === 'in') ctx.arc(0, i * 9, 2.6, 0, 6.2832);
   428	    else { ctx.moveTo(-3.5, i * 9 - 3.5); ctx.lineTo(3, i * 9); ctx.lineTo(-3.5, i * 9 + 3.5); ctx.closePath(); }
   429	    ctx.fill();
   430	  }
   431	  ctx.restore();
   432	}
   433	
   434	function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r){
   435	  ctx.beginPath();
   436	  ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
   437	  ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
   438	  ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
   439	  ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
   440	  ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
   441	  ctx.closePath();
   442	}

   444	function drawTrain(tr, selected){
   445	  var ang = Math.atan2(tr.ty, tr.tx);
   446	  ctx.save(); ctx.translate(tr.x, tr.y); ctx.rotate(ang);
   447	  var col = tr.done ? '#94a3b8' : tr.color;
   448	  if (selected){
   449	    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.35; ctx.fillStyle = '#a7f0fb';
   450	    roundRect(-20, -13, 40, 26, 9); ctx.fill(); ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   451	  }
   452	  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.45)'; roundRect(-15, -7, 30, 15, 4); ctx.fill();
   453	  ctx.fillStyle = col; roundRect(-15, -8, 30, 15, 4); ctx.fill();
   454	  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,.32)'; roundRect(2, -6, 10, 5, 2); ctx.fill();
   455	  ctx.strokeStyle = tr.hold ? '#ef4444' : 'rgba(6,12,18,.85)';
   456	  ctx.lineWidth = tr.hold ? 2.4 : 1.6; roundRect(-15, -8, 30, 15, 4); ctx.stroke();
   457	  if (!tr.done && tr.patience <= 0){
   458	    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(performance.now() / 110);
   459	    ctx.strokeStyle = '#fb923c'; ctx.lineWidth = 2.4; roundRect(-17, -10, 34, 19, 5); ctx.stroke();
   460	    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   461	  }
   462	  ctx.restore();
   463	
   464	  if (!tr.done){
   465	    var f = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, tr.patience / PATIENCE));
   466	    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(8,14,20,.75)';
   467	    ctx.fillRect(tr.x - 13, tr.y - 17, 26, 4);
   468	    ctx.fillStyle = f > 0.45 ? '#34d399' : (f > 0.18 ? '#fbbf24' : '#ef4444');
   469	    ctx.fillRect(tr.x - 12, tr.y - 16.2, 24 * f, 2.4);
   470	  }
   471	  if (tr.hold){
   472	    ctx.fillStyle = '#ef4444';
   473	    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(tr.x, tr.y + 15, 3.6, 0, 6.2832); ctx.fill();
   474	  }
   475	}

   502	/* ---------- input ---------- */
   503	var ptrs = new Map(), panned = false, downT = 0, downPos = null, pinch = null, lastTap = 0, lastTapPos = null;
   504	
   505	function localPos(ev){ return { x: ev.clientX, y: ev.clientY }; }
   506	
   507	cv.addEventListener('pointerdown', function(ev){
   508	  audio();
   509	  cv.setPointerCapture(ev.pointerId);
   510	  ptrs.set(ev.pointerId, localPos(ev));
   511	  if (ptrs.size === 1){ panned = false; downT = performance.now(); downPos = localPos(ev); }
   512	  else if (ptrs.size === 2){
   513	    var a = Array.from(ptrs.values());
   514	    pinch = { d: Math.hypot(a[0].x - a[1].x, a[0].y - a[1].y),
   515	              m: { x: (a[0].x + a[1].x) / 2, y: (a[0].y + a[1].y) / 2 }, s: G.cam.s };
   516	    panned = true;
   517	  }
   518	  ev.preventDefault();
   519	}, { passive: false });
   520	
   521	cv.addEventListener('pointermove', function(ev){
   522	  if (!ptrs.has(ev.pointerId)) return;
   523	  var prev = ptrs.get(ev.pointerId), cur = localPos(ev);
   524	  ptrs.set(ev.pointerId, cur);
   525	  if (ptrs.size >= 2 && pinch){
   526	    var a = Array.from(ptrs.values());
   527	    var d = Math.hypot(a[0].x - a[1].x, a[0].y - a[1].y);
   528	    var m = { x: (a[0].x + a[1].x) / 2, y: (a[0].y + a[1].y) / 2 };
   529	    var ns = Math.max(0.25, Math.min(3, pinch.s * (d / (pinch.d || 1))));
   530	    var before = s2w(m.x, m.y);
   531	    G.cam.s = ns; G.tween = null;
   532	    var after = s2w(m.x, m.y);
   533	    G.cam.x += before.x - after.x; G.cam.y += before.y - after.y;
   534	    G.cam.x -= (m.x - pinch.m.x) / G.cam.s; G.cam.y -= (m.y - pinch.m.y) / G.cam.s;
   535	    pinch.m = m;
   536	  } else if (ptrs.size === 1){
   537	    var dx = cur.x - prev.x, dy = cur.y - prev.y;
   538	    if (!panned && downPos && Math.hypot(cur.x - downPos.x, cur.y - downPos.y) > 9) panned = true;
   539	    if (panned){ G.cam.x -= dx / G.cam.s; G.cam.y -= dy / G.cam.s; G.tween = null; }
   540	  }
   541	  ev.preventDefault();
   542	}, { passive: false });
   543	
   544	function endPtr(ev){
   545	  if (!ptrs.has(ev.pointerId)) return;
   546	  var pos = ptrs.get(ev.pointerId);
   547	  ptrs.delete(ev.pointerId);
   548	  if (ptrs.size < 2) pinch = null;
   549	  if (ptrs.size === 0 && !panned && performance.now() - downT < 500) tap(pos);
   550	  ev.preventDefault();
   551	}
   552	cv.addEventListener('pointerup', endPtr, { passive: false });
   553	cv.addEventListener('pointercancel', endPtr, { passive: false });
   554	cv.addEventListener('wheel', function(ev){
   555	  var before = s2w(ev.clientX, ev.clientY);
   556	  G.cam.s = Math.max(0.25, Math.min(3, G.cam.s * (ev.deltaY < 0 ? 1.12 : 0.893)));
   557	  G.tween = null;
   558	  var after = s2w(ev.clientX, ev.clientY);
   559	  G.cam.x += before.x - after.x; G.cam.y += before.y - after.y;
   560	  ev.preventDefault();
   561	}, { passive: false });
   562	
   563	function tap(pos){
   564	  var now = performance.now();
   565	  if (G.over) return;
   566	  if (lastTapPos && now - lastTap < 320 && Math.hypot(pos.x - lastTapPos.x, pos.y - lastTapPos.y) < 40){
   567	    lastTap = 0;
   568	    if (G.cam.s < 1.25){
   569	      var w = s2w(pos.x, pos.y);
   570	      tweenTo(w.x, w.y, 1.7);
   571	    } else fitCam(false);
   572	    return;
   573	  }
   574	  lastTap = now; lastTapPos = pos;
   575	
   576	  /* trains first (generous hit area) */
   577	  var hitR = Math.max(26, 17 * G.cam.s), bestD = 1e9, bestI = -1, i, p, d;
   578	  for (i = 0; i < G.trains.length; i++){
   579	    p = w2s(G.trains[i].x, G.trains[i].y);
   580	    d = Math.hypot(p.x - pos.x, p.y - pos.y);
   581	    if (d < hitR && d < bestD){ bestD = d; bestI = i; }

   595	  }
   596	  if (bestI >= 0) toggleSwitch(bestI);
   597	}

   104	    var s = state, needRoad = 0, needPow = 0, needShop = 0, homes = 0, plants = 0, shops = 0;
   105	    for (var k = 0; k < S.W * S.H; k++) {
   106	      var t = s.t[k];

   108	      if (t === T.SHOP) shops++;
   109	      if (t !== T.HOME && t !== T.SHOP) continue;
   110	      if (t === T.HOME) homes++;
   111	      if (!s.acc[k]) needRoad++;
   112	      else if (!s.pow[k]) needPow++;
   113	      else if (!s.svc[k]) needShop++;

   117	    if (needRoad) return setTip('Red dot = no road. Build a road beside it.');
   118	    if (needPow) return setTip(plants ? 'Yellow dot = no power. Connect it by road to a plant.' : 'Yellow dot = no power. Build a Plant on the road network.');
   119	    if (needShop) return setTip(shops ? 'Blue dot = no shop within 5 tiles.' : 'Blue dot = build Shops within 5 tiles of homes.');

   213	      if (k >= '1' && k <= '6') { tool = +k - 1; syncTools(); hideTip(); updateTip(); return; }
   214	      if (!cur) cur = { x: 8, y: 11 };
   215	      if (k === 'arrowleft' || k === 'a') { cur.x = Math.max(0, cur.x - 1); e.preventDefault(); }
   216	      else if (k === 'arrowright' || k === 'd') { cur.x = Math.min(S.W - 1, cur.x + 1); e.preventDefault(); }
   217	      else if (k === 'arrowup' || k === 'w') { cur.y = Math.max(0, cur.y - 1); e.preventDefault(); }
   218	      else if (k === 'arrowdown' || k === 's') { cur.y = Math.min(S.H - 1, cur.y + 1); e.preventDefault(); }
   219	      else if (k === ' ' || k === 'enter') { lastPaint = -1; tryPlace(cur.x, cur.y); refresh(); e.preventDefault(); }
   220	      else if (k === 'p') togglePause();
   221	      else if (k === 'n') newCity();
   222	      else if (k === 'f') cycleSpeed();
   223	    });
   224	
   225	    bPause.addEventListener('pointerdown', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); togglePause(); });
   226	    bSpeed.addEventListener('pointerdown', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); cycleSpeed(); });
   227	    bNew.addEventListener('pointerdown', function (e) {
   228	      e.preventDefault();
   229	      if (bNew._arm) { clearTimeout(bNew._t); bNew._arm = false; bNew.textContent = 'NEW CITY'; newCity(); return; }
   230	      bNew._arm = true; bNew.textContent = 'SURE?';
   231	      bNew._t = setTimeout(function () { bNew._arm = false; bNew.textContent = 'NEW CITY'; }, 2200);
   232	    });
   233

   235	    window.addEventListener('orientationchange', function () { setTimeout(layout, 120); });
   236	    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', function () { if (document.hidden && state) S.save(state); });
   237	  }

   240	  function cycleSpeed() { spIdx = (spIdx + 1) % SPEEDS.length; speed = SPEEDS[spIdx]; bSpeed.textContent = 'SPEED ' + speed + 'x'; }
   241	
   242	  // ---------- monthly tick ----------
   243	  function doTick() {
   244	    var res = S.tick(state);
   245	    for (var i = 0; i < res.grew.length && i < 12; i++) {
   246	      var k = res.grew[i], x = k % S.W, y = (k / S.W) | 0;
   247	      R.burst(x, y, state.t[k] === T.HOME ? '#7ee59a' : '#66c6f5', 7);
   248	    }
   249	    if (res.grew.length) beep(880, 0.06, 'triangle', 0.05);
   250	    if (res.goalHit >= 0) {
   251	      var g = S.GOALS[res.goalHit];
   252	      R.kick(9); chord(440);
   253	      var msg = res.goalHit === 0 ? 'A real town now.' :
   254	                res.goalHit === 1 ? 'Borough status achieved.' : 'A proper city. Sandbox unlocked.';
   255	      toast(fmt(g) + ' RESIDENTS', msg, 3400);
   256	      for (var b = 0; b < 26; b++) {
   257	        R.burst((Math.random() * S.W) | 0, (Math.random() * S.H) | 0, ['#ffe9a8', '#7fd6a2', '#66c6f5'][b % 3], 5);
   258	      }
   259	    } else if (state.funds < 40) {
   260	      toast('TREASURY LOW', 'Taxes rise with residents. Wait a month.', 1800);
   261	    }
   262	    S.save(state);
   263	    syncHud();
   264	    updateTip();
   265	  }

   267	  // ---------- loop ----------
   268	  var last = 0, acc = 0;
   269	  function frame(ts) {
   270	    if (!last) last = ts;
   271	    var dt = Math.min(0.05, (ts - last) / 1000); last = ts;
   272	    if (!paused) {
   273	      acc += dt * 1000 * speed;
   274	      while (acc >= S.TICK_MS) { acc -= S.TICK_MS; doTick(); }
   275	    }
   276	    R.draw(state, dt, { cur: cur, toolCost: S.TOOLS[tool].cost });
   277	    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
   278	  }

     6	  var cv, cx, cell = 20, ox = 0, oy = 0, cssW = 0, cssH = 0, dpr = 1;

    10	  function init(canvas) {

    14	  function resize(availW, availH) {
    15	    cell = Math.floor(Math.min(availW / W, availH / H));
    16	    if (cell < 8) cell = 8;
    17	    cssW = cell * W; cssH = cell * H;
    18	    var longAxis = Math.max(cssW, cssH);
    19	    dpr = Math.min(2, window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 960 / longAxis);
    20	    cv.style.width = cssW + 'px'; cv.style.height = cssH + 'px';
    21	    cv.width = Math.round(cssW * dpr); cv.height = Math.round(cssH * dpr);

    28	  function pick(px, py) {
    29	    var x = Math.floor((px - ox) / cell), y = Math.floor((py - oy) / cell);
    30	    return S.inb(x, y) ? { x: x, y: y } : null;
    31	  }

    33	  function markDirty() { roadDirty = true; }

    36	  function burst(x, y, col, n) {
    37	    if (parts.length > 260) return;
    38	    var cxp = ox + (x + 0.5) * cell, cyp = oy + (y + 0.5) * cell;
    39	    for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    40	      var a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2, sp = 20 + Math.random() * 70;
    41	      parts.push({ x: cxp, y: cyp, vx: Math.cos(a) * sp, vy: Math.sin(a) * sp - 20, l: 0.45 + Math.random() * 0.35, m: 0, c: col });
    42	    }
    43	  }
    44	  function popText(x, y, txt, col) {
    45	    if (floats.length > 10) floats.shift();
    46	    floats.push({ x: ox + (x + 0.5) * cell, y: oy + (y + 0.3) * cell, t: txt, c: col, l: 1.1, m: 0 });
    47	  }
    48	
    49	  // ---------- traffic ----------
    50	  function rebuildRoads(s) {
    51	    roadList.length = 0;
    52	    for (var k = 0; k < W * H; k++) if (s.t[k] === T.ROAD) roadList.push(k);
    53	    roadDirty = false;
    54	    for (var i = dots.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    55	      if (s.t[dots[i].b] !== T.ROAD) dots.splice(i, 1);
    56	    }
    57	  }
    58	  function roadNbrs(s, k) {
    59	    var x = k % W, y = (k / W) | 0, out = [];
    60	    if (x > 0 && s.t[k - 1] === T.ROAD) out.push(k - 1);
    61	    if (x < W - 1 && s.t[k + 1] === T.ROAD) out.push(k + 1);
    62	    if (y > 0 && s.t[k - W] === T.ROAD) out.push(k - W);
    63	    if (y < H - 1 && s.t[k + W] === T.ROAD) out.push(k + W);
    64	    return out;
    65	  }
    66	  function updDots(s, dt) {
    67	    if (roadDirty) rebuildRoads(s);
    68	    var want = Math.min(64, Math.floor(s.pop / 45) + (roadList.length ? 3 : 0));
    69	    while (dots.length > want) dots.pop();
    70	    while (dots.length < want && roadList.length) {
    71	      var b = roadList[(Math.random() * roadList.length) | 0];
    72	      var nb = roadNbrs(s, b);
    73	      dots.push({ b: b, a: nb.length ? nb[(Math.random() * nb.length) | 0] : b, p: Math.random(), s: 0.8 + Math.random() * 0.7 });
    74	    }
    75	    for (var i = 0; i < dots.length; i++) {
    76	      var d = dots[i];
    77	      var slow = s.load[d.b] > S.ROAD_CAP ? 0.32 : 1;
    78	      d.p += dt * d.s * slow;
    79	      while (d.p >= 1) {
    80	        d.p -= 1;
    81	        var prev = d.b; d.b = d.a;
    82	        if (s.t[d.b] !== T.ROAD) { d.b = roadList.length ? roadList[(Math.random() * roadList.length) | 0] : d.b; prev = -1; }
    83	        var nb2 = roadNbrs(s, d.b);
    84	        if (nb2.length > 1) { var f = nb2.filter(function (v) { return v !== prev; }); if (f.length) nb2 = f; }
    85	        d.a = nb2.length ? nb2[(Math.random() * nb2.length) | 0] : d.b;
    86	      }
    87	    }
    88	  }

    91	  function grassCol(k) {
    92	    var v = ((k * 2654435761) >>> 0) % 3;
    93	    return v === 0 ? '#2d4632' : v === 1 ? '#314b36' : '#2a4130';
    94	  }

    96	  function drawTile(s, x, y) {
    97	    var k = y * W + x, t = s.t[k];
    98	    var px = ox + x * cell, py = oy + y * cell, c = cell;
    99	
   100	    if (t === T.WATER) {
   101	      var wob = Math.sin(time * 1.3 + x * 0.7 + y * 0.5) * 0.5 + 0.5;
   102	      cx.fillStyle = '#17384f'; cx.fillRect(px, py, c, c);
   103	      cx.fillStyle = 'rgba(120,200,235,' + (0.05 + wob * 0.07) + ')';
   104	      cx.fillRect(px, py + c * 0.35, c, c * 0.22);
   105	      return;
   106	    }
   107	    if (t === T.HILL) {
   108	      cx.fillStyle = '#3c4440'; cx.fillRect(px, py, c, c);
   109	      cx.fillStyle = '#4d5750';
   110	      cx.beginPath(); cx.moveTo(px + c * 0.5, py + c * 0.18);
   111	      cx.lineTo(px + c * 0.88, py + c * 0.82); cx.lineTo(px + c * 0.12, py + c * 0.82);
   112	      cx.closePath(); cx.fill();
   113	      cx.fillStyle = '#5d6a63';
   114	      cx.beginPath(); cx.moveTo(px + c * 0.5, py + c * 0.18);
   115	      cx.lineTo(px + c * 0.5, py + c * 0.82); cx.lineTo(px + c * 0.12, py + c * 0.82);
   116	      cx.closePath(); cx.fill();
   117	      return;
   118	    }
   119	
   120	    cx.fillStyle = grassCol(k); cx.fillRect(px, py, c, c);
   121	
   122	    if (t === T.ROAD) {
   123	      var cong = s.load[k] > S.ROAD_CAP;
   124	      cx.fillStyle = cong ? '#5a3f3c' : '#454f55';
   125	      cx.fillRect(px, py, c, c);
   126	      cx.fillStyle = cong ? 'rgba(255,120,90,0.30)' : 'rgba(230,235,240,0.14)';
   127	      var m = c * 0.42;
   128	      if (x > 0 && s.t[k - 1] === T.ROAD) cx.fillRect(px, py + m, c * 0.6, c * 0.16);
   129	      if (x < W - 1 && s.t[k + 1] === T.ROAD) cx.fillRect(px + c * 0.4, py + m, c * 0.6, c * 0.16);
   130	      if (y > 0 && s.t[k - W] === T.ROAD) cx.fillRect(px + m, py, c * 0.16, c * 0.6);
   131	      if (y < H - 1 && s.t[k + W] === T.ROAD) cx.fillRect(px + m, py + c * 0.4, c * 0.16, c * 0.6);
   132	      cx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.22)';
   133	      cx.fillRect(px, py, c, 1); cx.fillRect(px, py, 1, c);
   134	      return;
   135	    }
   136	    if (t === T.PARK) {
   137	      cx.fillStyle = '#3f6a35'; cx.fillRect(px + 1, py + 1, c - 2, c - 2);
   138	      cx.fillStyle = '#7ec24a';
   139	      var r = c * 0.17;
   140	      cx.beginPath(); cx.arc(px + c * 0.34, py + c * 0.38, r, 0, 6.284); cx.fill();
   141	      cx.beginPath(); cx.arc(px + c * 0.66, py + c * 0.60, r * 0.85, 0, 6.284); cx.fill();
   142	      cx.fillStyle = '#2f5228'; cx.fillRect(px + c * 0.32, py + c * 0.45, c * 0.05, c * 0.2);
   143	      return;
   144	    }
   145	    if (t === T.HOME || t === T.SHOP || t === T.POWER) drawBuilding(s, x, y, px, py, c, t, k);
   146	  }

   148	  var HOME_BODY = ['#3f8f57', '#48a862', '#57c477'];
   149	  var HOME_TOP  = ['#57b071', '#63c67e', '#7ee59a'];
   150	  var SHOP_BODY = ['#2f7aab', '#3690c9', '#3fa8e4'];

   153	  function drawBuilding(s, x, y, px, py, c, t, k) {
   154	    var d = s.d[k], lift, body, top;
   155	    if (t === T.POWER) {
   156	      cx.fillStyle = '#3a2b26'; cx.fillRect(px + 1, py + 1, c - 2, c - 2);
   157	      cx.fillStyle = '#c25b41'; cx.fillRect(px + c * 0.14, py + c * 0.30, c * 0.72, c * 0.56);
   158	      cx.fillStyle = '#e2795a'; cx.fillRect(px + c * 0.14, py + c * 0.30, c * 0.72, c * 0.10);
   159	      cx.fillStyle = '#8f8f92';
   160	      cx.fillRect(px + c * 0.24, py + c * 0.10, c * 0.16, c * 0.24);
   161	      cx.fillRect(px + c * 0.52, py + c * 0.06, c * 0.16, c * 0.28);
   162	      var puff = (time * 0.6) % 1;
   163	      cx.fillStyle = 'rgba(215,225,230,' + (0.36 * (1 - puff)) + ')';
   164	      cx.beginPath(); cx.arc(px + c * 0.60, py + c * 0.06 - puff * c * 0.35, c * 0.11 + puff * c * 0.08, 0, 6.284); cx.fill();
   165	      warn(s, k, px, py, c);
   166	      return;
   167	    }
   168	    if (t === T.HOME) { body = HOME_BODY[d]; top = HOME_TOP[d]; lift = [0.30, 0.42, 0.56][d]; }
   169	    else { body = SHOP_BODY[d]; top = SHOP_TOP[d]; lift = [0.32, 0.46, 0.62][d]; }
   170	
   171	    var pad = c * (d === 2 ? 0.06 : d === 1 ? 0.10 : 0.16);
   172	    var bw = c - pad * 2, bh = c - pad * 2;
   173	    // ground shadow
   174	    cx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.30)';
   175	    cx.fillRect(px + pad, py + pad + c * lift * 0.30, bw, bh - c * lift * 0.30);
   176	    // body
   177	    cx.fillStyle = body;
   178	    cx.fillRect(px + pad, py + pad, bw, bh);
   179	    // roof band (pseudo height)
   180	    cx.fillStyle = top;
   181	    cx.fillRect(px + pad, py + pad, bw, bh * (0.22 + lift * 0.28));
   182	    // windows
   183	    cx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,240,190,' + (s.pow[k] ? 0.78 : 0.10) + ')';
   184	    var cols = d + 2, ww = bw / (cols * 2.1), gap = bw / cols;
   185	    for (var i = 0; i < cols; i++) for (var j = 0; j < d + 1; j++) {
   186	      cx.fillRect(px + pad + gap * i + gap * 0.28, py + pad + bh * 0.42 + j * (bh * 0.26), ww, ww * 0.9);
   187	    }
   188	    cx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.35)'; cx.lineWidth = 1;
   189	    cx.strokeRect(px + pad + 0.5, py + pad + 0.5, bw - 1, bh - 1);
   190	    warn(s, k, px, py, c);
   191	  }

   193	  function warn(s, k, px, py, c) {
   194	    if (s.t[k] === T.POWER) return;
   195	    var pulse = 0.55 + 0.45 * Math.sin(time * 4);
   196	    var r = c * 0.13, wx = px + c - r - 1.5, wy = py + r + 1.5;
   197	    if (!s.acc[k]) { badge(wx, wy, r, 'rgba(255,90,80,' + pulse + ')', '#2a0b08'); return; }
   198	    if (!s.pow[k]) { badge(wx, wy, r, 'rgba(255,214,90,' + pulse + ')', '#332400'); return; }
   199	    if (!s.svc[k]) { badge(wx, wy, r, 'rgba(120,190,255,' + pulse + ')', '#04223a'); }
   200	  }
   201	  function badge(x, y, r, col, dark) {
   202	    cx.fillStyle = dark; cx.beginPath(); cx.arc(x, y, r + 1, 0, 6.284); cx.fill();
   203	    cx.fillStyle = col; cx.beginPath(); cx.arc(x, y, r, 0, 6.284); cx.fill();
   204	  }

   206	  // ---------- main draw ----------
   207	  function draw(s, dt, ui) {
   208	    time += dt;
   209	    updDots(s, dt);
   210	
   211	    cx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
   212	    if (shake > 0.05) {
   213	      cx.translate((Math.random() - 0.5) * shake, (Math.random() - 0.5) * shake);
   214	      shake *= Math.pow(0.001, dt);
   215	    } else shake = 0;
   216	
   217	    cx.fillStyle = '#0e1418'; cx.fillRect(-12, -12, cssW + 24, cssH + 24);
   218	
   219	    for (var y = 0; y < H; y++) for (var x = 0; x < W; x++) drawTile(s, x, y);
   220	
   221	    // traffic dots
   222	    for (var i = 0; i < dots.length; i++) {
   223	      var d = dots[i];
   224	      var bx = d.b % W, by = (d.b / W) | 0, ax = d.a % W, ay = (d.a / W) | 0;
   225	      var fx = (bx + (ax - bx) * d.p + 0.5) * cell + ox;
   226	      var fy = (by + (ay - by) * d.p + 0.5) * cell + oy;
   227	      var jam = s.load[d.b] > S.ROAD_CAP;
   228	      cx.fillStyle = jam ? '#ff8a63' : '#ffe9a8';
   229	      var r = Math.max(1.2, cell * 0.09);
   230	      cx.fillRect(fx - r, fy - r, r * 2, r * 2);
   231	    }
   232	
   233	    // build cursor / hover
   234	    if (ui.cur) {
   235	      var k = ui.cur.y * W + ui.cur.x, ok = S.buildable(s.t[k]) && s.funds >= ui.toolCost;
   236	      cx.lineWidth = 2;
   237	      cx.strokeStyle = ok ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.85)' : 'rgba(255,90,80,0.9)';
   238	      cx.strokeRect(ox + ui.cur.x * cell + 1, oy + ui.cur.y * cell + 1, cell - 2, cell - 2);
   239	      cx.fillStyle = ok ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.12)' : 'rgba(255,80,70,0.16)';
   240	      cx.fillRect(ox + ui.cur.x * cell, oy + ui.cur.y * cell, cell, cell);
   241	    }
   242	
   243	    // particles
   244	    for (var p = parts.length - 1; p >= 0; p--) {
   245	      var q = parts[p]; q.m += dt;
   246	      if (q.m >= q.l) { parts.splice(p, 1); continue; }
   247	      q.x += q.vx * dt; q.y += q.vy * dt; q.vy += 180 * dt;
   248	      var a = 1 - q.m / q.l;
   249	      cx.globalAlpha = a; cx.fillStyle = q.c;
   250	      var sz = Math.max(1.5, cell * 0.12 * a);
   251	      cx.fillRect(q.x - sz / 2, q.y - sz / 2, sz, sz);
   252	    }
   253	    cx.globalAlpha = 1;
   254	
   255	    // floating text
   256	    cx.textAlign = 'center';
   257	    cx.font = '700 ' + Math.max(10, Math.round(cell * 0.52)) + 'px ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif';
   258	    for (var f = floats.length - 1; f >= 0; f--) {
   259	      var t2 = floats[f]; t2.m += dt;
   260	      if (t2.m >= t2.l) { floats.splice(f, 1); continue; }
   261	      var al = 1 - t2.m / t2.l;
   262	      cx.globalAlpha = al; cx.fillStyle = '#000';
   263	      cx.fillText(t2.t, t2.x + 1, t2.y - t2.m * 26 + 1);
   264	      cx.fillStyle = t2.c;
   265	      cx.fillText(t2.t, t2.x, t2.y - t2.m * 26);
   266	    }
   267	    cx.globalAlpha = 1;
   268	  }

   272	    burst: burst, popText: popText, markDirty: markDirty, kick: kick,
   273	    cellSize: function () { return cell; }
   274	  };

    10	  var TOOLS = [
    11	    { id: 'road',  t: T.ROAD,  name: 'Road',  cost: 12,  col: '#5d6a71' },
    12	    { id: 'home',  t: T.HOME,  name: 'Homes', cost: 30,  col: '#4fb06a' },
    13	    { id: 'shop',  t: T.SHOP,  name: 'Shops', cost: 55,  col: '#3f9bd6' },
    14	    { id: 'power', t: T.POWER, name: 'Plant', cost: 300, col: '#d9694d' },
    15	    { id: 'park',  t: T.PARK,  name: 'Park',  cost: 40,  col: '#8fd44f' },
    16	    { id: 'raze',  t: -1,      name: 'Raze',  cost: 6,   col: '#c8ccd0' }
    17	  ];
    18	
    19	  var GOALS = [500, 2000, 5000];
    20	  var TICK_MS = 6000;
    21	
    22	  var HOME_POP  = [10, 34, 90];
    23	  var SHOP_CAP  = [220, 700, 1800]; // people each shop tier can serve
    24	  var PLANT_CAP = 46;               // building tiles a plant powers
    25	  var ROAD_CAP  = 26;               // traffic load before congestion
    26	
    27	  // ---------- rng ----------
    28	  function mulberry(a) {
    29	    return function () {
    30	      a |= 0; a = a + 0x6D2B79F5 | 0;
    31	      var t = Math.imul(a ^ a >>> 15, 1 | a);
    32	      t = t + Math.imul(t ^ t >>> 7, 61 | t) ^ t;
    33	      return ((t ^ t >>> 14) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
    34	    };
    35	  }
    36	
    37	  // ---------- state ----------
    38	  function blank(seed) {
    39	    var s = {
    40	      seed: seed >>> 0,
    41	      t: new Uint8Array(N),
    42	      d: new Uint8Array(N),      // density tier 0..2
    43	      g: new Float32Array(N),    // growth accumulator
    44	      pow: new Uint8Array(N),    // powered flag
    45	      acc: new Uint8Array(N),    // road access flag
    46	      svc: new Uint8Array(N),    // shop service flag (homes) / customers (shops)
    47	      des: new Float32Array(N),  // desirability
    48	      load: new Float32Array(N), // road traffic load
    49	      pop: 0, funds: 2200, month: 1, income: 0, upkeep: 0,
    50	      goal: 0, best: 0, broke: false, tickAcc: 0
    51	    };
    52	    terrain(s);
    53	    return s;
    54	  }
    55	
    56	  function terrain(s) {
    57	    var r = mulberry(s.seed), i, x, y;
    58	    // low-frequency value noise via random control points
    59	    var cw = 6, ch = 8, cp = [];
    60	    for (i = 0; i < cw * ch; i++) cp.push(r());
    61	    function samp(fx, fy) {
    62	      var gx = fx * (cw - 1), gy = fy * (ch - 1);
    63	      var x0 = Math.floor(gx), y0 = Math.floor(gy);
    64	      var x1 = Math.min(cw - 1, x0 + 1), y1 = Math.min(ch - 1, y0 + 1);
    65	      var tx = gx - x0, ty = gy - y0;
    66	      tx = tx * tx * (3 - 2 * tx); ty = ty * ty * (3 - 2 * ty);
    67	      var a = cp[y0 * cw + x0], b = cp[y0 * cw + x1], c = cp[y1 * cw + x0], d = cp[y1 * cw + x1];
    68	      return (a + (b - a) * tx) * (1 - ty) + (c + (d - c) * tx) * ty;
    69	    }
    70	    var wv = 0.30 + r() * 0.06, hv = 0.74 - r() * 0.04, open = 0, pass;
    71	    for (pass = 0; pass < 14; pass++) {
    72	      open = 0;
    73	      for (y = 0; y < H; y++) for (x = 0; x < W; x++) {
    74	        var v = samp(x / (W - 1), y / (H - 1));
    75	        var k = y * W + x;
    76	        s.t[k] = v < wv ? T.WATER : (v > hv ? T.HILL : T.GRASS);
    77	        if (s.t[k] === T.GRASS) open++;
    78	      }
    79	      if (open >= 245) break;      // keep enough buildable land for a 5k city
    80	      wv -= 0.022; hv += 0.022;
    81	    }
    82	    // guarantee a decent buildable core near centre
    83	    for (y = 8; y < 14; y++) for (x = 5; x < 11; x++) s.t[y * W + x] = T.GRASS;
    84	    // seed a starter road so the first tap is obvious
    85	    for (x = 5; x < 11; x++) s.t[10 * W + x] = T.ROAD;
    86	  }
    87	
    88	  // ---------- helpers ----------
    89	  function inb(x, y) { return x >= 0 && y >= 0 && x < W && y < H; }
    90	  function isBuilding(t) { return t === T.HOME || t === T.SHOP || t === T.POWER; }
    91	  function buildable(t) { return t !== T.WATER && t !== T.HILL; }
    92	
    93	  function place(s, x, y, tool) {
    94	    if (!inb(x, y)) return 0;
    95	    var k = y * W + x, cur = s.t[k];
    96	    if (cur === T.WATER || cur === T.HILL) return 0;
    97	    if (tool.t === -1) {                       // raze
    98	      if (cur === T.GRASS) return 0;
    99	      if (s.funds < tool.cost) { s.broke = true; return 0; }
   100	      s.t[k] = T.GRASS; s.d[k] = 0; s.g[k] = 0; s.funds -= tool.cost;
   101	      return 1;
   102	    }
   103	    if (cur === tool.t) return 0;
   104	    if (s.funds < tool.cost) { s.broke = true; return 0; }
   105	    s.t[k] = tool.t; s.d[k] = 0; s.g[k] = 0;
   106	    s.funds -= tool.cost;
   107	    return 1;
   108	  }
   109	
   110	  // ---------- state analysis (road access / power / desirability / traffic / shops) ----------
   111	  function analyze(s) {
   112	    var i, x, y, k, nx, ny;
   113	
   114	    // --- road access: adjacent to any road
   115	    s.acc.fill(0);
   116	    for (y = 0; y < H; y++) for (x = 0; x < W; x++) {
   117	      k = y * W + x;
   118	      if (!isBuilding(s.t[k])) continue;
   119	      if ((inb(x - 1, y) && s.t[k - 1] === T.ROAD) || (inb(x + 1, y) && s.t[k + 1] === T.ROAD) ||
   120	          (inb(x, y - 1) && s.t[k - W] === T.ROAD) || (inb(x, y + 1) && s.t[k + W] === T.ROAD)) s.acc[k] = 1;
   121	    }
   122	
   123	    // --- power: BFS over roads + plants, then fill buildings by distance, up to capacity
   124	    s.pow.fill(0);
   125	    var dist = new Int16Array(N).fill(-1), q = [], plants = 0;
   126	    for (k = 0; k < N; k++) if (s.t[k] === T.POWER) { dist[k] = 0; q.push(k); plants++; }
   127	    var qi = 0;
   128	    while (qi < q.length) {
   129	      k = q[qi++]; x = k % W; y = (k / W) | 0;
   130	      if (dist[k] >= 40) continue;
   131	      for (i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
   132	        nx = x + (i === 0 ? 1 : i === 1 ? -1 : 0); ny = y + (i === 2 ? 1 : i === 3 ? -1 : 0);
   133	        if (!inb(nx, ny)) continue;
   134	        var nk = ny * W + nx;
   135	        if (dist[nk] !== -1) continue;
   136	        if (s.t[nk] !== T.ROAD && s.t[nk] !== T.POWER) continue;
   137	        dist[nk] = dist[k] + 1; q.push(nk);
   138	      }
   139	    }
   140	    var cand = [];
   141	    for (y = 0; y < H; y++) for (x = 0; x < W; x++) {
   142	      k = y * W + x;
   143	      if (s.t[k] === T.POWER) { s.pow[k] = 1; continue; }
   144	      if (s.t[k] !== T.HOME && s.t[k] !== T.SHOP) continue;
   145	      var best = -1;
   146	      for (i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
   147	        nx = x + (i === 0 ? 1 : i === 1 ? -1 : 0); ny = y + (i === 2 ? 1 : i === 3 ? -1 : 0);
   148	        if (!inb(nx, ny)) continue;
   149	        var d2 = dist[ny * W + nx];
   150	        if (d2 >= 0 && (best < 0 || d2 < best)) best = d2;
   151	      }
   152	      if (best >= 0) cand.push([best, k]);
   153	    }
   154	    cand.sort(function (a, b) { return a[0] - b[0]; });
   155	    var cap = plants * PLANT_CAP;
   156	    for (i = 0; i < cand.length && i < cap; i++) s.pow[cand[i][1]] = 1;
   157	
   158	    // --- desirability field
   159	    s.des.fill(0);
   160	    stamp(s, T.PARK, 4, 3.4);
   161	    stamp(s, T.POWER, 3, -5.0);
   162	    // water is nice, hills are scenic
   163	    for (y = 0; y < H; y++) for (x = 0; x < W; x++) {
   164	      k = y * W + x;
   165	      if (s.t[k] !== T.WATER && s.t[k] !== T.HILL) continue;
   166	      var amt = s.t[k] === T.WATER ? 1.2 : 0.6;
   167	      for (ny = y - 2; ny <= y + 2; ny++) for (nx = x - 2; nx <= x + 2; nx++) {
   168	        if (!inb(nx, ny)) continue;
   169	        s.des[ny * W + nx] += amt / (1 + Math.abs(nx - x) + Math.abs(ny - y));
   170	      }
   171	    }
   172	
   173	    // --- traffic load on roads (from nearby occupied buildings)
   174	    s.load.fill(0);
   175	    for (y = 0; y < H; y++) for (x = 0; x < W; x++) {
   176	      k = y * W + x;
   177	      var w = 0;
   178	      if (s.t[k] === T.HOME) w = HOME_POP[s.d[k]] * 0.28;
   179	      else if (s.t[k] === T.SHOP) w = (s.d[k] + 1) * 7;
   180	      if (!w) continue;
   181	      // spread this building's trips over nearby road tiles (more roads = less load each)
   182	      var sum = 0;
   183	      for (ny = y - 2; ny <= y + 2; ny++) for (nx = x - 2; nx <= x + 2; nx++) {
   184	        if (!inb(nx, ny) || s.t[ny * W + nx] !== T.ROAD) continue;
   185	        sum += 1 / (1 + Math.abs(nx - x) + Math.abs(ny - y));
   186	      }
   187	      if (sum <= 0) continue;
   188	      for (ny = y - 2; ny <= y + 2; ny++) for (nx = x - 2; nx <= x + 2; nx++) {
   189	        if (!inb(nx, ny)) continue;
   190	        var rk = ny * W + nx;
   191	        if (s.t[rk] !== T.ROAD) continue;
   192	        s.load[rk] += w * (1 / (1 + Math.abs(nx - x) + Math.abs(ny - y))) / sum;
   193	      }
   194	    }
   195	
   196	    // --- shop service: homes need a shop in radius 5; shops need customers in radius 5
   197	    s.svc.fill(0);
   198	    var shops = [], homes = [], pop = 0;
   199	    for (k = 0; k < N; k++) {
   200	      if (s.t[k] === T.SHOP) shops.push(k);
   201	      else if (s.t[k] === T.HOME) { homes.push(k); pop += s.d[k] > 0 || s.g[k] > 0 ? HOME_POP[s.d[k]] : HOME_POP[0]; }
   202	    }
   203	    var shopDemand = new Float32Array(shops.length);
   204	
   205	    for (var hi = 0; hi < homes.length; hi++) {
   206	      k = homes[hi]; x = k % W; y = (k / W) | 0;
   207	      var near = [];
   208	      for (i = 0; i < shops.length; i++) {
   209	        var sk = shops[i], sx = sk % W, sy = (sk / W) | 0;
   210	        var dd = Math.max(Math.abs(sx - x), Math.abs(sy - y));
   211	        if (dd <= 5 && s.pow[sk] && s.acc[sk]) near.push([dd, i]);
   212	      }
   213	      near.sort(function (a, b) { return a[0] - b[0]; });
   214	      var need = HOME_POP[s.d[k]];
   215	      for (i = 0; i < near.length; i++) {
   216	        var si = near[i][1];
   217	        if (shopDemand[si] < SHOP_CAP[s.d[shops[si]]]) { s.svc[k] = 1; shopDemand[si] += need; break; }
   218	      }
   219	    }
   220	    for (i = 0; i < shops.length; i++) if (shopDemand[i] > 0) s.svc[shops[i]] = 1;
   221	
   222	    return { homes: homes, shops: shops };
   223	  }
   224	
   225	  // ---------- monthly tick ----------
   226	  function tick(s) {
   227	    var i, k, x, y;
   228	    analyze(s);
   229	
   230	    // --- growth / decay
   231	    var grew = [];
   232	    for (k = 0; k < N; k++) {
   233	      var tt = s.t[k];
   234	      if (tt !== T.HOME && tt !== T.SHOP) continue;
   235	      x = k % W; y = (k / W) | 0;
   236	      var ok = s.acc[k] && s.pow[k] && s.svc[k];
   237	      var cong = roadCong(s, x, y);
   238	      if (tt === T.SHOP) ok = s.acc[k] && s.pow[k] && s.svc[k];
   239	      if (ok) {
   240	        var rate = 1;
   241	        rate += Math.max(-0.6, Math.min(0.8, s.des[k] * 0.16));
   242	        rate *= cong ? 0.35 : 1;
   243	        rate *= (s.d[k] === 0 ? 1 : s.d[k] === 1 ? 0.55 : 0);
   244	        s.g[k] += rate;
   245	        if (s.g[k] >= 3 && s.d[k] < 2) { s.d[k]++; s.g[k] = 0; grew.push(k); }
   246	      } else {
   247	        s.g[k] -= 0.7;
   248	        if (s.g[k] <= -3) { s.g[k] = 0; if (s.d[k] > 0) s.d[k]--; }
   249	      }
   250	    }
   251	
   252	    // --- population & economy
   253	    var pop = 0, jobs = 0;
   254	    for (k = 0; k < N; k++) {
   255	      if (s.t[k] === T.HOME) { if (s.acc[k] && s.pow[k]) pop += HOME_POP[s.d[k]]; else pop += Math.round(HOME_POP[s.d[k]] * 0.25); }
   256	      else if (s.t[k] === T.SHOP && s.pow[k]) jobs += (s.d[k] + 1) * 12;
   257	    }
   258	    s.pop = pop;
   259	    if (pop > s.best) s.best = pop;
   260	
   261	    var tax = Math.round(30 + pop * 0.55 + Math.min(jobs, pop) * 0.30);
   262	    var up = 0;
   263	    for (k = 0; k < N; k++) {
   264	      if (s.t[k] === T.ROAD) up += 0.4;
   265	      else if (s.t[k] === T.POWER) up += 22;
   266	      else if (s.t[k] === T.PARK) up += 2;
   267	      else if (s.t[k] === T.HOME) up += 0.8 * (s.d[k] + 1);
   268	      else if (s.t[k] === T.SHOP) up += 1.2 * (s.d[k] + 1);
   269	    }
   270	    up = Math.round(up);
   271	    s.income = tax; s.upkeep = up;
   272	    s.funds += tax - up;
   273	    if (s.funds < 0) s.funds = 0;
   274	    // emergency relief so a bankrupt city can always dig itself out
   275	    if (s.funds < 70 && tax - up <= 0) s.funds += 30;
   276	    s.broke = false;
   277	    s.month++;
   278	
   279	    var lvl = -1;
   280	    while (s.goal < GOALS.length && pop >= GOALS[s.goal]) { lvl = s.goal; s.goal++; }
   281	    return { grew: grew, net: tax - up, goalHit: lvl };
   282	  }
   283	
   284	  function stamp(s, type, rad, amt) {
   285	    for (var y = 0; y < H; y++) for (var x = 0; x < W; x++) {
   286	      var k = y * W + x;
   287	      if (s.t[k] !== type) continue;
   288	      var d = s.d[k] || 0;
   289	      for (var ny = y - rad; ny <= y + rad; ny++) for (var nx = x - rad; nx <= x + rad; nx++) {
   290	        if (!inb(nx, ny)) continue;
   291	        var m = Math.max(Math.abs(nx - x), Math.abs(ny - y));
   292	        s.des[ny * W + nx] += amt * (1 - m / (rad + 1)) * (1 + d * 0.15);
   293	      }
   294	    }
   295	  }
   296	
   297	  function roadCong(s, x, y) {
   298	    for (var i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
   299	      var nx = x + (i === 0 ? 1 : i === 1 ? -1 : 0), ny = y + (i === 2 ? 1 : i === 3 ? -1 : 0);
   300	      if (!inb(nx, ny)) continue;
   301	      var k = ny * W + nx;
   302	      if (s.t[k] === T.ROAD && s.load[k] > ROAD_CAP) return true;
   303	    }
   304	    return false;
   305	  }
   306	
   307	  // ---------- save ----------
   308	  var KEY = 'blockborough.city.v1', BKEY = 'blockborough.best.v1';
   309	  function save(s) {
   310	    try {
   311	      var o = {
   312	        seed: s.seed, t: Array.from(s.t), d: Array.from(s.d),
   313	        g: Array.from(s.g, function (v) { return Math.round(v * 10) / 10; }),
   314	        pop: s.pop, funds: Math.round(s.funds), month: s.month, goal: s.goal, best: s.best
   315	      };
   316	      localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(o));
   317	      localStorage.setItem(BKEY, String(Math.max(s.best, bestScore())));
   318	    } catch (e) {}
   319	  }
   320	  function bestScore() { try { return parseInt(localStorage.getItem(BKEY) || '0', 10) || 0; } catch (e) { return 0; } }
   321	  function load() {
   322	    try {
   323	      var o = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY) || 'null');
   324	      if (!o || !o.t || o.t.length !== N) return null;
   325	      var s = blank(o.seed);
   326	      s.t.set(o.t); s.d.set(o.d); s.g.set(o.g);
   327	      s.pop = o.pop | 0; s.funds = o.funds | 0; s.month = o.month | 0 || 1;
   328	      s.goal = o.goal | 0; s.best = Math.max(o.best | 0, bestScore());
   329	      return s;
   330	    } catch (e) { return null; }
   331	  }
   332	  function wipe() { try { localStorage.removeItem(KEY); } catch (e) {} }
   333

   338	    isBuilding: isBuilding, save: save, load: load, wipe: wipe, bestScore: bestScore
   339	  };

    28	  function pick(px, py) {

    30	    return S.inb(x, y) ? { x: x, y: y } : null;

    33	  function markDirty() { roadDirty = true; }

    36	  function burst(x, y, col, n) {
    37	    if (parts.length > 260) return;

    59	    var x = k % W, y = (k / W) | 0, out = [];

    66	  function updDots(s, dt) {
    67	    if (roadDirty) rebuildRoads(s);
    68	    var want = Math.min(64, Math.floor(s.pop / 45) + (roadList.length ? 3 : 0));
    69	    while (dots.length > want) dots.pop();

    71	      var b = roadList[(Math.random() * roadList.length) | 0];
    72	      var nb = roadNbrs(s, b);
    73	      dots.push({ b: b, a: nb.length ? nb[(Math.random() * nb.length) | 0] : b, p: Math.random(), s: 0.8 + Math.random() * 0.7 });
    74	    }
    75	    for (var i = 0; i < dots.length; i++) {
    76	      var d = dots[i];
    77	      var slow = s.load[d.b] > S.ROAD_CAP ? 0.32 : 1;
    78	      d.p += dt * d.s * slow;
    79	      while (d.p >= 1) {
    80	        d.p -= 1;
    81	        var prev = d.b; d.b = d.a;
    82	        if (s.t[d.b] !== T.ROAD) { d.b = roadList.length ? roadList[(Math.random() * roadList.length) | 0] : d.b; prev = -1; }
    83	        var nb2 = roadNbrs(s, d.b);
    84	        if (nb2.length > 1) { var f = nb2.filter(function (v) { return v !== prev; }); if (f.length) nb2 = f; }
    85	        d.a = nb2.length ? nb2[(Math.random() * nb2.length) | 0] : d.b;
    86	      }
    87	    }
    88	  }

   107	  function spark(x, y, n, c, spd, sz, life) {
   108	    for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
   109	      if (parts.length > 300) break;
   110	      var an = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2, s = spd * (0.35 + Math.random() * 0.9);
   111	      parts.push({
   112	        x: x, y: y, vx: Math.cos(an) * s, vy: Math.sin(an) * s - spd * 0.35,
   113	        l: life * (0.6 + Math.random() * 0.7), m: life, s: sz * (0.6 + Math.random() * 0.9),
   114	        c: c, g: 1
   115	      });
   116	    }
   117	  }
   118	  function pop(x, y, txt, c) {
   119	    if (pops.length > 14) pops.shift();
   120	    pops.push({ x: x, y: y, t: txt, l: 1.1, c: c || '#ffd166' });
   121	  }
   122	  function kick(a) { shake = Math.min(26, shake + a); }
   123	
   124	  function mult() { return Math.min(9, 1 + Math.floor(G.combo / 2)); }
   125	  function award(pts, label, x, y, col) {
   126	    var m = mult();
   127	    var v = Math.round(pts * m);
   128	    G.score += v;
   129	    if (label) pop(x, y, label + '  +' + v, col);
   130	    G.combo++;
   131	    G.comboT = 5;
   132	    if (mult() > G.maxCombo) G.maxCombo = mult();
   133	    G.boost = Math.min(100, G.boost + 16);
   134	    SFX.trick(Math.min(4, Math.floor(G.combo / 2)));
   135	  }
   136	
   137	  // ---------- physics helpers ----------
   138	  function bodyPoints(b) {
   139	    var ca = Math.cos(b.a), sa = Math.sin(b.a), p = [];
   140	    var c = [[-HW, -HH], [HW, -HH], [HW, HH], [-HW, HH]];
   141	    for (var i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
   142	      p.push([b.x + c[i][0] * ca - c[i][1] * sa, b.y + c[i][0] * sa + c[i][1] * ca, c[i][0], c[i][1]]);
   143	    }
   144	    return p;
   145	  }
   146	
   147	  function crushObs(o, targetTop, impact, px) {
   148	    var top = o.top0 - o.h;
   149	    if (targetTop <= top + 1.5) return false;
   150	    if (o.tough) {
   151	      if (impact < 210) return false;
   152	      targetTop = top + Math.min(targetTop - top, 14 + impact * 0.05);
   153	    }
   154	    var nh = Math.max(0, o.top0 - targetTop);
   155	    if (nh >= o.h - 0.5) return false;
   156	    var removed = o.h - nh;
   157	    o.h = nh;
   158	    o.hit = 1;
   159	    o.wob = Math.min(1, o.wob + removed / 20);
   160	    if (!o.started) { o.started = true; G.crushes++; }
   161	    var big = o.tough || removed > 12;
   162	    G.score += Math.round(removed * 5 * mult());
   163	    spark(px, top + 4, big ? 16 : 9, o.type === 'bus' ? '#ffcf5a' : 'hsl(' + o.hue + ',60%,62%)', 190, 3.4, 0.55);
   164	    spark(px, top + 4, 6, '#cfd6e6', 150, 2.4, 0.4);
   165	    SFX.crush(big);
   166	    kick(big ? 13 : 7);
   167	    if (o.h <= 1.5 && !o.dead) {
   168	      o.dead = true;
   169	      G.flat++;
   170	      award(220, o.type === 'bus' ? 'BUS FLATTENED' : 'FLATTENED', px, top - 10, '#ff8f6b');
   171	      spark(px, top, 18, '#ffffff', 230, 3, 0.6);
   172	      kick(16);
   173	    }
   174	    return true;
   175	  }
   176	
   177	  // resolve deep horizontal penetration into a still-solid obstacle
   178	  function wallPass(b) {
   179	    var pts = bodyPoints(b);
   180	    for (var w = 0; w < 2; w++) pts.push([b.wheels[w].wx, b.wheels[w].wy + WR * 0.6, 0, 0]);
   181	    for (var k = 0; k < W.obs.length; k++) {
   182	      var o = W.obs[k];
   183	      if (o.h <= 1.5) continue;
   184	      var top = o.top0 - o.h, l = o.x - o.w * 0.5, r = o.x + o.w * 0.5;
   185	      for (var i = 0; i < pts.length; i++) {
   186	        var p = pts[i];
   187	        if (p[0] < l || p[0] > r || p[1] < top + 16) continue;
   188	        // push out the near side
   189	        var dl = p[0] - l, dr = r - p[0];
   190	        if (dl < dr) { b.x -= Math.min(dl, 6); if (b.vx > 0) b.vx *= -0.15; }
   191	        else { b.x += Math.min(dr, 6); if (b.vx < 0) b.vx *= -0.15; }
   192	        b.av *= 0.9;
   193	        // grinding: sustained shoving chews through even tough obstacles
   194	        o.press = (o.press || 0) + 1;
   195	        if (o.press > 10) {
   196	          o.press = 0;
   197	          crushObs(o, top + 11, 9999, Math.max(l + 8, Math.min(r - 8, p[0])));
   198	        }
   199	        return;
   200	      }
   201	    }
   202	  }
   203	
   204	  function crushPass(b) {
   205	    var pts = [];
   206	    for (var w = 0; w < 2; w++) pts.push([b.wheels[w].wx, b.wheels[w].wy + WR]);
   207	    var bp = bodyPoints(b);
   208	    for (var i = 0; i < 4; i++) pts.push([bp[i][0], bp[i][1]]);
   209	    var spd = Math.abs(b.vx), fall = Math.max(0, b.vy);
   210	    var impact = Math.max(spd * 0.8, fall);
   211	    for (var k = 0; k < W.obs.length; k++) {
   212	      var o = W.obs[k];
   213	      if (o.h <= 1.5) continue;
   214	      var top = o.top0 - o.h, l = o.x - o.w * 0.5, r = o.x + o.w * 0.5;
   215	      for (var j = 0; j < pts.length; j++) {
   216	        var p = pts[j];
   217	        if (p[0] < l || p[0] > r) continue;
   218	        if (p[1] > top + 1.5) { crushObs(o, p[1], impact, Math.max(l + 8, Math.min(r - 8, p[0]))); break; }
   219	      }
   220	    }
   221	  }
   222	
   223	  function step(dt) {
   224	    var b = truck;
   225	    var thr = 0, lean = 0;
   226	    var live = G.state === 'play' && G.wreck <= 0;
   227	    var L = K.l || touchL, R = K.r || touchR;
   228	    if (live) {
   229	      if (L && !R) thr = -1;
   230	      if (R && !L) thr = 1;
   231	      lean = thr;
   232	    }
   233	
   234	    // gravity
   235	    b.vy += GRAV * dt;
   236	
   237	    crushPass(b);
   238	    wallPass(b);
   239	
   240	    var contacts = 0, groundSpd = 0, wheelDown = [false, false];
   241	    var ca = Math.cos(b.a), sa = Math.sin(b.a);
   242	    var dx = -sa, dy = ca; // body "down"
   243	
   244	    for (var i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
   245	      var wh = b.wheels[i];
   246	      var ax = b.x + wh.lx * ca - wh.ly * sa;
   247	      var ay = b.y + wh.lx * sa + wh.ly * ca;
   248	      var len = SUS_MAX, grounded = false, pen = 0;
   249	
   250	      if (dy > 0.25) {
   251	        var probe = W.at(ax + dx * SUS_MAX);
   252	        var Ln = (probe.y - WR - ay) / dy;
   253	        if (Ln < SUS_MAX) {
   254	          grounded = true;
   255	          len = Math.max(SUS_MIN, Ln);
   256	          if (Ln < SUS_MIN) pen = Math.min(30, SUS_MIN - Ln);
   257	        }
   258	      }
   259	      wh.len = len;
   260	      wh.wx = ax + dx * wh.len;
   261	      wh.wy = ay + dy * wh.len;
   262	      wh.grounded = grounded;
   263	      wh.comp = (SUS_MAX - wh.len) / (SUS_MAX - SUS_MIN);
   264	      wheelDown[i] = grounded;
   265	
   266	      if (grounded) {
   267	        contacts++;
   268	        var rx = ax - b.x, ry = ay - b.y;
   269	        var pvx = b.vx - b.av * ry, pvy = b.vy + b.av * rx;
   270	        var comp = SUS_MAX - len;
   271	        var vn = pvx * dx + pvy * dy; // + = compressing
   272	        var F = SUS_K * comp + 300 * pen + SUS_C * vn;
   273	        if (F < 0) F = 0;
   274	        if (F > 5200) F = 5200;
   275	        var fx = -dx * F, fy = -dy * F;
   276	        b.vx += fx / MASS * dt; b.vy += fy / MASS * dt;
   277	        b.av += (rx * fy - ry * fx) / INER * dt;
   278	
   279	        // ground tangent
   280	        var g2 = W.at(wh.wx);
   281	        var sl = g2.slope, nl = Math.sqrt(1 + sl * sl);
   282	        var tx = 1 / nl, ty = sl / nl;
   283	        var vt = pvx * tx + pvy * ty;
   284	        groundSpd += vt;
   285	        var drive = thr * ENGINE - vt * ROLL;
   286	        if (thr === 0) drive -= vt * 2.2;
   287	        var grip = Math.min(1, comp / 5);
   288	        var ftx = tx * drive * grip, fty = ty * drive * grip;
   289	        b.vx += ftx / MASS * dt; b.vy += fty / MASS * dt;
   290	        b.av += (rx * fty - ry * ftx) / INER * dt * 0.85;
   291	        wh.spin += vt / WR * dt;
   292	      } else {
   293	        wh.spin += (thr * 9 + b.vx / WR * 0.5) * dt;
   294	      }
   295	    }
   296	
   297	    // body corner collision (roof / nose scrape)
   298	    var pts = bodyPoints(b), bodyHit = false;
   299	    for (var c = 0; c < 4; c++) {
   300	      var p = pts[c];
   301	      var g = W.at(p[0]);
   302	      if (p[1] > g.y) {
   303	        bodyHit = true;
   304	        var depth = p[1] - g.y;
   305	        b.y -= Math.min(depth, 5) * 0.55;
   306	        var sl2 = g.slope, n2 = Math.sqrt(1 + sl2 * sl2);
   307	        var nx = sl2 / n2, ny = -1 / n2;
   308	        var rx2 = p[0] - b.x, ry2 = p[1] - b.y;
   309	        var pvx2 = b.vx - b.av * ry2, pvy2 = b.vy + b.av * rx2;
   310	        var vn2 = pvx2 * nx + pvy2 * ny;
   311	        if (vn2 < 0) {
   312	          var rn = rx2 * ny - ry2 * nx;
   313	          var jj = -(1.05) * vn2 / (1 / MASS + rn * rn / INER);
   314	          b.vx += jj * nx / MASS; b.vy += jj * ny / MASS;
   315	          b.av += (rx2 * (jj * ny) - ry2 * (jj * nx)) / INER;
   316	          if (vn2 < -140) { spark(p[0], p[1], 5, '#ffd166', 130, 2.2, 0.35); kick(4); }
   317	        }
   318	        // scrape friction
   319	        b.vx *= 1 - Math.min(0.5, 4 * dt);
   320	        b.av *= 1 - Math.min(0.6, 5 * dt);
   321	      }
   322	    }
   323	
   324	    // air control
   325	    if (contacts === 0 && !bodyHit) {
   326	      if (live) b.av -= lean * AIR_TQ * dt; // right throttle = nose up = backflip
   327	      b.av *= 1 - 0.10 * dt;
   328	      b.air += dt; b.airRot += b.av * dt;
   329	      b.grounded = 0;
   330	    } else {
   331	      b.av *= 1 - Math.min(0.85, 2.6 * dt);
   332	      b.grounded += dt;
   333	    }
   334	    if (b.av > AV_MAX) b.av = AV_MAX;
   335	    if (b.av < -AV_MAX) b.av = -AV_MAX;
   336	
   337	    // boost
   338	    var bReq = (K.b || touchB) && live && G.boost > 1;
   339	    G.boosting = bReq;
   340	    if (bReq) {
   341	      var f = 1900;
   342	      b.vx += Math.cos(b.a) * f * dt;
   343	      b.vy += Math.sin(b.a) * f * dt;
   344	      G.boost = Math.max(0, G.boost - 42 * dt);
   345	      b.flame = 1;
   346	      if (!step._bs) { SFX.boost(); step._bs = 1; }
   347	      if (Math.random() < 0.85) {
   348	        var ex = b.x - Math.cos(b.a) * 44, ey = b.y - Math.sin(b.a) * 44;
   349	        parts.push({ x: ex, y: ey, vx: -Math.cos(b.a) * 220 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 60, vy: -Math.sin(b.a) * 220 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 60, l: 0.3, m: 0.3, s: 4, c: '#5adcff', g: 0.1 });
   350	      }
   351	      kick(1.6);
   352	    } else { step._bs = 0; b.flame *= 0.85; }
   353	
   354	    // air drag
   355	    b.vx *= 1 - 0.12 * dt; b.vy *= 1 - 0.06 * dt;
   356	
   357	    // integrate
   358	    b.x += b.vx * dt; b.y += b.vy * dt; b.a += b.av * dt;
   359	    if (b.a > Math.PI) b.a -= Math.PI * 2; else if (b.a < -Math.PI) b.a += Math.PI * 2;
   360	
   361	    // arena bounds
   362	    if (b.x < 40) { b.x = 40; b.vx = Math.abs(b.vx) * 0.3; }
   363	    if (b.x > W.w - 40) { b.x = W.w - 40; b.vx = -Math.abs(b.vx) * 0.3; }
   364	    if (b.y > W.base + 500) { b.y = W.baseY(b.x) - 60; b.vy = 0; b.vx = 0; }
   365	
   366	    // dirt spray
   367	    if (contacts && Math.abs(b.vx) > 140 && Math.random() < 0.55) {
   368	      var wq = b.wheels[b.vx > 0 ? 0 : 1];
   369	      parts.push({
   370	        x: wq.wx, y: wq.wy + WR - 3, vx: -b.vx * 0.22 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 40,
   371	        vy: -Math.random() * 110 - 20, l: 0.45, m: 0.45, s: 3, c: '#7a5c3a', g: 1
   372	      });
   373	    }
   374	
   375	    // ---- trick resolution ----
   376	    var upsideDown = Math.cos(b.a) < -0.25;
   377	    if (G.wreck <= 0 && G.state === 'play') {
   378	      if (b.air > 0 && (contacts > 0 || bodyHit)) {
   379	        // landed
   380	        var at = b.air, ar = b.airRot;
   381	        b.air = 0; b.airRot = 0;
   382	        G.airTotal += at;
   383	        if (upsideDown && at > 0.15) {
   384	          wreckOut();
   385	        } else if (at > 0.22) {
   386	          var fl = Math.floor(Math.abs(ar) / (Math.PI * 2 - 0.7));
   387	          if (fl > 0) {
   388	            G.flips += fl;
   389	            award(380 * fl, (ar < 0 ? 'BACKFLIP' : 'FRONTFLIP') + (fl > 1 ? ' x' + fl : ''), b.x, b.y - 60, '#7dffb0');
   390	            kick(9);
   391	          }
   392	          if (at > 0.55) {
   393	            award(Math.round(at * 130), at > 1.3 ? 'HUGE AIR' : 'AIR', b.x, b.y - 40, '#9fd0ff');
   394	          }
   395	          SFX.land(Math.abs(b.vy) + 200);
   396	          kick(Math.min(12, 3 + at * 5));
   397	          spark(b.x, b.y + 26, 8, '#8a6a44', 150, 2.6, 0.4);
   398	        } else if (bodyHit && upsideDown) {
   399	          wreckOut();
   400	        }
   401	      }
   402	      // beached: on the roof, or stood up on nose/tail and going nowhere
   403	      var beached = upsideDown || (Math.abs(b.a) > 1.15 && Math.abs(b.vx) < 70);
   404	      if (beached && (contacts > 0 || bodyHit) && b.air === 0 && Math.abs(b.av) < 3.2) {
   405	        b.rollT = (b.rollT || 0) + dt;
   406	        if (b.rollT > 0.4) wreckOut();
   407	      } else b.rollT = 0;
   408	
   409	      // wheelies
   410	      var one = (wheelDown[0] !== wheelDown[1]);
   411	      var nose = wheelDown[1] && !wheelDown[0] && b.a > 0.22;
   412	      var back = wheelDown[0] && !wheelDown[1] && b.a < -0.22;
   413	      if (one && (nose || back) && Math.abs(b.vx) > 40) {
   414	        b.wheelieT += dt;
   415	        G.score += Math.round(55 * mult() * dt);
   416	        G.comboT = Math.max(G.comboT, 1.2);
   417	        if (b.wheelieT > 0.75 && !b.wheelieAwarded) {
   418	          b.wheelieAwarded = true;
   419	          award(160, nose ? 'NOSE WHEELIE' : 'WHEELIE', b.x, b.y - 46, '#ffd166');
   420	        }
   421	      } else { b.wheelieT = 0; b.wheelieAwarded = false; }
   422	    }
   423	
   424	    // wreck recovery
   425	    if (G.wreck > 0) {
   426	      G.wreck -= dt;
   427	      var tgt = 0;
   428	      b.a += (tgt - b.a) * Math.min(1, dt * 3.2);
   429	      b.av *= 0.85;
   430	      b.vx *= 1 - Math.min(0.9, 3 * dt);
   431	      if (G.wreck <= 0) {
   432	        G.wreck = 0;
   433	        b.a = 0; b.av = 0; b.air = 0; b.airRot = 0;
   434	        b.y = Math.min(b.y, W.baseY(b.x) - 46);
   435	        b.vy = -80;
   436	      }
   437	    }
   438	
   439	    // combo decay
   440	    if (G.comboT > 0) { G.comboT -= dt; if (G.comboT <= 0) G.combo = 0; }
   441	
   442	    // engine sfx
   443	    SFX.engine(Math.abs(thr) + (G.boosting ? 0.6 : 0), Math.abs(b.vx), contacts === 0);
   444	
   445	    // timer
   446	    if (G.state === 'play') {
   447	      G.t -= dt;
   448	      if (G.t <= 0) { G.t = 0; endRun(); }
   449	    }
   450	  }
   451	
   452	  function wreckOut() {
   453	    if (G.wreck > 0) return;
   454	    G.wreck = 3;
   455	    G.combo = 0; G.comboT = 0;
   456	    truck.air = 0; truck.airRot = 0;
   457	    pop(truck.x, truck.y - 40, 'WRECKED  -3s', '#ff6b6b');
   458	    spark(truck.x, truck.y, 20, '#ff6b6b', 210, 3.2, 0.6);
   459	    kick(20);
   460	    SFX.wreck();
   461	  }
   462	
   463	  function endRun() {
   464	    G.state = 'over';
   465	    SFX.quiet();
   466	    SFX.over();
   467	    if (G.score > G.best) { G.best = G.score; saveBest(G.score); }
   468	    elFin.textContent = G.score.toLocaleString();
   469	    elBest.textContent = 'BEST ' + G.best.toLocaleString();
   470	    elStats.innerHTML =
   471	      'CRUSHED <b>' + G.crushes + '</b> &nbsp;·&nbsp; FLATTENED <b>' + G.flat + '</b><br>' +
   472	      'FLIPS <b>' + G.flips + '</b> &nbsp;·&nbsp; AIRTIME <b>' + G.airTotal.toFixed(1) + 's</b><br>' +
   473	      'BEST MULTIPLIER <b>x' + G.maxCombo + '</b>';
   474	    over.classList.add('show');
   475	  }

   477	  // ---------- rendering ----------
   478	  function resize() {
   479	    var dpr = Math.min(2, window.devicePixelRatio || 1);
   480	    var w = window.innerWidth, h = window.innerHeight;
   481	    var bw = Math.round(w * dpr), bh = Math.round(h * dpr);
   482	    var long = Math.max(bw, bh);
   483	    if (long > 960) { var k = 960 / long; bw = Math.round(bw * k); bh = Math.round(bh * k); }
   484	    cv.width = bw; cv.height = bh;
   485	    cw = bw; ch = bh;
   486	    S = cw / 390;
   487	    zoom = Math.min(cw / 440, ch / 640);
   488	    zoom = Math.max(zoom, cw / 1000);
   489	  }
   490	  window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
   491	  window.addEventListener('orientationchange', function () { setTimeout(resize, 120); });
   492	
   493	  var skyGrad = null, skyKey = '';
   494	  function sky() {
   495	    var key = cw + 'x' + ch;
   496	    if (skyKey !== key) {
   497	      skyGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, ch);
   498	      skyGrad.addColorStop(0, '#1b1f33');
   499	      skyGrad.addColorStop(0.45, '#2e2a45');
   500	      skyGrad.addColorStop(1, '#5a3f4e');
   501	      skyKey = key;
   502	    }
   503	    ctx.fillStyle = skyGrad;
   504	    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, cw, ch);
   505	  }
   506	
   507	  var OX = 0, OY = 0;
   508	  function sx(x) { return (x - cam.x) * zoom + OX; }
   509	  function sy(y) { return (y - cam.y) * zoom + OY; }
   510	
   511	  function drawTerrain() {
   512	    var vw = viewW();
   513	    var x0 = cam.x - vw * 0.6, x1 = cam.x + vw * 0.6;
   514	    x0 = Math.max(-200, x0); x1 = Math.min(W.w + 200, x1);
   515	    ctx.beginPath();
   516	    ctx.moveTo(sx(x0), ch + 10);
   517	    var stp = 7;
   518	    for (var x = x0; x <= x1; x += stp) ctx.lineTo(sx(x), sy(W.baseY(x)));
   519	    ctx.lineTo(sx(x1), ch + 10);
   520	    ctx.closePath();
   521	    var gr = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, sy(W.base - 380), 0, sy(W.base + 120));
   522	    gr.addColorStop(0, '#6b5236');
   523	    gr.addColorStop(0.35, '#4e3c28');
   524	    gr.addColorStop(1, '#2c2419');
   525	    ctx.fillStyle = gr; ctx.fill();
   526	    // top edge
   527	    ctx.beginPath();
   528	    for (var x2 = x0, first = true; x2 <= x1; x2 += stp) {
   529	      var px = sx(x2), py = sy(W.baseY(x2));
   530	      if (first) { ctx.moveTo(px, py); first = false; } else ctx.lineTo(px, py);
   531	    }

   604	  function drawTruck() {
   605	    var b = truck, ang = b.a;
   606	    // wheels (world space - they ride the suspension)

   676	  function drawParticles(dt) {
   677	    for (var i = parts.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   678	      var p = parts[i];
   679	      p.l -= dt;
   680	      if (p.l <= 0) { parts.splice(i, 1); continue; }
   681	      p.vy += GRAV * 0.55 * p.g * dt;
   682	      p.x += p.vx * dt; p.y += p.vy * dt;
   683	      var a = Math.max(0, p.l / p.m);
   684	      ctx.globalAlpha = a;
   685	      ctx.fillStyle = p.c;
   686	      var s = p.s * zoom * (0.5 + a * 0.7);
   687	      ctx.fillRect(sx(p.x) - s / 2, sy(p.y) - s / 2, s, s);
   688	    }
   689	    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   690	  }

   768	  // ---------- loop ----------
   769	  function frame(now) {
   770	    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
   771	    if (!lastT) lastT = now;
   772	    var dt = (now - lastT) / 1000;
   773	    lastT = now;
   774	    if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;
   775	    if (dt <= 0) return;
   776	
   777	    if (G.state === 'play') {
   778	      var sub = Math.min(5, Math.max(2, Math.ceil(dt / 0.009)));
   779	      for (var i = 0; i < sub; i++) step(dt / sub);
   780	    } else {
   781	      SFX.engine(0, 0, false);
   782	    }
   783	    if (hintT > 0) hintT -= dt;
   784	
   785	    // camera
   786	    var tx = truck.x + truck.vx * 0.22;
   787	    var ty = truck.y - 30;
   788	    var gy = W.baseY(truck.x);
   789	    if (ty > gy - 60) ty = gy - 60;
   790	    cam.x += (tx - cam.x) * Math.min(1, dt * 6.5);
   791	    cam.y += (ty - cam.y) * Math.min(1, dt * 4.5);
   792	    var halfW = viewW() / 2;
   793	    if (cam.x < halfW - 40) cam.x = halfW - 40;
   794	    if (cam.x > W.w - halfW + 40) cam.x = W.w - halfW + 40;
   795	
   796	    shake *= 1 - Math.min(0.9, 6 * dt);
   797	    OX = cw / 2 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * shake * S;
   798	    OY = ch * 0.62 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * shake * S;
   799	
   800	    // draw
   801	    sky();
   802	    drawDeco();
   803	    drawTerrain();
   804	    drawObs();
   805	    drawParticles(dt);
   806	    drawTruck();
   807	    drawPops(dt);
   808	    hud();
   809	
   810	    // boost meter DOM
   811	    bfill.style.width = G.boost.toFixed(0) + '%';
   812	    if (G.boost < 2) bBoost.classList.add('empty'); else bBoost.classList.remove('empty');
   813	  }
   814	
   815	  resize();
   816	  reset((Math.random() * 1e9) | 0);
   817	  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
   818	})();
