   104	function startGrind(s, y) {
   105	  P.grind = true; P.grindSeg = s; P.y = y; P.vy = 0; P.onGround = false;
   106	  P.bal = rnd(-0.12, 0.12); P.balv = 0; P.grindPts = 0; P.grindT = 0;
   107	  P.trick = null; P.rot = 0; P.flip = 0;
   108	  SFX.grindStart();
   109	  pop(s.k === 'rail' ? 'RAIL SLIDE' : 'LEDGE GRIND', 'HOLD IT');
   110	}
   111	function endGrind() {
   112	  if (P.grindPts > 0) addCombo('GRIND ' + Math.round(P.grindT * 10) / 10 + 's', Math.round(P.grindPts));
   113	  P.grind = false; P.grindSeg = null; P.grindPts = 0;
   114	  SFX.grindStop();
   115	}
   116	
   117	/* ---------------- bail ---------------- */
   118	function bail(reason) {
   119	  if (state !== 'run') return;
   120	  state = 'bail';
   121	  SFX.grindStop(); SFX.bail();
   122	  P.combo.length = 0; P.comboSum = 0;
   123	  shake = 18; flash = 0.45; flashCol = '#ff5b6e';
   124	  P.rag = {
   125	    x: P.x, y: P.y - 16, vx: P.v * 0.55, vy: -rnd(220, 380), rot: P.rot, rv: rnd(-9, 9),
   126	    bx: P.x, by: P.y, bvx: P.v * 0.8 + rnd(0, 120), bvy: -rnd(160, 300), brot: 0, brv: rnd(-14, 14),
   127	    t: 0, reason: reason
   128	  };
   129	  Parts.spawn(P.x, P.y - 14, 26, { c: '#ff8fa0', vx0: -180, vx1: 220, vy0: -320, vy1: 40, s0: 2, s1: 5, l1: 0.9, sq: true });
   130	  Parts.spawn(P.x, P.y, 14, { c: '#cfd6e6', vx0: -120, vx1: 180, vy0: -160, vy1: 0, l1: 0.7 });
   131	}
   132	
   133	function gameOver() {
   134	  state = 'over';
   135	  if (total() > best) {
   136	    best = total();
   137	    try { localStorage.setItem('curbside.best', String(best)); } catch (e) { }
   138	  }
   139	}
   140	
   141	/* ---------------- update ---------------- */
   142	function update(dt) {
   143	  timeAll += dt; tHint += dt;
   144	  shake = Math.max(0, shake - dt * 48);
   145	  flash = Math.max(0, flash - dt * 1.9);
   146	  for (var i = popups.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) { popups[i].t += dt; if (popups[i].t > 1.3) popups.splice(i, 1); }
   147	  Parts.update(dt);
   148	  World.update(dt);
   149	
   150	  if (state === 'run') updateRun(dt);
   151	  else if (state === 'bail') {
   152	    var r = P.rag; r.t += dt;
   153	    P.v *= Math.pow(0.16, dt);
   154	    var groundY = bestSurfaceY(r.x);
   155	    r.vy += G * dt; r.x += r.vx * dt; r.y += r.vy * dt; r.rot += r.rv * dt; r.vx *= Math.pow(0.55, dt);
   156	    if (groundY !== null && r.y > groundY - 12) { r.y = groundY - 12; r.vy *= -0.34; r.rv *= 0.5; r.vx *= 0.6; if (Math.abs(r.vy) > 60) Parts.spawn(r.x, groundY, 5, { c: '#9aa4bb', l1: 0.4 }); }
   157	    var gb = bestSurfaceY(r.bx);
   158	    r.bvy += G * dt; r.bx += r.bvx * dt; r.by += r.bvy * dt; r.brot += r.brv * dt; r.bvx *= Math.pow(0.7, dt);
   159	    if (gb !== null && r.by > gb - 3) { r.by = gb - 3; r.bvy *= -0.4; r.brv *= 0.6; }
   160	    camX = lerp(camX, r.x - W * 0.34, 1 - Math.pow(0.001, dt));
   161	    camY = lerp(camY, r.y - H * 0.6, 1 - Math.pow(0.004, dt));
   162	    if (r.t > 1.15) gameOver();
   163	    if (r.t > 0.4 && (Input.tapPress || Input.tapQuick)) { gameOver(); }
   164	  } else if (state === 'over') {
   165	    if (Input.tapPress || Input.tapQuick) reset();
   166	  }
   167	}
   168	
   169	function bestSurfaceY(x) {
   170	  World.surfaces(x, surfBuf);
   171	  var y = null;
   172	  for (var i = 0; i < surfBuf.length; i++) if (y === null || surfBuf[i].y > y) y = surfBuf[i].y;
   173	  return y;
   174	}
   175	
   176	function updateRun(dt) {
   177	  var i, s;
   178	  // ---- speed ----
   179	  P.v = clamp(P.v + 5 * dt, 240, 660);
   180	  P.x += P.v * dt;
   181	  distPx += P.v * dt;
   182	  P.wobble = Math.max(0, P.wobble - dt * 2.5);
   183	
   184	  World.gen(P.x + W * 2.2, distPx);
   185	  World.prune(P.x - W * 1.2);
   186	
   187	  // ---- input ----
   188	  var sw = Input.swipe;
   189	  if (P.grind) {
   190	    if (Input.tapQuick) { addCombo('POP OUT', 40); popOff(600); }
   191	  } else if (P.onGround) {
   192	    if (Input.tapPress) popOff(660);
   193	  } else {
   194	    if (sw === 3) {
   195	      if (!tryLatchGrind()) startTrick(3);
   196	    } else if (sw) startTrick(sw);
   197	  }
   198	
   199	  // ---- grinding ----
   200	  if (P.grind) {
   201	    var gs = P.grindSeg;
   202	    P.grindT += dt;
   203	    var pts = 45 * dt * (1 + P.grindT * 0.5);
   204	    P.grindPts += pts;
   205	    P.y = World.segY(gs, clamp(P.x, gs.x0, gs.x1));
   206	    // balance
   207	    var ctrl = Input.balance();
   208	    P.balv += (P.bal * 3.4 + Math.sin(timeAll * 7.3) * 0.35 + rnd(-1.1, 1.1)) * dt;
   209	    P.balv -= ctrl * 4.6 * dt;
   210	    P.balv = clamp(P.balv, -3.2, 3.2);
   211	    P.bal += P.balv * dt;
   212	    if (Math.abs(P.bal) >= 1) { bail('lost balance'); return; }
   213	    P.groundRef = P.y;
   214	    Parts.spawn(P.x - 10, P.y, 1, { c: '#ffe66d', vx0: -220, vx1: -60, vy0: -120, vy1: -20, s0: 1, s1: 2.4, l1: 0.35, g: 700 });
   215	    if (P.x > gs.x1) { endGrind(); P.onGround = false; P.vy = -180; }
   216	    camFollow(dt);
   217	    return;
   218	  }
   219	
   220	  // ---- vertical ----
   221	  var prevY = P.y;
   222	  if (P.onGround) {
   223	    // stick to surface / step off
   224	    World.surfaces(P.x, surfBuf);
   225	    var found = null;
   226	    for (i = 0; i < surfBuf.length; i++) {
   227	      var c = surfBuf[i];
   228	      if (c.y >= P.y - 7 && c.y <= P.y + 16) { if (found === null || c.y < found.y) found = c; }
   229	    }
   230	    if (found) { P.y = found.y; P.seg = found.s; P.groundRef = P.y; P.rot = lerp(P.rot, 0, 1 - Math.pow(0.001, dt)); }
   231	    else { P.onGround = false; P.vy = 40; P.airT = 0; }
   232	  }
   233	  if (!P.onGround) {
   234	    P.airT += dt;
   235	    P.vy += G * dt;
   236	    P.y += P.vy * dt;
   237	    // trick anim
   238	    if (P.trick) {
   239	      P.tt += dt / P.trick.dur;
   240	      var e = easeOut(clamp(P.tt, 0, 1));
   241	      P.rot = P.trickRot0 + P.trick.rot * e;
   242	      P.flip = P.trickFlip0 + P.trick.flip * e;
   243	      if (P.tt >= 1) {
   244	        P.rot = 0; P.flip = 0;
   245	        addCombo(P.trick.n, P.trick.sc);
   246	        P.trick = null; P.tuck = 0;
   247	      }
   248	    }
   249	    // land?
   250	    World.surfaces(P.x, surfBuf);
   251	    var hit = null;
   252	    for (i = 0; i < surfBuf.length; i++) {
   253	      var su = surfBuf[i];
   254	      if (prevY <= su.y + 2 && P.y >= su.y && P.vy > 0) { if (hit === null || su.y < hit.y) hit = su; }
   255	    }
   256	    if (hit) land(hit);
   257	    else if (P.y > P.groundRef + 250) { bail('fell in the gap'); return; }
   258	  }
   259	
   260	  // ---- obstacle collision ----
   261	  var bx0 = P.x - 11, bx1 = P.x + 11, by0 = P.y - 34, by1 = P.y - 2;
   262	  for (i = 0; i < World.obs.length; i++) {
   263	    var o = World.obs[i];
   264	    if (bx1 > o.x && bx0 < o.x + o.w && by1 > o.y && by0 < o.y + o.h) { bail('clipped it'); return; }
   265	  }
   266	  for (i = 0; i < World.cars.length; i++) {
   267	    var car = World.cars[i];
   268	    if (bx1 > car.x + 4 && bx0 < car.x + car.w - 4 && by1 > car.y + 5 && by0 < car.y + car.h) { bail('ate a bumper'); return; }
   269	  }
   270	
   271	  camFollow(dt);
   272	}
   273	
   274	function camFollow(dt) {
   275	  camX = P.x - W * 0.30;
   276	  camY = lerp(camY, P.groundRef - H * 0.66, 1 - Math.pow(0.02, dt));
   277	}
   278	
   279	function tryLatchGrind() {
   280	  for (var i = 0; i < World.segs.length; i++) {
   281	    var s = World.segs[i];
   282	    if (s.k !== 'rail' && s.k !== 'ledge') continue;
   283	    if (P.x < s.x0 - 18 || P.x > s.x1) continue;
   284	    var y = World.segY(s, clamp(P.x, s.x0, s.x1));
   285	    if (P.y > y - 46 && P.y < y + 16) { startGrind(s, y); return true; }
   286	  }
   287	  return false;
   288	}
   289	
   290	function land(hit) {
   291	  var s = hit.s;
   292	  // grindable surface -> auto slide
   293	  if ((s.k === 'rail' || s.k === 'ledge') && P.x < s.x1 - 8) {
   294	    if (P.trick && P.tt < 0.85) { bail('caught the lip'); return; }
   295	    if (P.trick) { addCombo(P.trick.n, P.trick.sc); P.trick = null; }
   296	    startGrind(s, hit.y);
   297	    return;
   298	  }
   299	  var err = Math.abs(angNorm(P.rot));
   300	  var mid = P.trick ? P.tt : 1;          // how far through the trick we are
   301	  P.y = hit.y; P.vy = 0; P.onGround = true; P.seg = s; P.tuck = 0; P.groundRef = P.y;
   302	
   303	  if (mid < 0.7 || err > 0.85) {
   304	    P.trick = null;
   305	    bail(mid < 0.7 ? 'landed mid-rotation' : 'landed sideways');
   306	    return;
   307	  }
   308	  if (P.trick) {
   309	    // scrappy but survivable: near-finished rotation snaps upright, half credit
   310	    var full = mid >= 0.88;
   311	    addCombo(P.trick.n + (full ? '' : ' (SCRAPPY)'), Math.round(P.trick.sc * (full ? 1 : 0.5)));
   312	    P.trick = null;
   313	    if (!full) err = 0.6;
   314	  }
   315	  P.rot = 0; P.flip = 0;
   316	
   317	  if (err < 0.34) {           // clean
   318	    P.v = Math.min(660, P.v + (P.combo.length ? 26 : 8));
   319	    bankCombo(true);
   320	    SFX.land(true);
   321	    Parts.spawn(P.x, P.y, 8, { c: '#cfd6e6', vx0: -140, vx1: -20, vy0: -110, vy1: -10, l1: 0.45 });
   322	  } else {                    // sketchy
   323	    P.v = Math.max(240, P.v - 80);
   324	    P.wobble = 1;
   325	    bankCombo(false);
   326	    shake = Math.max(shake, 7);
   327	    SFX.land(false);
   328	    Parts.spawn(P.x, P.y, 12, { c: '#ffb35c', vx0: -180, vx1: 40, vy0: -140, vy1: 0, l1: 0.5 });
   329	  }
   330	  P.lastLand = timeAll;
   331	}

   333	/* ---------------- render ---------------- */
   334	function hash(n) { var x = Math.sin(n * 127.1) * 43758.5453; return x - Math.floor(x); }
   335	
   336	function drawSky() {
   337	  var g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
   338	  g.addColorStop(0, '#191233');
   339	  g.addColorStop(0.45, '#3b2350');
   340	  g.addColorStop(0.72, '#8b3f63');
   341	  g.addColorStop(1, '#e0714f');
   342	  ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
   343	  // stars
   344	  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)';
   345	  for (var i = 0; i < 34; i++) {
   346	    var sx = hash(i) * W, sy = hash(i + 90) * H * 0.42;
   347	    var tw = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(timeAll * 2 + i);
   348	    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.25 + tw * 0.4;
   349	    ctx.fillRect(sx, sy, 1.6, 1.6);
   350	  }
   351	  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   352	  // sun
   353	  var sunY = H * 0.52 - camY * 0.02, sunX = W * 0.72;
   354	  var sg = ctx.createRadialGradient(sunX, sunY, 4, sunX, sunY, 150);
   355	  sg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,196,120,0.42)');
   356	  sg.addColorStop(0.35, 'rgba(255,140,110,0.18)');
   357	  sg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,120,120,0)');
   358	  ctx.fillStyle = sg;
   359	  ctx.fillRect(sunX - 150, sunY - 150, 300, 300);
   360	}
   361	
   362	function drawSkyline(par, bw, hmin, hmax, col, baseFrac) {
   363	  var startX = camX * par;
   364	  var i0 = Math.floor(startX / bw) - 1, n = Math.ceil(W / bw) + 3;
   365	  var baseY = H * baseFrac - camY * par * 0.35;
   366	  ctx.fillStyle = col;
   367	  for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
   368	    var idx = i0 + i;
   369	    var h = hmin + hash(idx * 1.7) * (hmax - hmin);
   370	    var x = idx * bw - startX;
   371	    ctx.fillRect(x, baseY - h, bw - 3, h + H + 400);
   372	    // windows
   373	    if (par > 0.28) {
   374	      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,214,140,0.20)';
   375	      for (var wy = baseY - h + 12; wy < baseY - 8; wy += 18) {
   376	        for (var wx = x + 6; wx < x + bw - 10; wx += 14) {
   377	          if (hash(wx * 0.31 + wy * 0.77 + idx) > 0.55) ctx.fillRect(wx, wy, 5, 8);
   378	        }
   379	      }
   380	      ctx.fillStyle = col;
   381	    }
   382	  }
   383	}
   384	
   385	function drawWorld() {
   386	  var bottom = camY + H + 60;
   387	  // ground bodies
   388	  for (var i = 0; i < World.segs.length; i++) {
   389	    var s = World.segs[i];
   390	    if (s.x1 < camX - 40 || s.x0 > camX + W + 40) continue;
   391	    var x0 = s.x0 - camX, x1 = s.x1 - camX, y0 = s.y0 - camY, y1 = s.y1 - camY;
   392	    if (s.k === 'street' || s.k === 'stair' || s.k === 'ramp') {
   393	      ctx.fillStyle = '#2a2739';
   394	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x0, y0); ctx.lineTo(x1, y1); ctx.lineTo(x1, H + 60); ctx.lineTo(x0, H + 60); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
   395	      ctx.strokeStyle = s.k === 'stair' ? '#6f6a92' : '#57527a';
   396	      ctx.lineWidth = 3;
   397	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x0, y0 - 1); ctx.lineTo(x1, y1 - 1); ctx.stroke();
   398	      if (s.k === 'street' && s.x1 - s.x0 > 120) {
   399	        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,225,140,0.35)'; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
   400	        ctx.setLineDash([16, 22]);
   401	        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x0, y0 + 26); ctx.lineTo(x1, y1 + 26); ctx.stroke();
   402	        ctx.setLineDash([]);
   403	      }
   404	    } else if (s.k === 'ledge') {
   405	      ctx.fillStyle = '#3c3752';
   406	      ctx.fillRect(x0, y0, x1 - x0, 40);
   407	      ctx.fillStyle = '#8ff0d4';
   408	      ctx.fillRect(x0, y0 - 3, x1 - x0, 4);
   409	      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.25)';
   410	      ctx.fillRect(x0, y0 + 22, x1 - x0, 18);
   411	    } else if (s.k === 'rail') {
   412	      // posts
   413	      ctx.strokeStyle = '#5b6c86'; ctx.lineWidth = 4;
   414	      for (var px = x0 + 8; px < x1; px += 62) {
   415	        var t = (px - x0) / Math.max(1, x1 - x0);
   416	        var py = y0 + (y1 - y0) * t;
   417	        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(px, py); ctx.lineTo(px, py + 48); ctx.stroke();
   418	      }
   419	      ctx.strokeStyle = '#63e6ff'; ctx.lineWidth = 7; ctx.lineCap = 'round';
   420	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x0, y0); ctx.lineTo(x1, y1); ctx.stroke();
   421	      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.6)'; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
   422	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x0, y0 - 2); ctx.lineTo(x1, y1 - 2); ctx.stroke();
   423	      ctx.lineCap = 'butt';
   424	    }
   425	  }
   426	  // obstacles
   427	  for (var j = 0; j < World.obs.length; j++) {
   428	    var o = World.obs[j];
   429	    if (o.x + o.w < camX - 20 || o.x > camX + W + 20) continue;
   430	    var ox = o.x - camX, oy = o.y - camY;
   431	    if (o.k === 'hydrant') {
   432	      ctx.fillStyle = '#e8524f';
   433	      ctx.fillRect(ox, oy + 6, o.w, o.h - 6);
   434	      ctx.fillRect(ox - 4, oy + 12, o.w + 8, 6);
   435	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(ox + o.w / 2, oy + 6, o.w / 2, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
   436	    } else if (o.k === 'cone') {
   437	      ctx.fillStyle = '#ff8a3d';
   438	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(ox + o.w / 2, oy); ctx.lineTo(ox + o.w + 3, oy + o.h); ctx.lineTo(ox - 3, oy + o.h); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
   439	      ctx.fillStyle = '#ffe9d6'; ctx.fillRect(ox - 1, oy + o.h * 0.45, o.w + 2, 4);
   440	    }
   441	  }
   442	  // cars
   443	  for (var k = 0; k < World.cars.length; k++) {
   444	    var c = World.cars[k];
   445	    if (c.x + c.w < camX - 40 || c.x > camX + W + 40) continue;
   446	    var cx = c.x - camX, cy = c.y - camY;
   447	    ctx.fillStyle = 'hsl(' + c.hue + ',48%,44%)';
   448	    ctx.fillRect(cx, cy + 16, c.w, c.h - 16);
   449	    ctx.beginPath();
   450	    ctx.moveTo(cx + 18, cy + 16); ctx.lineTo(cx + 34, cy); ctx.lineTo(cx + 84, cy); ctx.lineTo(cx + 100, cy + 16);
   451	    ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
   452	    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(180,230,255,0.55)';
   453	    ctx.fillRect(cx + 36, cy + 3, 44, 12);
   454	    ctx.fillStyle = '#141220';
   455	    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx + 26, cy + c.h, 12, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
   456	    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx + c.w - 26, cy + c.h, 12, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
   457	    if (c.vx) { ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,240,180,0.75)'; ctx.fillRect(cx - 4, cy + 26, 6, 7); }
   458	  }
   459	  // props
   460	  for (var m = 0; m < World.props.length; m++) {
   461	    var pr = World.props[m];
   462	    if (pr.x < camX - 20 || pr.x > camX + W + 20) continue;
   463	    var qx = pr.x - camX, qy = pr.y - camY;
   464	    if (pr.k === 'post') { ctx.fillStyle = '#4a4665'; ctx.fillRect(qx, qy - 74, 5, 74); ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd98a'; ctx.fillRect(qx - 5, qy - 80, 16, 7); }
   465	    else if (pr.k === 'trash') { ctx.fillStyle = '#3f4a5c'; ctx.fillRect(qx, qy - 30, 22, 30); ctx.fillStyle = '#586479'; ctx.fillRect(qx - 2, qy - 34, 26, 5); }
   466	    else { ctx.fillStyle = '#4a4665'; ctx.fillRect(qx, qy - 16, 8, 16); }
   467	  }
   468	}
   469	
   470	function drawSkater(x, y, rot, flip, grinding, tuck, wob) {
   471	  ctx.save();
   472	  ctx.translate(x, y);
   473	  ctx.rotate(rot + (wob ? Math.sin(timeAll * 40) * 0.09 * wob : 0));
   474	  // board
   475	  var sx = Math.cos(flip);
   476	  ctx.save();
   477	  ctx.scale(sx < 0 ? Math.min(-0.12, sx) : Math.max(0.12, sx), 1);
   478	  ctx.fillStyle = '#f2f3f8';
   479	  ctx.beginPath();
   480	  ctx.moveTo(-22, 0); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-25, -6, -18, -6);
   481	  ctx.lineTo(18, -6); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(25, -6, 22, 0);
   482	  ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
   483	  ctx.fillStyle = '#f2a33c';
   484	  ctx.fillRect(-16, -6, 32, 2.5);
   485	  ctx.fillStyle = '#201c2e';
   486	  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(-12, 3, 3.4, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
   487	  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(12, 3, 3.4, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
   488	  ctx.restore();
   489	  // legs

   653	var last = 0;
   654	function frame(now) {
   655	  if (!last) last = now;
   656	  var dt = (now - last) / 1000; last = now;
   657	  if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;
   658	  if (window.innerWidth !== W || window.innerHeight !== H) resize();
   659	  update(dt);
   660	  render();
   661	  Input.endFrame();
   662	  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
   663	}

     1	'use strict';
     2	/* Curbside - engine: math, audio, particles, input */
     3	
     4	var TAU = Math.PI * 2;
     5	function clamp(v, a, b) { return v < a ? a : (v > b ? b : v); }
     6	function lerp(a, b, t) { return a + (b - a) * t; }
     7	function rnd(a, b) { return a + Math.random() * (b - a); }
     8	function irnd(a, b) { return Math.floor(rnd(a, b + 1)); }
     9	function pick(a) { return a[(Math.random() * a.length) | 0]; }
    10	function angNorm(a) { a = a % TAU; if (a > Math.PI) a -= TAU; if (a < -Math.PI) a += TAU; return a; }
    11	function easeOut(t) { return 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 2.2); }

    13	/* ---------------- Audio (WebAudio only, no files) ---------------- */
    14	var SFX = {
    15	  ctx: null, master: null, noiseBuf: null, grindSrc: null, grindGain: null, on: true,
    16	  init: function () {
    17	    if (this.ctx) { if (this.ctx.state === 'suspended') this.ctx.resume(); return; }
    18	    var AC = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
    19	    if (!AC) { this.on = false; return; }
    20	    try { this.ctx = new AC(); } catch (e) { this.on = false; return; }
    21	    this.master = this.ctx.createGain();
    22	    this.master.gain.value = 0.55;
    23	    this.master.connect(this.ctx.destination);
    24	    var sr = this.ctx.sampleRate, len = sr * 2;
    25	    var b = this.ctx.createBuffer(1, len, sr), d = b.getChannelData(0);
    26	    for (var i = 0; i < len; i++) d[i] = Math.random() * 2 - 1;
    27	    this.noiseBuf = b;
    28	  },
    29	  tone: function (f0, f1, dur, type, vol) {
    30	    if (!this.on || !this.ctx) return;
    31	    var t = this.ctx.currentTime, o = this.ctx.createOscillator(), g = this.ctx.createGain();
    32	    o.type = type || 'square';
    33	    o.frequency.setValueAtTime(f0, t);
    34	    o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(20, f1), t + dur);
    35	    g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, t);
    36	    g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(vol || 0.2, t + 0.01);
    37	    g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t + dur);
    38	    o.connect(g); g.connect(this.master); o.start(t); o.stop(t + dur + 0.02);
    39	  },
    40	  noise: function (dur, f, q, vol) {
    41	    if (!this.on || !this.ctx) return;
    42	    var t = this.ctx.currentTime, s = this.ctx.createBufferSource();
    43	    s.buffer = this.noiseBuf;
    44	    var bp = this.ctx.createBiquadFilter();
    45	    bp.type = 'bandpass'; bp.frequency.value = f; bp.Q.value = q || 1;
    46	    var g = this.ctx.createGain();
    47	    g.gain.setValueAtTime(vol || 0.3, t);
    48	    g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t + dur);
    49	    s.connect(bp); bp.connect(g); g.connect(this.master);
    50	    s.start(t); s.stop(t + dur + 0.02);
    51	  },
    52	  ollie: function () { this.noise(0.16, 1700, 1.2, 0.22); this.tone(320, 620, 0.10, 'square', 0.07); },
    53	  land: function (good) { this.noise(0.13, good ? 480 : 260, 0.9, 0.3); if (good) this.tone(220, 130, 0.09, 'triangle', 0.1); },
    54	  trick: function (n) { this.tone(420 + n * 90, 900 + n * 120, 0.13, 'sawtooth', 0.1); },
    55	  bail: function () { this.noise(0.55, 300, 0.5, 0.5); this.tone(180, 40, 0.5, 'sawtooth', 0.18); },
    56	  chime: function (n) { this.tone(520 + n * 60, 900 + n * 60, 0.2, 'triangle', 0.12); },
    57	  grindStart: function () {
    58	    if (!this.on || !this.ctx || this.grindSrc) return;
    59	    var s = this.ctx.createBufferSource();
    60	    s.buffer = this.noiseBuf; s.loop = true;
    61	    var bp = this.ctx.createBiquadFilter();
    62	    bp.type = 'bandpass'; bp.frequency.value = 2600; bp.Q.value = 6;
    63	    var g = this.ctx.createGain(); g.gain.value = 0.0001;
    64	    g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.16, this.ctx.currentTime + 0.05);
    65	    s.connect(bp); bp.connect(g); g.connect(this.master); s.start();
    66	    this.grindSrc = s; this.grindGain = g;
    67	  },
    68	  grindStop: function () {
    69	    if (!this.grindSrc) return;
    70	    var s = this.grindSrc, g = this.grindGain, t = this.ctx.currentTime;
    71	    g.gain.cancelScheduledValues(t);
    72	    g.gain.setValueAtTime(g.gain.value, t);
    73	    g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t + 0.08);
    74	    try { s.stop(t + 0.12); } catch (e) { }
    75	    this.grindSrc = null; this.grindGain = null;
    76	  }
    77	};
    78	
    79	/* ---------------- Particles ---------------- */
    80	var Parts = {
    81	  list: [],
    82	  reset: function () { this.list.length = 0; },
    83	  spawn: function (x, y, n, opt) {
    84	    opt = opt || {};
    85	    for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    86	      if (this.list.length > 260) break;
    87	      this.list.push({
    88	        x: x, y: y,
    89	        vx: rnd(opt.vx0 === undefined ? -60 : opt.vx0, opt.vx1 === undefined ? 60 : opt.vx1),
    90	        vy: rnd(opt.vy0 === undefined ? -120 : opt.vy0, opt.vy1 === undefined ? -10 : opt.vy1),
    91	        g: opt.g === undefined ? 900 : opt.g,
    92	        life: 0, max: rnd(opt.l0 || 0.25, opt.l1 || 0.6),
    93	        s: rnd(opt.s0 || 2, opt.s1 || 4),
    94	        c: opt.c || '#ffd166', sq: !!opt.sq
    95	      });
    96	    }
    97	  },
    98	  update: function (dt) {
    99	    for (var i = this.list.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   100	      var p = this.list[i];
   101	      p.life += dt;
   102	      if (p.life >= p.max) { this.list.splice(i, 1); continue; }
   103	      p.vy += p.g * dt; p.x += p.vx * dt; p.y += p.vy * dt;
   104	    }
   105	  },
   106	  draw: function (c) {
   107	    for (var i = 0; i < this.list.length; i++) {
   108	      var p = this.list[i], a = 1 - p.life / p.max;
   109	      c.globalAlpha = a;
   110	      c.fillStyle = p.c;
   111	      if (p.sq) c.fillRect(p.x - p.s, p.y - p.s, p.s * 2, p.s * 2);
   112	      else { c.beginPath(); c.arc(p.x, p.y, p.s * a + 0.6, 0, TAU); c.fill(); }
   113	    }
   114	    c.globalAlpha = 1;
   115	  }
   116	};

   118	/* ---------------- Input ---------------- */
   119	var Input = {
   120	  ptr: null,           // active pointer {id,x0,y0,x,y,t0,fired,dragOx}
   121	  swipe: 0,            // 1=L 2=R 3=U 4=D consumed by game
   122	  tapPress: false,     // pointer/space went down this frame
   123	  tapQuick: false,     // quick tap released this frame
   124	  dragX: 0,            // live horizontal drag (px) for balance
   125	  keys: {},
   126	  keyBal: 0,
   127	  bind: function (cv, onFirst) {
   128	    var self = this;
   129	    function first() { SFX.init(); if (onFirst) onFirst(); }
   130	    function pos(e) {
   131	      var r = cv.getBoundingClientRect();
   132	      return { x: e.clientX - r.left, y: e.clientY - r.top };
   133	    }
   134	    cv.addEventListener('pointerdown', function (e) {
   135	      e.preventDefault(); first();
   136	      if (self.ptr) return;
   137	      var p = pos(e);
   138	      self.ptr = { id: e.pointerId, x0: p.x, y0: p.y, x: p.x, y: p.y, t0: performance.now(), fired: false, moved: 0 };
   139	      self.tapPress = true; self.dragX = 0;
   140	      if (cv.setPointerCapture) { try { cv.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); } catch (er) { } }
   141	    }, { passive: false });
   142	    cv.addEventListener('pointermove', function (e) {
   143	      e.preventDefault();
   144	      if (!self.ptr || self.ptr.id !== e.pointerId) return;
   145	      var p = pos(e), q = self.ptr;
   146	      q.x = p.x; q.y = p.y;
   147	      var dx = q.x - q.x0, dy = q.y - q.y0;
   148	      q.moved = Math.max(q.moved, Math.hypot(dx, dy));
   149	      self.dragX = dx;
   150	      if (!q.fired && Math.hypot(dx, dy) > 30) {
   151	        q.fired = true;
   152	        if (Math.abs(dx) > Math.abs(dy)) self.swipe = dx < 0 ? 1 : 2;
   153	        else self.swipe = dy < 0 ? 3 : 4;
   154	      }
   155	    }, { passive: false });
   156	    function up(e) {
   157	      if (!self.ptr || self.ptr.id !== e.pointerId) return;
   158	      var q = self.ptr;
   159	      if (!q.fired && q.moved < 20 && performance.now() - q.t0 < 260) self.tapQuick = true;
   160	      self.ptr = null; self.dragX = 0;
   161	    }
   162	    cv.addEventListener('pointerup', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); up(e); }, { passive: false });
   163	    cv.addEventListener('pointercancel', function (e) { up(e); }, { passive: false });
   164	    cv.addEventListener('touchmove', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); }, { passive: false });
   165	    cv.addEventListener('contextmenu', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); });
   166	
   167	    window.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
   168	      var k = e.key.toLowerCase();
   169	      if ([' ', 'arrowleft', 'arrowright', 'arrowup', 'arrowdown', 'a', 'd', 'w', 's', 'enter'].indexOf(k) >= 0) e.preventDefault();
   170	      if (self.keys[k]) return;
   171	      self.keys[k] = true; first();
   172	      if (k === ' ' || k === 'enter') { self.tapPress = true; self.tapQuick = true; }
   173	      if (k === 'arrowleft' || k === 'a') self.swipe = 1;
   174	      if (k === 'arrowright' || k === 'd') self.swipe = 2;
   175	      if (k === 'arrowup' || k === 'w') self.swipe = 3;
   176	      if (k === 'arrowdown' || k === 's') self.swipe = 4;
   177	    });
   178	    window.addEventListener('keyup', function (e) { self.keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = false; });
   179	  },
   180	  balance: function () {
   181	    var k = 0;
   182	    if (this.keys['arrowleft'] || this.keys['a']) k -= 60;
   183	    if (this.keys['arrowright'] || this.keys['d']) k += 60;
   184	    if (k !== 0) return clamp(k / 60, -1, 1);
   185	    return clamp(this.dragX / 55, -1, 1);
   186	  },
   187	  endFrame: function () { this.swipe = 0; this.tapPress = false; this.tapQuick = false; }
   188	};

     4	var World = {
     5	  segs: [],      // {x0,y0,x1,y1,k}  k: street|stair|ledge|rail|ramp|roof
     6	  obs: [],       // {x,y,w,h,k}      crash boxes (hydrant, ledge face, cone)
     7	  cars: [],      // {x,y,w,h,vx}     y = roof top
     8	  props: [],     // decorative {x,y,k}
     9	  gx: 0, gy: 0,
    10	  lastKind: '',
    11	  seedDist: 0,
    12	
    13	  reset: function () {
    14	    this.segs.length = 0; this.obs.length = 0; this.cars.length = 0; this.props.length = 0;
    15	    this.gx = -600; this.gy = 0; this.lastKind = '';
    16	    this.flat(1500);
    17	  },
    18	
    19	  seg: function (x0, y0, x1, y1, k) { this.segs.push({ x0: x0, y0: y0, x1: x1, y1: y1, k: k }); },
    20	
    21	  flat: function (len) {
    22	    this.seg(this.gx, this.gy, this.gx + len, this.gy, 'street');
    23	    this.gx += len;
    24	  },

    26	  /* ---- features ---- */
    27	  fStairs: function (d) {
    28	    var n = irnd(4, 5 + Math.round(d * 5)), sw = 30, sh = 15;
    29	    var x0 = this.gx, y0 = this.gy;
    30	    for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    31	      this.seg(this.gx, this.gy, this.gx + sw, this.gy, 'stair');
    32	      this.gx += sw; this.gy += sh;
    33	    }
    34	    // hand rail beside the set (grindable, sloped)
    35	    if (Math.random() < 0.75) {
    36	      this.seg(x0 - 16, y0 - 44, this.gx + 26, this.gy - 44, 'rail');
    37	    }

    39	  },
    40	  fGap: function (d) {
    41	    this.gx += rnd(70, 100 + d * 80);
    42	    this.flat(rnd(200, 330));
    43	  },
    44	  fRail: function (d) {

    46	    this.seg(x0, this.gy, x0 + len + 90, this.gy, 'street');
    47	    this.seg(x0, this.gy - 46, x0 + len, this.gy - 46, 'rail');
    48	    this.gx += len + 90;
    49	    this.flat(rnd(140, 220));
    50	  },
    51	  fLedge: function (d) {

    53	    this.seg(x0, this.gy, x0 + len + 70, this.gy, 'street');
    54	    this.seg(x0, this.gy - h, x0 + len, this.gy - h, 'ledge');

    56	    this.gx += len + 70;

    58	  },
    59	  fHydrant: function () {
    60	    this.seg(this.gx, this.gy, this.gx + 300, this.gy, 'street');

    62	    this.gx += 300;
    63	    this.flat(rnd(120, 200));
    64	  },
    65	  fCone: function () {
    66	    this.seg(this.gx, this.gy, this.gx + 260, this.gy, 'street');
    67	    var n = irnd(1, 3);
    68	    for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) this.obs.push({ x: this.gx + 90 + i * 40, y: this.gy - 22, w: 14, h: 22, k: 'cone' });
    69	    this.gx += 260;
    70	    this.flat(rnd(120, 190));
    71	  },
    72	  fCar: function (d) {
    73	    this.seg(this.gx, this.gy, this.gx + 420, this.gy, 'street');
    74	    var moving = Math.random() < 0.45;
    75	    this.cars.push({
    76	      x: this.gx + 150, y: this.gy - 52, w: 120, h: 52,
    77	      vx: moving ? -rnd(50, 110) : 0, hue: pick([8, 42, 190, 320, 265])
    78	    });
    79	    this.gx += 420;
    80	    this.flat(rnd(130, 200));
    81	  },
    82	  fRamp: function () {
    83	    var len = 130, rise = 42;
    84	    this.seg(this.gx, this.gy, this.gx + len, this.gy - rise, 'ramp');
    85	    this.gx += len; this.gy -= rise;
    86	    this.flat(rnd(180, 300));
    87	  },
    88	  fDrop: function () { // curb drop
    89	    this.gy += 26;
    90	    this.flat(rnd(220, 340));
    91	  },
    92	
    93	  gen: function (aheadX, dist) {
    94	    var d = clamp(dist / 3000, 0, 1);
    95	    var guard = 0;
    96	    while (this.gx < aheadX && guard++ < 40) {
    97	      // keep the street from wandering off the bottom of the world
    98	      if (this.gy > 520) { this.fRamp(); this.lastKind = 'ramp'; continue; }
    99	      if (this.gy < -260) { this.fDrop(); this.lastKind = 'drop'; continue; }
   100	
   101	      var bag = ['rail', 'ledge', 'stairs', 'gap', 'hydrant', 'car', 'cone', 'flat'];
   102	      if (d > 0.25) bag.push('rail', 'stairs', 'gap');
   103	      if (d > 0.5) bag.push('ledge', 'car', 'gap', 'stairs');
   104	      var k = pick(bag);
   105	      if (k === this.lastKind && Math.random() < 0.7) k = 'flat';
   106	      this.lastKind = k;
   107	      if (k === 'rail') this.fRail(d);
   108	      else if (k === 'ledge') this.fLedge(d);
   109	      else if (k === 'stairs') this.fStairs(d);
   110	      else if (k === 'gap') this.fGap(d);
   111	      else if (k === 'hydrant') this.fHydrant();
   112	      else if (k === 'cone') this.fCone();
   113	      else if (k === 'car') this.fCar(d);
   114	      else this.flat(rnd(200, 380));
   115	      if (Math.random() < 0.22) { this.props.push({ x: this.gx - rnd(40, 160), y: this.gy, k: pick(['hyd', 'post', 'trash']) }); }
   116	    }
   117	  },
   118	
   119	  prune: function (x) {
   120	    var i;
   121	    for (i = this.segs.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) if (this.segs[i].x1 < x) this.segs.splice(i, 1);
   122	    for (i = this.obs.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) if (this.obs[i].x + this.obs[i].w < x) this.obs.splice(i, 1);
   123	    for (i = this.cars.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) if (this.cars[i].x + this.cars[i].w < x) this.cars.splice(i, 1);
   124	    for (i = this.props.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) if (this.props[i].x < x) this.props.splice(i, 1);
   125	  },
   126	
   127	  update: function (dt) {
   128	    for (var i = 0; i < this.cars.length; i++) { var c = this.cars[i]; if (c.vx) c.x += c.vx * dt; }
   129	  },
   130	
   131	  segY: function (s, x) {
   132	    if (s.y0 === s.y1) return s.y0;
   133	    return s.y0 + (s.y1 - s.y0) * ((x - s.x0) / (s.x1 - s.x0));
   134	  },
   135	
   136	  // every walkable surface height at x -> array of {y, seg}
   137	  surfaces: function (x, out) {
   138	    out.length = 0;
   139	    for (var i = 0; i < this.segs.length; i++) {
   140	      var s = this.segs[i];
   141	      if (x >= s.x0 && x <= s.x1) out.push({ y: this.segY(s, x), s: s });
   142	    }
   143	    for (var j = 0; j < this.cars.length; j++) {
   144	      var c = this.cars[j];
   145	      if (x >= c.x + 6 && x <= c.x + c.w - 6) out.push({ y: c.y, s: { k: 'roof', x0: c.x, x1: c.x + c.w, car: c } });
   146	    }
   147	    return out;
   148	  }
   149	};

   260	      if (f.w > cur) { store.trophy[f.sp.id] = f.w; rec = true; }
   261	      if (score > best) { best = score; store.best = Math.round(score * 100) / 100; }
   262	      LL.save(store);
   263	      fish.splice(fish.indexOf(f), 1);
   264	      result = { sp: f.sp, w: f.w, rec: rec, kind: 'land' };
   265	      addParts(L.rod.x + 30, L.waterTop, 26, '#cfeaf6', 220, 90);
   266	      shake = 6; flash = 0.3; flashCol = '#bfe9c8';
   267	      if (rec) LL.sfx.record(); else LL.sfx.land();
   268	    } else {
   269	      result = { sp: f.sp, w: f.w, kind: kind };
   270	      f.interest = 0; f.cool = 6;
   271	      f.x = Math.min(L.xmax, f.x + 40);
   272	      addParts(f.x, f.y, 18, kind === 'snap' ? '#ff8b6b' : '#9fd8ea', 200, 0);
   273	      shake = kind === 'snap' ? 14 : 6;
   274	      flash = 0.4; flashCol = kind === 'snap' ? '#ff7a55' : '#8fd0e8';
   275	      if (kind === 'snap') LL.sfx.snap(); else LL.sfx.escape();
   276	    }
   277	    F = null; strikeFish = null;
   278	    setState('result');
   279	  }
   280	  function finishResult() {
   281	    result = null;
   282	    setState('aim');
   283	    lure.inWater = false;
   284	    if (fish.length === 0) say('Lake is fished out - tap NEXT LAKE');
   285	    else say('Flick up to cast');
   286	  }
   287	
   288	  /* ---------------- update ---------------- */
   289	  var lastDt = 0.016;
   290	  function update(dt) {
   291	    time += dt; stateT += dt;
   292	    if (msgT > 0) msgT -= dt;
   293	    if (shake > 0) shake = Math.max(0, shake - dt * 26);
   294	    if (flash > 0) flash = Math.max(0, flash - dt * 1.6);
   295	
   296	    for (var i = parts.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   297	      var p = parts[i]; p.t += dt;
   298	      p.x += p.vx * dt; p.y += p.vy * dt; p.vy += 420 * dt;
   299	      if (p.t > p.life) parts.splice(i, 1);
   300	    }
   301	    for (var j = ripples.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
   302	      var rp = ripples[j]; rp.t += dt; rp.r += 46 * dt;
   303	      if (rp.t > rp.life) ripples.splice(j, 1);
   304	    }
   305	
   306	    if (showLog) return;
   307	
   308	    // aim charge (keyboard)
   309	    if (state === 'aim') {
   310	      if (aim.holding && !aim.touched) {
   311	        aim.charge += aim.chargeDir * dt * 1.15;
   312	        if (aim.charge > 1) { aim.charge = 1; aim.chargeDir = -1; }
   313	        if (aim.charge < 0.30) { aim.charge = 0.30; aim.chargeDir = 1; }
   314	        aim.power = aim.charge;
   315	      }
   316	      var ang = 0;
   317	      if (keys['ArrowUp'] || keys['w'] || keys['W']) ang += 1;
   318	      if (keys['ArrowDown'] || keys['s'] || keys['S']) ang -= 1;
   319	      if (ang) aim.angle = Math.max(0.17, Math.min(1.40, aim.angle + ang * dt * 0.9));
   320	    }
   321	
   322	    if (state === 'cast') {
   323	      lure.vy += H * 2.4 * dt;
   324	      lure.x += lure.vx * dt; lure.y += lure.vy * dt;
   325	      if (lure.x > W - 6) { lure.x = W - 6; lure.vx *= -0.25; }
   326	      if (lure.y >= L.waterTop) {
   327	        lure.y = L.waterTop; lure.vy = 0; lure.vx = 0; lure.inWater = true;
   328	        addRipple(lure.x, L.waterTop, 5); addRipple(lure.x, L.waterTop, 14);
   329	        addParts(lure.x, L.waterTop, 12, '#cfeaf6', 140, 120);
   330	        LL.sfx.splash();
   331	        setState('water');
   332	        say('Drag to work the lure');
   333	      }
   334	    }
   335	
   336	    if (state === 'water') {
   337	      if (drag.active) drag.downT += dt;
   338	      // keyboard hold = slow steady drag
   339	      if (hold && !drag.active && (keys[' '] || keys['Enter'])) {
   340	        retrieve(46 * dt);
   341	        drag.speed = drag.speed * 0.85 + 60 * 0.15;
   342	        drag.moveT = 0.3;
   343	      }
   344	      drag.moveT -= dt;
   345	      if (drag.moveT <= 0) drag.speed *= Math.pow(0.02, dt);
   346	      var target = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, drag.speed / 480));
   347	      action += (target - action) * Math.min(1, dt * 7);
   348	      // sink
   349	      if (drag.moveT <= 0) {
   350	        lure.y += 34 * dt;
   351	        var maxd = bottomAt(lure.x) - 4;
   352	        if (lure.y > maxd) lure.y = maxd;
   353	      }
   354	    }
   355	
   356	    // fish behaviour
   357	    var lively = state === 'water' && drag.moveT > 0;
   358	    for (var k = 0; k < fish.length; k++) {
   359	      var f = fish[k];
   360	      f.phase += dt * (3 + f.spd * 0.08);
   361	      if (f.cool > 0) f.cool -= dt;
   362	      if (F && F.f === f) continue;
   363	      if (strikeFish === f) continue;
   364	      var chase = false;
   365	      if (state === 'water' && f.cool <= 0) {
   366	        var d = Math.hypot(f.x - lure.x, f.y - lure.y);
   367	        var match = 1 - Math.abs(action - f.sp.pref);
   368	        if (d < 130 && lively) {
   369	          f.interest += dt * ((match - 0.40) * 2.6 + 0.18);
   370	        } else {
   371	          f.interest -= dt * 0.5;
   372	        }
   373	        f.interest = Math.max(0, Math.min(1.2, f.interest));
   374	        if (f.interest > 0.22) {
   375	          chase = true;
   376	          var ang2 = Math.atan2(lure.y - f.y, lure.x - f.x);
   377	          var cs = 26 + f.interest * 70;
   378	          f.x += Math.cos(ang2) * cs * dt;
   379	          f.y += Math.sin(ang2) * cs * dt;
   380	          f.dir = (lure.x < f.x) ? -1 : 1;
   381	          if (f.interest >= 1 && d < 30 && !strikeFish) {
   382	            strikeFish = f; strikeT = 0; setState('strike');
   383	            shake = 5; flash = 0.28; flashCol = '#ffd76a';
   384	            addRipple(lure.x, lure.y, 6);
   385	            LL.sfx.strike();
   386	          }
   387	        }
   388	      } else if (f.interest > 0) f.interest = Math.max(0, f.interest - dt * 0.8);
   389	
   390	      if (!chase) {
   391	        f.x += f.dir * f.spd * dt;
   392	        f.y += Math.sin(time * 0.6 + f.phase) * 5 * dt;
   393	        if (f.x < f.xlo) { f.x = f.xlo; f.dir = 1; }
   394	        if (f.x > L.xmax) { f.x = L.xmax; f.dir = -1; }
   395	        if (f.y < f.homeLo) f.y += 18 * dt;
   396	        if (f.y > f.homeHi) f.y -= 18 * dt;
   397	      }
   398	    }
   399	
   400	    if (state === 'strike') {
   401	      strikeT += dt;
   402	      if (strikeT > 0.8) {
   403	        strikeFish.interest = 0; strikeFish.cool = 4; strikeFish = null;
   404	        setState('water'); say('Missed the take');
   405	      }
   406	    }
   407	
   408	    if (state === 'fight') updateFight(dt);
   409	  }
   410	
   411	  function updateFight(dt) {
   412	    F.t += dt;
   413	    var run = Math.max(0, Math.sin(F.t * 1.55 + F.ph)) * (0.45 + 0.55 * Math.max(0, Math.sin(F.t * 0.82 + F.ph2)));
   414	    var pull = F.power * (0.32 + 0.68 * F.stamina) * (0.62 + 0.95 * run);
   415	    F.pull = pull;
   416	    if (hold) {
   417	      F.tension += (0.30 + pull * 0.80) * dt;
   418	      F.progress += Math.max(0.03, 0.165 - 0.055 * pull) * dt;
   419	      if (Math.random() < dt * 14) LL.sfx.reel();
   420	    } else {
   421	      F.tension -= (0.88 + 0.22 * (1 - F.stamina)) * dt;
   422	      F.progress -= 0.055 * pull * dt;
   423	    }
   424	    F.tension = Math.max(0, Math.min(1.15, F.tension));
   425	    F.progress = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, F.progress));
   426	    F.stamina -= dt * (hold ? 0.085 + 0.075 * F.tension : 0.022) / (0.55 + F.f.w * 0.055);
   427	    F.stamina = Math.max(0, F.stamina);
   428	    F.thrash = run;
   429	
   430	    if (F.tension >= 1) { F.snapT += dt; if (F.snapT > 0.80) { endFight('snap'); return; } }
   431	    else F.snapT = Math.max(0, F.snapT - dt * 1.5);
   432	    if (F.tension <= 0.035) { F.slackT += dt; if (F.slackT > 1.7) { endFight('escape'); return; } }
   433	    else F.slackT = Math.max(0, F.slackT - dt * 1.2);
   434	    if (F.progress >= 1) { endFight('land'); return; }
   435	    if (F.tension > 0.86 && Math.random() < dt * 30) addParts(fightFishPos().x, fightFishPos().y, 1, '#ff9a72', 60, 0);
   436	  }
   437	
   438	  function fightFishPos() {
   439	    var p = F.progress;
   440	    var tx = L.rod.x + 26, ty = L.waterTop + 16;
   441	    var x = F.hx + (tx - F.hx) * p;
   442	    var y = F.hy + (ty - F.hy) * p;
   443	    var sw = (1 - p) * 26 * F.thrash;
   444	    x += Math.sin(F.t * 6.1) * sw;
   445	    y += Math.cos(F.t * 4.3) * sw * 0.6;
   446	    return { x: x, y: Math.max(L.waterTop + 8, Math.min(bottomAt(x) - 6, y)) };
   447	  }
   448	
   449	  function bottomAt(x) {
   450	    var t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (x - W * 0.1) / (W * 0.9)));
   451	    return L.waterTop + L.depth * (0.34 + 0.66 * Math.min(1, t * 2.2));
   452	  }

   455	  function drawBg() {
   456	    var g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, L.waterTop);
   457	    g.addColorStop(0, lake.weather.sky[0]);
   458	    g.addColorStop(1, lake.weather.sky[1]);
   459	    ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, L.waterTop + 1);
   460	
   461	    // far hills
   462	    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(30,52,60,0.45)';
   463	    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, L.waterTop);
   464	    var hr = LL.rng(lake.seed * 7919 + 3);
   465	    var n = 7, hx = 0;
   466	    ctx.lineTo(0, L.waterTop - 20);
   467	    for (var i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
   468	      hx = (W * i) / n;
   469	      ctx.lineTo(hx, L.waterTop - 18 - hr() * H * 0.075);
   470	    }
   471	    ctx.lineTo(W, L.waterTop); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
   472	
   473	    // water
   474	    var wg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, L.waterTop, 0, L.bottom + 10);
   475	    wg.addColorStop(0, lake.weather.water[0]);
   476	    wg.addColorStop(1, lake.weather.water[1]);
   477	    ctx.fillStyle = wg; ctx.fillRect(0, L.waterTop, W, H - L.waterTop);
   478	
   479	    // depth bands
   480	    var labels = ['SHALLOW', 'MID', 'DEEP'];
   481	    for (var b = 0; b < 3; b++) {
   482	      var y0 = L.waterTop + L.depth * (b === 0 ? 0 : b === 1 ? 0.33 : 0.65);
   483	      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.10)';
   484	      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
   485	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, y0); ctx.lineTo(W, y0); ctx.stroke();
   486	      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.22)';
   487	      ctx.font = '600 9px system-ui,sans-serif';
   488	      ctx.textAlign = 'left';
   489	      ctx.fillText(labels[b], 5, y0 + 11);
   490	    }
   491	
   492	    // lake bed
   493	    ctx.fillStyle = '#123040';
   494	    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, H);
   495	    ctx.lineTo(0, bottomAt(0));
   496	    for (var x = 0; x <= W; x += 12) ctx.lineTo(x, bottomAt(x) + Math.sin(x * 0.05 + lake.seed) * 3);
   497	    ctx.lineTo(W, H); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
   498	
   499	    // weeds
   500	    var wr = LL.rng(lake.seed * 104729 + 11);
   501	    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(60,120,80,0.5)'; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
   502	    for (var k = 0; k < 14; k++) {
   503	      var wx = W * 0.2 + wr() * W * 0.78;
   504	      var by = bottomAt(wx);
   505	      var hgt = 14 + wr() * 42;
   506	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(wx, by);
   507	      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(wx + Math.sin(time * 0.8 + k) * 7, by - hgt * 0.6, wx + Math.sin(time * 0.8 + k) * 11, by - hgt);
   508	      ctx.stroke();
   509	    }
   510	
   511	    // surface line + ripples
   512	    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.55)'; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
   513	    ctx.beginPath();
   514	    for (var sx = 0; sx <= W; sx += 8) {
   515	      var sy = L.waterTop + Math.sin(sx * 0.06 + time * 1.6) * 1.8;
   516	      if (sx === 0) ctx.moveTo(sx, sy); else ctx.lineTo(sx, sy);
   517	    }
   518	    ctx.stroke();
   519	    ripples.forEach(function (r) {
   520	      ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, 1 - r.t / r.life) * 0.6;
   521	      ctx.strokeStyle = '#dff4ff'; ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
   522	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(r.x, r.y, r.r, r.r * 0.3, 0, 0, 6.283); ctx.stroke();
   523	      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   524	    });
   525	  }

   528	    var ax = L.anglerX, base = L.waterTop;
   529	    // dock
   530	    ctx.fillStyle = '#4a3a2c';

   537	    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(ax, base - 62, 9, 0, 6.283); ctx.fill();
   538	    ctx.fillRect(ax - 8, base - 54, 16, 30);
   539	    ctx.fillRect(ax - 7, base - 26, 6, 18);
   540	    ctx.fillRect(ax + 1, base - 26, 6, 18);
   541	    // rod

   550	    L.tipY = L.rod.y + bend;

   553	  function drawLine(tx, ty, tension) {
   554	    var sag = (1 - Math.min(1, tension)) * 26 + 4;
   555	    ctx.strokeStyle = tension > 0.86 ? 'rgba(255,150,120,0.95)' : 'rgba(240,250,255,0.75)';

   557	    ctx.beginPath();
   558	    ctx.moveTo(L.rod.x, L.tipY);
   559	    ctx.quadraticCurveTo((L.rod.x + tx) * 0.5, (L.tipY + ty) * 0.5 + sag, tx, ty);
   560	    ctx.stroke();
   561	  }

   576	  function drawPreview() {
   577	    var v = aim.power * Math.sqrt(W * H * 2.4);
   578	    var x = L.rod.x, y = L.tipY || L.rod.y;
   579	    var vx = Math.cos(aim.angle) * v, vy = -Math.sin(aim.angle) * v;
   580	    var dt = 0.028;
   581	    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.75)';
   582	    for (var i = 0; i < 70; i++) {
   583	      vy += H * 2.4 * dt; x += vx * dt; y += vy * dt;
   584	      if (y >= L.waterTop) {
   585	        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,225,120,0.95)';
   586	        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, L.waterTop, 5, 0, 6.283); ctx.fill();
   587	        break;
   588	      }
   589	      if (x > W) break;
   590	      if (i % 3 === 0) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, 2.1, 0, 6.283); ctx.fill(); }
   591	    }
   592	    // power meter
   593	    var pw = 120, px = W * 0.5 - pw / 2, py = H - 92;
   594	    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.35)'; roundRect(px - 2, py - 2, pw + 4, 12, 5); ctx.fill();
   595	    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd24a'; roundRect(px, py, pw * aim.power, 8, 4); ctx.fill();
   596	  }

   598	  function drawFishes() {
   599	    for (var i = 0; i < fish.length; i++) {
   600	      var f = fish[i];
   601	      if (F && F.f === f) continue;
   602	      var dep = (f.y - L.waterTop) / L.depth;
   603	      var alpha = 0.95 - dep * 0.30;
   604	      LL.drawFish(ctx, f.sp, f.x, f.y, f.len, f.dir, f.phase, alpha, false);
   605	      if (f.interest > 0.3 && state === 'water') {
   606	        ctx.globalAlpha = Math.min(1, f.interest);
   607	        ctx.fillStyle = f.interest > 0.8 ? '#ffdc5e' : '#ffffff';
   608	        ctx.font = 'bold 15px system-ui,sans-serif'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
   609	        ctx.fillText(f.interest > 0.8 ? '!' : '?', f.x, f.y - f.len * 0.45 - 6);
   610	        ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   611	      }
   612	    }
   613	  }

   615	  function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r) {
   616	    ctx.beginPath();
   617	    ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
   618	    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
   619	    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
   620	    ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
   621	    ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
   622	    ctx.closePath();
   623	  }

   664	  function hintFor() {
   665	    if (state === 'aim') return 'Flick UP to cast (hold to aim)';
   666	    if (state === 'cast') return '...';

   812	  var prev = 0;
   813	  function frame(ts) {
   814	    if (!prev) prev = ts;
   815	    var dt = (ts - prev) / 1000;
   816	    prev = ts;
   817	    if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;
   818	    if (dt < 0) dt = 0;
   819	    lastDt = Math.max(0.008, dt);
   820	    update(dt);
   821	    render();
   822	    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
   823	  }

   139	  const TOUCH_BUTTONS = ['a', 'b', 'start', 'select', 'cont', 'mute'];
   140	  function setupTouch() {
   141	    const zoneEl = el('stick-zone'), stickEl = el('stick'), knobEl = el('knob');
   142	    const btnEl = {
   143	      a: el('btn-a'), b: el('btn-b'), start: el('btn-start'),
   144	      select: el('btn-select'), cont: el('btn-c'), mute: el('btn-m')
   145	    };
   146	    const owners = {};              // pointerId -> {own, x, y, ox, oy}
   147	    const RADIUS = 54;              // px from origin for a full deflection
   148	    const DEAD = 14;                // px dead zone
   149	
   150	    const opts = { passive: false };
   151	    window.addEventListener('pointerdown', down, opts);
   152	    window.addEventListener('pointermove', moved, opts);
   153	    window.addEventListener('pointerup', up, opts);
   154	    window.addEventListener('pointercancel', up, opts);
   155	    // Belt and braces: some in-app browsers still emit only touch events.
   156	    window.addEventListener('touchmove', e => {
   157	      if (Object.keys(owners).length) e.preventDefault();
   158	    }, opts);
   159	
   160	    function visible(e) { return !!visRect(e); }
   161	    function inEl(p, e) {
   162	      const r = visRect(e); if (!r) return false;
   163	      return p.x >= r.left && p.x <= r.right && p.y >= r.top && p.y <= r.bottom;
   164	    }
   165	    function ownerAt(p) {
   166	      for (const name of TOUCH_BUTTONS) if (inEl(p, btnEl[name])) return name;
   167	      if (inEl(p, zoneEl)) return 'stick';
   168	      return null;
   169	    }
   170	    function down(e) {
   171	      unlockAudio();
   172	      const p = { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY };
   173	      const own = ownerAt(p);
   174	      if (!own) return;
   175	      owners[e.pointerId] = { own: own, x: p.x, y: p.y, ox: p.x, oy: p.y };
   176	      if (own === 'stick' && stickEl) {
   177	        stickEl.style.left = p.x + 'px';
   178	        stickEl.style.top = p.y + 'px';
   179	        setActive2(stickEl, true); setActive2(knobEl, true);
   180	      }
   181	      if (e.cancelable) e.preventDefault();
   182	      apply();
   183	    }
   184	    function moved(e) {
   185	      const o = owners[e.pointerId];
   186	      if (!o) return;
   187	      o.x = e.clientX; o.y = e.clientY;
   188	      if (e.cancelable) e.preventDefault();
   189	      apply();
   190	    }
   191	    function up(e) {
   192	      const o = owners[e.pointerId];
   193	      if (!o) return;
   194	      delete owners[e.pointerId];
   195	      if (o.own === 'stick') { setActive2(stickEl, false); setActive2(knobEl, false); }
   196	      apply();
   197	    }
   198	    function setActive(e, on) { if (e && e.classList) e.classList.toggle('active', !!on); }
   199	    function setActive2(e, on) { if (e && e.classList) e.classList.toggle('on', !!on); }
   200	
   201	    const last = {};
   202	    const lastDir = { up:false, down:false, left:false, right:false };
   203	    function apply() {
   204	      let up_ = false, dn = false, lt = false, rt = false;
   205	      const held = {};
   206	      for (const id in owners) {
   207	        const o = owners[id];
   208	        if (o.own === 'stick') {
   209	          let dx = o.x - o.ox, dy = o.y - o.oy;
   210	          const len = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
   211	          if (len > DEAD) {
   212	            // 4-way: the dominant axis wins, matching the hero's movement model.
   213	            if (Math.abs(dx) > Math.abs(dy)) { if (dx < 0) lt = true; else rt = true; }
   214	            else { if (dy < 0) up_ = true; else dn = true; }
   215	          }
   216	          if (knobEl && knobEl.style) {
   217	            const k = len > RADIUS ? RADIUS / len : 1;
   218	            const half = (stickEl && stickEl.offsetWidth) ? stickEl.offsetWidth / 2 : 66;
   219	            knobEl.style.left = (half + dx * k) + 'px';
   220	            knobEl.style.top = (half + dy * k) + 'px';
   221	          }
   222	        } else held[o.own] = true;
   223	      }
   224	      const dirs = { up: up_, down: dn, left: lt, right: rt };
   225	      for (const d in dirs) {
   226	        // Edge presses too: menus (the pack screen) read pressed, not held.
   227	        if (dirs[d] && !lastDir[d]) pressed[d] = true;
   228	        lastDir[d] = dirs[d];
   229	        keys[d] = dirs[d];
   230	      }
   231	      for (const name of TOUCH_BUTTONS) {
   232	        const on = !!held[name];
   233	        if (on && !last[name]) pressed[name] = true;   // edge press for one frame
   234	        last[name] = on;
   235	        keys[name] = on;
   236	        setActive(btnEl[name], on);
   237	      }
   238	      if (up_ || dn || lt || rt) hideTip();
   239	    }
   240	  }
   241	  let tipHidden = false;
   242	  function hideTip() {
   243	    if (tipHidden) return;
   244	    tipHidden = true;
   245	    const t = el('tip');
   246	    if (t && t.classList) setTimeout(() => t.classList.add('gone'), 1500);
   247	  }
   248	  window.addEventListener('keydown', hideTip);
   249	  setupTouch();
   250	
   251	  function clearPressed() { for (const k in pressed) pressed[k] = false; }
   252	
   253	  // ---- loop (fixed 60Hz logic) ----
   254	  // nowMs(): high-res clock when available, else Date.now(). Some headless/test
   255	  // environments don't expose `performance`, and depending on it hard-crashed boot.
   256	  const nowMs = (typeof performance !== 'undefined' && performance.now)
   257	    ? () => performance.now() : () => Date.now();
   258	  let updateFn = () => {}, renderFn = () => {};
   259	  let acc = 0, last = 0;
   260	  const STEP = 1000 / 60;
   261	  let _useRAF = true;
   262	  function tick() { frame(nowMs()); }
   263	  function frame(now) {
   264	    try {
   265	      if (!last) last = now;
   266	      acc += now - last;
   267	      last = now;
   268	      if (acc > 250) acc = 250;     // avoid spiral after tab-out
   269	      let steps = 0;
   270	      while (acc >= STEP && steps < 5) {
   271	        updateFn();
   272	        clearPressed();
   273	        acc -= STEP; steps++;
   274	      }
   275	      renderFn(ctx);
   276	    } catch(e) {
   277	      var _d = (typeof document !== 'undefined' && document.getElementById) ? document.getElementById('dbg') : null;
   278	      if (_d) { _d.style.display='block'; _d.textContent='frame-err:' + (e&&e.message?e.message:String(e)); }
   279	      ctx.fillStyle = '#000'; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, SCREEN_W, SCREEN_H);
   280	      ctx.fillStyle = '#f44'; ctx.font = '8px monospace'; ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
   281	      ctx.fillText('ERR:', 4, 4);
   282	      ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
   283	      var msg = (e && e.message ? e.message : String(e)) + ' L' + (e && e.stack ? e.stack.split('\n')[1] : '');
   284	      var words = msg.split(' '), line = '', y = 16;
   285	      for (var i = 0; i < words.length; i++) {
   286	        if ((line + ' ' + words[i]).length > 28) { ctx.fillText(line.trim(), 4, y); y += 10; line = words[i]; }
   287	        else line += ' ' + words[i];
   288	      }
   289	      if (line.trim()) ctx.fillText(line.trim(), 4, y);
   290	      return; // stop the loop
   291	    }
   292	    if (_useRAF) requestAnimationFrame(frame); else setTimeout(tick, 16);
   293	  }
   294	  function run(update, render) {
   295	    updateFn = update; renderFn = render;
   296	    // Draw gold immediately to test if ctx works at all (sync, no rAF needed)
   297	    ctx.fillStyle = '#f8d030';
   298	    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, SCREEN_W, SCREEN_H);
   299	    ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
   300	    ctx.font = '10px monospace';
   301	    ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
   302	    ctx.fillText('STARTING...', 4, 4);
   303	    // Also run one frame synchronously
   304	    frame(nowMs());
   305	    // frame() owns the single recurring scheduler chain.
   306	  }
   307	
   308	  // ---- tiny deterministic-ish RNG ----
   309	  let seed = 0x2545f491;
   310	  function rand() {
   311	    seed ^= seed << 13; seed ^= seed >>> 17; seed ^= seed << 5;
   312	    return ((seed >>> 0) / 4294967296);
   313	  }
   314	  const randInt = (a, b) => a + Math.floor(rand() * (b - a + 1));
   315	  const choice = arr => arr[Math.floor(rand() * arr.length)];
   316	
   317	  // ---- draw helpers ----
   318	  function rect(ctx, x, y, w, h, col) { ctx.fillStyle = col; ctx.fillRect(x|0, y|0, w|0, h|0); }
   319	  function text(ctx, str, x, y, col='#fff', scale=1) {
   320	    Font.draw(ctx, str, x, y, col, scale);
   321	  }
   322	
   323	  return { canvas, ctx, keys, pressed, run, rand, randInt, choice, rect, text,
   324	           clearPressed,
   325	           TILE, SCREEN_W, SCREEN_H, HUD_H, PLAY_W, PLAY_H, COLS, ROWS };
   326	})();

    59	  // ---------- helpers ----------
    60	  function key3(prefix, c, r) { return prefix + ':' + c + ',' + r; }
    61	
    62	  const screenPool = [];
    63	  const DUNGEON_SCREEN_LEVELS = {};
    64	  for (const k in World.CFG) if (World.CFG[k].dungeon) DUNGEON_SCREEN_LEVELS[k] = World.CFG[k].dungeon.level;
    65	  function bakeScreen(grid, theme) {
    66	    let c = state.screenImg;
    67	    if (!c || state._bakeNext) {
    68	      let index = c ? screenPool.indexOf(c) : -1;
    69	      if (index < 0) index = screenPool.length;
    70	      if (state._bakeNext) index = (index + 1) % 3;
    71	      c = screenPool[index] || (screenPool[index] = document.createElement('canvas'));
    72	    }
    73	    c.width = PLAY_W; c.height = PLAY_H;
    74	    const x = c.getContext('2d');
    75	    x.fillStyle = '#000'; x.fillRect(0, 0, PLAY_W, PLAY_H);
    76	    const tileTheme = Tiles.levelTheme(theme, state.mode === 'dungeon' && state.level ? state.level.id : 0);
    77	    for (let r = 0; r < ROWS; r++) {
    78	      for (let col = 0; col < COLS; col++) {
    79	        const ch = grid[r][col];
    80	        Tiles.blit(x, tileTheme, ch, col * 16, r * 16);
    81	      }
    82	    }
    83	    return c;
    84	  }
    85	
    86	  function solidFor(entity, px, py) {
    87	    const c = Math.floor(px / 16), r = Math.floor(py / 16);
    88	    if (c < 0 || c > 15 || r < 0 || r > 10) return false;   // off-edge = walk-through (triggers transition)
    89	    const ch = state.grid[r][c];
    90	    if (entity && entity.kind === 'enemy' && ['keese', 'tektite', 'peahat'].includes(entity.etype)) return false;
    91	    if (entity && entity.kind === 'link' && ch === 'W' && entity.hasStepladder) {
    92	      const d = E.DIRS[entity.dir] || [0, 0];
    93	      const bc = c + d[0], br = r + d[1];
    94	      // The ladder is a one-tile bridge: the tile immediately beyond the
    95	      // water must be ordinary walkable ground, never a second W.
    96	      if (bc >= 0 && bc < COLS && br >= 0 && br < ROWS) {
    97	        const beyond = state.grid[br][bc];
    98	        if (beyond !== 'W' && !Tiles.isSolid(beyond)) return false;
    99	      }
   100	    }
   101	    return Tiles.isSolid(ch);
   102	  }
   103	  function solidAt(px, py, entity) { return solidFor(entity || state.link, px, py); }
   104	
   105	  function tileAtPx(px, py) {
   106	    const c = Math.floor(px / 16), r = Math.floor(py / 16);
   107	    if (c < 0 || c > 15 || r < 0 || r > 10) return null;
   108	    return { c, r, ch: state.grid[r][c] };
   109	  }

   450	    hintCracks: {dialog:['WALLS WITH CRACKS HIDE PATHS.']},

   466	  function caveScreenKey() {

   480	  function spawnShop(def) {

   492	  // All cave behavior is data-driven through CAVES and the enterCave function below.
   493	  function enterCave(kind, tile) {
   494	    clearHoist();
   495	    Sound.pauseMusic();
   496	    Sound.stinger('cave');
   497	    const def = CAVES[kind] || CAVES.money;
   498	    const exitPos = tile ? freeBelow(tile.c, tile.r + 1) : [state.link.x, PLAY_H - 28];
   499	    state.cave = { kind, def, ret:{ col:state.col, row:state.row, pos:exitPos } };
   500	    const g = [];

   503	      for (let c = 0; c < COLS; c++) {

   505	        if (r === 10 && (c === 7 || c === 8)) ch = 'F';
   506	        row += ch;
   507	      }

   520	      if (!state.taken.has(caveUnique('fairy'))) spawnCaveItem('fairy', 11, {unique:caveUnique('fairy')});
   521	      showMsg('THE POND DRAINS. A WISP WAITS BELOW.', 220);

   524	      showMsg('THE OLD ROAD RUNS BENEATH AURELAY.', 180);

   531	    } else if (def.special === 'gamble') {

   534	      else {
   535	        showMsg(def.greet, 99999);
   536	        for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) spawnCaveItem('gamble', [4,7,10][i], {gambleIndex:i});
   537	      }
   538	    } else if (def.gate && !def.gate(state.link)) {
   539	      showDialog({pages:[def.gateText || 'COME BACK LATER.']});
   540	    } else if (def.wares) {
   760	    const position = data.world && data.world.position ? data.world.position :
   761	      (data.position || { col: World.findStart().col, row: World.findStart().row, x: 7 * 16, y: 8 * 16 });
   762	    if (data.v !== 2 || !isRecord(data.quest) ||
   763	        !['collecting','level9Open','ganonDefeated','rescued'].includes(data.quest.phase) ||
   764	        !finite(data.quest.triforces) || !isRecord(data.world) || !isRecord(data.link) ||
   765	        !validateLinkSave(data.link) || !validPosition(position) ||
   766	        !stringArray(data.world.taken, false) || !stringArray(data.world.revealed, false) ||
   767	        !stringArray(data.world.visitedScreens, false) || !stringArray(data.world.visitedRooms, false) ||
   768	        !isRecord(data.world.edges) || !isRecord(data.world.stock) || !isRecord(data.world.counters)) return null;
   769	    for (const k in data.world.edges) if (!['open','locked','shut','shutter'].includes(data.world.edges[k])) return null;
   770	    return {

   778	      visitedScreens: data.world.visitedScreens,

   780	      stock: data.world.stock,

   782	      triforces: Math.max(0, Math.min(TRIFORCE_PIECES, Math.round(data.quest.triforces))),
   783	    };

   785	  function loadGame() {
   786	    const save = readSave();
   787	    if (!save) { startGame(); return false; }
   788	    startGame();   // fresh baseline, then overlay the save
   789	    const l = state.link;

   164	    function fitViewport() {
   165	      const vw = Math.max(1, window.innerWidth);
   166	      const vh = Math.max(1, window.innerHeight);
   167	      const aspect = 256 / 224;
   168	      let width = vw;
   169	      let height = width / aspect;
   170	      if (height > vh) {
   171	        height = vh;
   172	        width = height * aspect;
   173	      }
   174	      canvas.style.width = `${Math.floor(width)}px`;
   175	      canvas.style.height = `${Math.floor(height)}px`;
   176	      document.body.classList.toggle('portrait', vw < vh);
   177	    }
   178	
   179	    fitViewport();
   180	    window.addEventListener('resize', fitViewport, { passive: true });
   181	    window.addEventListener('orientationchange', fitViewport, { passive: true });
   182	    container.addEventListener('touchmove', (event) => event.preventDefault(), { passive: false });
   183	    container.addEventListener('gesturestart', (event) => event.preventDefault(), { passive: false });

     1	// Keyboard and pointer input. Pointer events cover both touch and mouse,
     2	// while each control keeps its own pointer so multi-touch remains independent.
     3	
     4	export class Input {
     5	  constructor() {
     6	    this.keys = {};
     7	    this.prev = {};
     8	    this._pressedPulses = new Set();
     9	    this._cleanups = [];
    10	    this._stickPointer = null;
    11	    this._onDown = this._onDown.bind(this);
    12	    this._onUp = this._onUp.bind(this);
    13	    window.addEventListener('keydown', this._onDown);
    14	    window.addEventListener('keyup', this._onUp);
    15	  }
    16	
    17	  _onDown(e) {
    18	    this.keys[e.code] = true;
    19	    if (['ArrowUp', 'ArrowDown', 'ArrowLeft', 'ArrowRight', 'Space'].includes(e.code)) {
    20	      e.preventDefault();
    21	    }
    22	  }
    23	
    24	  _onUp(e) {
    25	    this.keys[e.code] = false;
    26	  }
    27	
    28	  // Called after the first simulation step that can consume a press edge.
    29	  consumePressed() {
    30	    this._pressedPulses.clear();
    31	  }
    32	
    33	  // Is key currently held?
    34	  held(code) { return !!this.keys[code]; }
    35	
    36	  // Just pressed this frame, including a very quick pointer tap.
    37	  pressed(code) {
    38	    return (!!this.keys[code] && !this.prev[code]) || this._pressedPulses.has(code);
    39	  }
    40	
    41	  released(code) { return !this.keys[code] && !!this.prev[code]; }
    42	
    43	  // D-pad / virtual stick
    44	  get left()  { return this.held('ArrowLeft') || this.held('KeyA') || this.held('TouchLeft'); }
    45	  get right() { return this.held('ArrowRight') || this.held('KeyD') || this.held('TouchRight'); }
    46	  get up()    { return this.held('ArrowUp') || this.held('KeyW') || this.held('TouchUp'); }
    47	  get down()  { return this.held('ArrowDown') || this.held('KeyS') || this.held('TouchDown'); }
    48	
    49	  // A button = jump (Z / Space / left virtual button)
    50	  get A()      { return this.held('KeyZ') || this.held('Space') || this.held('TouchJump'); }
    51	  get pressA() { return this.pressed('KeyZ') || this.pressed('Space') || this.pressed('TouchJump'); }
    52	
    53	  // B button = attack (X / Enter / right virtual button)
    54	  get B()      { return this.held('KeyX') || this.held('Enter') || this.held('TouchAttack'); }
    55	  get pressB() { return this.pressed('KeyX') || this.pressed('Enter') || this.pressed('TouchAttack'); }
    56	
    57	  // Start = pause/rune select
    58	  get start() { return this.pressed('Escape') || this.pressed('KeyP') || this.pressed('TouchMenu'); }
    59	  get select() { return this.pressed('Tab') || this.pressed('KeyQ'); }
    60	
    61	  attachTouchControls({ stick, knob, jump, attack, menu }) {
    62	    if (!stick) return;
    63	
    64	    const button = (element, code) => {
    65	      if (!element) return;
    66	      const pointers = new Set();
    67	      const down = (e) => {
    68	        e.preventDefault();
    69	        pointers.add(e.pointerId);
    70	        this.keys[code] = true;
    71	        this._pressedPulses.add(code);
    72	        element.classList.add('active');
    73	        if (element.setPointerCapture) element.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
    74	      };
    75	      const up = (e) => {
    76	        e.preventDefault();
    77	        pointers.delete(e.pointerId);
    78	        if (pointers.size === 0) {
    79	          this.keys[code] = false;
    80	          element.classList.remove('active');
    81	        }
    82	      };
    83	      element.addEventListener('pointerdown', down, { passive: false });
    84	      element.addEventListener('pointerup', up, { passive: false });
    85	      element.addEventListener('pointercancel', up, { passive: false });
    86	      element.addEventListener('lostpointercapture', up, { passive: false });
    87	      this._cleanups.push(() => {
    88	        element.removeEventListener('pointerdown', down);
    89	        element.removeEventListener('pointerup', up);
    90	        element.removeEventListener('pointercancel', up);
    91	        element.removeEventListener('lostpointercapture', up);
    92	      });
    93	    };
    94	
    95	    const stickMove = (e) => {
    96	      if (this._stickPointer !== e.pointerId) return;
    97	      e.preventDefault();
    98	      const rect = stick.getBoundingClientRect();
    99	      const cx = rect.left + rect.width / 2;
   100	      const cy = rect.top + rect.height / 2;
   101	      const max = rect.width * 0.34;
   102	      const dx = e.clientX - cx;
   103	      const dy = e.clientY - cy;
   104	      const distance = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
   105	      const scale = Math.min(1, max / distance);
   106	      const knobX = dx * scale;
   107	      const knobY = dy * scale;
   108	      if (knob) knob.style.transform = `translate(calc(-50% + ${knobX}px), calc(-50% + ${knobY}px))`;
   109	      const dead = Math.max(8, rect.width * 0.12);
   110	      this.keys.TouchLeft = dx < -dead;
   111	      this.keys.TouchRight = dx > dead;
   112	      this.keys.TouchUp = dy < -dead;
   113	      this.keys.TouchDown = dy > dead;
   114	    };
   115	    const stickDown = (e) => {
   116	      e.preventDefault();

    82	  // Runs zero or more fixed 1/60s sim steps for the elapsed real time,
    83	  // then draws once. See module header for the accumulator contract.
    84	  _loop(ts) {
    85	    if (this._lastTs === null) this._lastTs = ts;
    86	    let dtMs = ts - this._lastTs;
    87	    this._lastTs = ts;
    88	    if (dtMs > FRAME_CLAMP_MS) dtMs = FRAME_CLAMP_MS; // clamp a big stall
    89	    if (dtMs < 0) dtMs = 0; // guard against a non-monotonic ts source
    90	
    91	    this._accumulatorMs += dtMs;
    92	
    93	    let steps = 0;
    94	    while (this._accumulatorMs >= STEP_MS && steps < MAX_STEPS_PER_FRAME) {
    95	      this._update();
    96	      this._traceStep();
    97	      // Input edges (pressed()) are consumed by the FIRST sim step that
    98	      // runs after the frame's input was latched. Snapshotting `prev`
    99	      // here, after that first step, means any further sim steps this
   100	      // same frame see those edges as already consumed (pressed() is
   101	      // false), while held state (left/right/up/down/A/B — read straight
   102	      // off `keys`) is unaffected and persists across all of them.
   103	      if (steps === 0) {
   104	        this.input.prev = { ...this.input.keys };
   105	        this.input.consumePressed();
   106	      }
   107	      this._accumulatorMs -= STEP_MS;
   108	      steps++;
   109	    }
   110	    // Remainder time (including any left over after hitting the 5-step
   111	    // cap during a catch-up spiral) intentionally carries into next frame
   112	    // rather than being discarded — no time is invented or dropped.
   113	
   114	    this._draw();
   115	    this.frame++;

   228	          this.state = STATE.OVERWORLD;
   229	          break;
   230	        }
   231	
   232	        // Check palace clear (all enemies dead + crystal collected)
   233	        if (this.sideview.isPalace && !this.palaceClearTimer) {
   234	          const bossRoom = this.sideview.room?.type === 'palace_boss';
   235	          const crystalGone = this.sideview.items.every(i => i.type !== 'crystal' || i.collected);
   236	          if (bossRoom && crystalGone && this.sideview.enemies.every(e => !e.alive)) {
   237	            this.palaceClearTimer = 120;
   238	          }
   239	        }
   240	        if (this.palaceClearTimer > 0) {
   241	          this.palaceClearTimer--;
   242	          if (this.palaceClearTimer === 0) {
   243	            this.palaceClearTimer = null;
   244	            // R3 repair: the final boss's death used to fall through to
   245	            // the same keep-clear return path as every other
   246	            // palace, so STATE.WIN (defined, drawn — see hud.js drawWin,
   247	            // constants.js STATE.WIN) was never entered by any code path
   248	            // (see reviews/sol_port_spec_review_2026-07-18.md "WIN state
   249	            // never entered"). Repaired: the final palace's clear enters
   250	            // STATE.WIN instead.
   251	            if (this.sideview.isFinalPalace) {
   252	              this.state = STATE.WIN;
   253	              this.winTimer = 0;
   254	            } else {
   255	              this.state = STATE.OVERWORLD;
   256	              this.overworld.showNotification('KEEP CLEARED!');
   257	            }
   258	          }
   259	        }
   260	
   261	        // Level up check
   262	        if (this.sideview.levelUpPending) {
   263	          this.sideview.levelUpPending = false;
   264	          this.levelUpScreen = true;
   265	          this.levelUpSelection = 0;
   266	        }
   267	
   268	        if (inp.start) this.paused = true;
   269	        break;
   270	      }
   271	
   272	      case STATE.TOWN:
   273	        if (this.paused) {
   274	          this._updateSpellMenu();
   275	          return;
   276	        }
   277	        this.town.update(inp);
   278	        if (this.town.done) {
   279	          this.state = STATE.OVERWORLD;
   280	        }
   281	        if (inp.start) this.paused = true;
   282	        break;
   283	
   284	      case STATE.GAMEOVER:
   285	        this.gameOverTimer++;
   286	        if (this.gameOverTimer > 0 && (inp.start || inp.pressed('Enter') || inp.pressA || inp.pressB)) {
   287	          if (this.player.lives < 0) {
   288	            // Full reset
   289	            this.player.reset();
   290	          } else {
   291	            // Continue - restore 3 hearts
   292	            this.player.hp = this.player.maxHp;
   293	            this.player.mp = this.player.maxMp;
   294	            this.player.state = 'stand';
   295	            this.player.owX = 8;
   296	            this.player.owY = 1; // Road near North Palace
   297	          }
   298	          this.state = STATE.OVERWORLD;
   299	          this.overworld.showNotification('EMBER KEEP');
   300	          this.gameOverTimer = 0;
   301	        }
   302	        break;
   303	
   304	      case STATE.WIN:
   305	        this.winTimer++;
   306	        if (this.winTimer > 0 && (inp.start || inp.pressed('Enter') || inp.pressA || inp.pressB)) {
   307	          this.player.reset();
   308	          this.state = STATE.OVERWORLD;
   309	          this.overworld.showNotification('EMBER KEEP');
   310	          this.winTimer = 0;
   311	        }
   312	        break;
   313	    }
   314	  }
   315	
   316	  _updateSpellMenu() {
   317	    const inp = this.input;
   318	    const spellList = ['SHIELD','JUMP','LIFE','FAIRY','FIRE','REFLECT','SPELL','THUNDER'];
   319	
   320	    if (!this.player.selectedSpell) this.player.selectedSpell = spellList[0];
   321

   325	      this.player.selectedSpell = spellList[Math.max(0, idx - 1)];
   326	    }
   327	    if (inp.pressed('ArrowDown') || inp.pressed('KeyS')) {
   328	      this.player.selectedSpell = spellList[Math.min(spellList.length - 1, idx + 1)];
   329	    }
   330	    // Cast selected spell
   330	    // Cast selected spell

   332	      if (this.player.selectedSpell) {

   334	      }
   335	    }
   336	    // Close menu
   337	    if (inp.start || inp.pressed('Escape') || inp.pressed('KeyP')) {
   338	      this.paused = false;
   339	    }
   340	  }
   341	
   342	  _updateLevelUp() {
   343	    const inp = this.input;
   344	    const opts = ['atk','mag','lif'];
   345	
   346	    if (inp.pressed('ArrowUp') || inp.pressed('KeyW')) {
   347	      this.levelUpSelection = (this.levelUpSelection - 1 + 3) % 3;
   348	    }
   349	    if (inp.pressed('ArrowDown') || inp.pressed('KeyS')) {
   350	      this.levelUpSelection = (this.levelUpSelection + 1) % 3;
   351	    }
   352	    if (inp.pressA || inp.pressed('Enter')) {
   353	      const attr = opts[this.levelUpSelection];
   354	      const lvlKey = attr + 'Lvl';
   355	      if (this.player[lvlKey] < 8) {

   357	      }
   358	      this.levelUpScreen = false;
   359	    }
   360	  }
   361

   364	    this.state = STATE.GAMEOVER;
   365	    this.gameOverTimer = 0;
   366	    if (this.player.lives < 0) {
   367	      // Game over - full reset next
   368	    } else {
   369	      // Continue next press
   370	    }
   371	  }

   373	  _draw() {
   374	    const ctx = this.ctx;
   375	    ctx.fillStyle = '#000000';
   376	    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
   377	
   378	    switch (this.state) {
   379	      case STATE.TITLE:
   380	        drawTitle(ctx, this.titleFrame);
   381	        break;
   382	
   383	      case STATE.OVERWORLD:
   384	        this.overworld.draw(ctx);
   385	        drawHUD(ctx, this.player, this.bestScore);
   386	        // HUD overlays overworld - redraw on top
   387	        if (this.paused) {
   388	          drawSpellSelect(ctx, this.player);
   389	        }
   390	        break;
   391	
   392	      case STATE.SIDEVIEW:
   393	        drawHUD(ctx, this.player, this.bestScore);
   394	        this.sideview.draw(ctx);
   395	        if (this.paused) {
   396	          drawSpellSelect(ctx, this.player);
   397	        } else if (this.levelUpScreen) {
   398	          const opts = ['atk','mag','lif'];
   399	          drawLevelUp(ctx, this.player, opts[this.levelUpSelection]);
   400	        }
   401	        break;
   402	
   403	      case STATE.TOWN:
   404	        drawHUD(ctx, this.player, this.bestScore);
   405	        this.town.draw(ctx);
   406	        if (this.paused) {
   407	          drawSpellSelect(ctx, this.player);
   408	        }
   409	        break;
   410	
   411	      case STATE.GAMEOVER:
   412	        drawHUD(ctx, this.player, this.bestScore);
   413	        drawGameOver(ctx, this.player);
   414	        break;
   415	
   416	      case STATE.WIN:
   417	        drawWin(ctx, this.winTimer);
   418	        break;
   419	    }
   420	  }

     2	//
     3	// No save/load existed anywhere in `src` before this (see
     4	// reviews/sol_port_spec_review_2026-07-18.md "no save or load
     5	// implementation exists"). This module is the normative save format and
     6	// implementation: a versioned JSON document covering player stats, spells,
     7	// palace flags (crystals collected — palace state itself is not
     8	// re-simulated, only crystal count), position, and all four RNG stream
     9	// states (worldRng/combatRng/townRng/fxRng), so a restored game continues
    10	// producing the exact same draw sequence a live game would have.
    11	//
    12	// Design choices (documented, not hidden):
    13	//  - Save is defined for STATE.OVERWORLD, STATE.TITLE, STATE.GAMEOVER and
    14	//    STATE.WIN. Saving mid-SIDEVIEW/TOWN still captures full player state,
    15	//    but load always resumes on the OVERWORLD at the player's last
    16	//    overworld position — palace/field/town room state is transient
    17	//    session state, not part of the save contract (matches the original

    19	//  - RNG stream state is the raw 32-bit LCG state integer (SeededRng
    20	//    getState()/setState()), not the seed — this preserves stream
    21	//    POSITION, which is what parity/determinism actually depends on.
    22	//
    23	// Supported I/O: localStorage (browser), and an explicit export/import

    35	  'x', 'y', 'w', 'h', 'vx', 'vy', 'facing', 'onGround', 'state',
    36	  'attackTimer', 'attackDuration', 'iframes', 'damageTimer',
    37	  'walkFrame', 'walkTimer',

    41	  'selectedSpell', 'keys', 'crystals', 'owX', 'owY',
