    44	export function serializeGame(game) {
    45	  const p = game.player;
    46	  return {
    47	    version: SAVE_VERSION,
    48	    seed: game.seed,
    49	    state: game.state,
    50	    player: {
    51	      ...Object.fromEntries(PLAYER_FIELDS.map(k => [k, p[k]])),
    52	      spells: { ...p.spells },
    53	      activeSpells: { ...p.activeSpells },
    54	    },
    55	    overworld: {
    56	      region: game.overworld.region,
    57	    },
    58	    rng: {
    59	      worldRng: worldRng.getState(),
    60	      combatRng: combatRng.getState(),
    61	      townRng: townRng.getState(),
    62	      fxRng: fxRng.getState(),
    63	    },
    64	  };
    65	}
    66	
    67	export function deserializeGame(game, data) {
    68	  if (!data || typeof data !== 'object') {
    69	    throw new Error('save: not an object');
    70	  }
    71	  if (data.version !== SAVE_VERSION) {
    72	    throw new Error(`save: unsupported version ${data.version} (expected ${SAVE_VERSION})`);
    73	  }
    74	  if (!data.player || !data.rng) {
    75	    throw new Error('save: missing required "player" or "rng" section');
    76	  }
    77	
    78	  const p = game.player;
    79	  for (const k of PLAYER_FIELDS) {
    80	    if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(data.player, k)) {
    81	      p[k] = data.player[k];
    82	    }
    83	  }
    84	  p.spells = { ...(data.player.spells || {}) };
    85	  p.activeSpells = { ...(data.player.activeSpells || {}) };
    86	  // Runtime-only fields that must not leak stale values across a load.
    87	  p.swordActive = false;
    88	  p.swordBox = null;
    89	  p.fireballs = [];
    90	  p.swordBeam = null;
    91	  p._pendingLevelUp = [];
    92	
    93	  if (data.overworld) {
    94	    game.overworld.region = data.overworld.region === 'east' ? 'east' : 'west';
    95	    game.overworld.map = game.overworld.region === 'east' ? EASTERN_MAP : WESTERN_MAP;
    96	  }
    97	
    98	  worldRng.setState(data.rng.worldRng);
    99	  combatRng.setState(data.rng.combatRng);
   100	  townRng.setState(data.rng.townRng);
   101	  fxRng.setState(data.rng.fxRng);
   102	
   103	  // Load always resumes on the overworld (see module header).
   104	  game.state = STATE.OVERWORLD;
   105	  game.paused = false;
   106	  game.levelUpScreen = false;
   107	  game.palaceClearTimer = null;
   108	}
   109	
   110	export function saveToLocalStorage(game, key = STORAGE_KEY) {
   111	  try {
   112	    if (typeof localStorage === 'undefined') return false;
   113	    localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(serializeGame(game)));
   114	    return true;
   115	  } catch (_e) {
   116	    return false;
   117	  }

   222	function completeSequence(seq){if(state.sequence!==seq)return;if(!seq.chargeOnly&&!seq.hitApplied)actionImpact(seq);state.hitstop=0;emitSequenceExtras(seq);state.anim=null;state.sequence=null;state.mode="action-resolved";if(state.endPending){state.endPending=false;checkEnd();}else finishTurn();}function fastForwardSequence(){if(state.sequence)completeSequence(state.sequence);}

   226	function aiMove(u,target){if(u.moveUsed){finishTurn();return;}const map=reachable(u),current=dist(u,target);let best=null;for(const e of map.values()){if(e.d===0||dist(e,target)>=current)continue;const score=dist(e,target)-(terrainAt(e.c,e.r).h>terrainAt(target.c,target.r).h?.3:0);if(!best||score<best.score||score===best.score&&(e.d>best.d||e.d===best.d&&seededTie(e,{id:key(e.c,e.r)},31)<0))best={...e,score};}if(best)startMove(u,best.path,()=>aiAct(u,target));else finishTurn();}

   296	function abilitySpec(u,name){const j=JOBS[u.job],basic={name,range:j.role==="ranged"?5:j.role==="mage"||j.role==="healer"?3:j.role==="bruiser"?2:1,minRange:1,cost:0,kind:"physical",factor:j.role==="ranged"?1.05:1,desc:"",presentation:"slash"};if(name==="Attack"){const basicVisual={Knight:["Knight Cleave","cleave"],Archer:["Archer Shot","starburst"],"Black Mage":["Arcane Bolt","rune"],"White Mage":["Radiant Bolt","lightbolt"],Monk:["Wave Punch","shockwave"],Thief:["Dagger Spectacle","dagger"]}[u.job];return{...basic,visualName:basicVisual[0],presentation:basicVisual[1],kind:"physical"};}const specs={"Shield Bash":{range:1,factor:1.2,desc:"Damage and push",knock:1,presentation:"shield"},Rampart:{range:0,minRange:0,kind:"buff",desc:"Brace and taunt",presentation:"buff"},"Aimed Shot":{range:5,factor:1.9,kind:"physical",charged:true,desc:"Charged high damage",presentation:"arrow"},Pin:{range:4,factor:.82,kind:"physical",desc:"Damage and delay",presentation:"arrow"},Fireball:{range:4,factor:1.15,kind:"magic",cost:16,charged:true,aoe:1,desc:"Charged 3 x 3 blast",presentation:"fireball"},"Frost Lance":{range:4,factor:1.05,kind:"magic",cost:10,desc:"Damage and slow",presentation:"frost"},Heal:{range:3,minRange:0,factor:1.45,kind:"heal",cost:10,desc:"Restore ally HP",presentation:"heal"},Bless:{range:3,minRange:0,factor:1,kind:"buff",cost:12,desc:"PA and accuracy for 2 turns",presentation:"bless"},Chakra:{range:0,minRange:0,factor:1,kind:"chakra",desc:"Restore self HP and MP",presentation:"chakra"},"Wave Fist":{range:2,factor:1.05,kind:"physical",desc:"Shockwave punch",presentation:"wave"},Backstab:{range:1,factor:2,kind:"physical",desc:"Huge back bonus",backOnly:true,presentation:"backstab"},"Steal Tempo":{range:1,factor:1,kind:"steal",desc:"Drain CT, gain Tempo",presentation:"steal"}};return{...basic,...(specs[name]||{})};}
   297	function sequencePalette(u,s){if(s.name==="Fireball")return{main:"#ff762d",glow:"#ffb347",text:"#ffb347"};if(s.name==="Frost Lance")return{main:"#72cfff",glow:"#c3f0ff",text:"#a9e8ff"};if(s.kind==="heal"||s.kind==="chakra"||s.name==="Bless"||s.name==="Radiant Bolt")return{main:"#86f5bc",glow:"#e8fff5",text:"#b9ffe2"};if(s.name==="Rampart"||s.name==="Steal Tempo")return{main:"#ffd36c",glow:"#fff1b2",text:"#ffd36c"};if(s.presentation==="rune")return{main:"#b58cff",glow:"#ebd7ff",text:"#d8b8ff"};if(s.presentation==="shockwave")return{main:"#ffbd6e",glow:"#ffe2a7",text:"#ffd36c"};return{main:"#dce8e5",glow:"#ffffff",text:"#ffffff"};}
   298	function prepareOutcomes(seq){const s=seq.spec,u=seq.unit;if(seq.fizzle)return[];if(s.name==="Steal Tempo"||s.kind==="heal"||s.kind==="buff"||s.kind==="chakra")return[];const targets=[];if(s.aoe){for(const t of state.units)if(t.alive&&t.team!==u.team&&Math.abs(t.c-seq.c)<=1&&Math.abs(t.r-seq.r)<=1)targets.push(t);}else{const t=seq.targetId?state.units.find(x=>x.id===seq.targetId&&x.alive):targetAt(seq.c,seq.r);if(t&&t.team!==u.team)targets.push(t);}const out=[];for(const t of targets){const pre=preview(u,s,t),hit=state.combatRng()*100<=pre.hit,crit=pre.dir==="BACK"||s.backOnly;out.push({targetId:t.id,hit,crit,damage:hit?Math.max(1,Math.round(pre.damage*(.9+state.combatRng()*.2))):0,pre});}return out;}
   299	function buildSequence(u,s,c,r,fromCharge,chargeOnly,targetId,fizzle){const charge=s.charged&&!chargeOnly&&!fromCharge?300:0,anticipation=260,commit=440,recovery=430,total=chargeOnly?700:charge+anticipation+commit+recovery,target=targetId&&state.units.find(x=>x.id===targetId)||targetAt(c,r),targetFace=target?faceVector(target.face):faceVector(u.face),backTile=s.name==="Backstab"?{c:c-targetFace[0],r:r-targetFace[1]}:null;const seq={unit:u,spec:s,c,r,targetId:targetId||null,fizzle:!!fizzle,fromCharge:!!fromCharge,chargeOnly:!!chargeOnly,signature:true,t:0,total,chargeAt:charge,commitAt:charge+anticipation,impactAt:chargeOnly?Infinity:charge+anticipation+commit,recoveryAt:chargeOnly?Infinity:charge+anticipation+commit,steps:[],stepIndex:0,reactions:[],palette:sequencePalette(u,s),presentation:s.presentation||"slash",projectile:s.presentation==="arrow",aoe:!!s.aoe,hitApplied:false,impactPresentation:false,hasHit:false,lastEmit:0,projectileLast:0,burstDone:false,visualName:(s.visualName||s.name).toUpperCase(),backTile,knockVisual:null};seq.outcomes=seq.chargeOnly?[]:prepareOutcomes(seq);seq.hasHit=s.name==="Steal Tempo"||s.kind==="heal"||s.kind==="buff"||s.kind==="chakra"||seq.outcomes.some(o=>o.hit);return seq;}
   300	function startActionAnimation(u,s,c,r,fromCharge,chargeOnly,targetId,fizzle){const t=targetId?state.units.find(x=>x.id===targetId):targetAt(c,r);if(t&&t.team!==u.team)u.face=directionFromTarget(u,t);state.mode="anim";state.confirmTargetKey=null;state.action=null;state.aim=null;activeFloats.length=0;activeParticles.length=0;state.sequence=buildSequence(u,s,c,r,fromCharge,!!chargeOnly,targetId,fizzle);state.anim={kind:"action",sequence:state.sequence};updateHUD();focusUnit(u);schedule();}
   301	function addReaction(seq,t,p,o){seq.reactions.push({unit:t,x:p.x,y:p.y,hit:!!o.hit,crit:!!o.crit,dx:Math.sign(t.c-seq.unit.c),dy:Math.sign(t.r-seq.unit.r),from:null,to:null});}

   304	function completeSequence(seq){if(state.sequence!==seq)return;if(!seq.chargeOnly&&!seq.hitApplied)actionImpact(seq);if(state.speedMode===0){activeFloats.length=0;activeParticles.length=0;state.camera.punch=0;state.camera.shakeTime=0;state.camera.shakeAmp=0;}else{activeFloats.length=0;activeParticles.length=0;}state.hitstop=0;state.anim=null;state.sequence=null;state.mode="action-resolved";if(state.endPending){state.endPending=false;checkEnd();}else finishTurn();}
   305	function fastForwardSequence(){if(state.sequence)completeSequence(state.sequence);}
   306	function updateSequence(dt){const seq=state.sequence;if(!seq)return;if(state.speedMode===0){completeSequence(seq);return;}if(state.hitstop>0){state.hitstop-=dt*state.speedMode;return;}const rate=state.speedMode>1?2:1;seq.t+=dt*rate;if(!seq.chargeOnly&&seq.t>=seq.impactAt){if(!seq.hitApplied)actionImpact(seq);if(!seq.burstDone)emitSequenceExtras(seq);}if(seq.chargeOnly&&seq.t>=seq.total)completeSequence(seq);if(!seq.chargeOnly&&seq.projectile&&seq.t>=seq.commitAt&&seq.t<seq.impactAt&&seq.t-seq.projectileLast>34){seq.projectileLast=seq.t;const q=pathPoint(seq);burst(q.x,q.y,seq.palette.main,3,{speed:7,spread:13,vy:0,dur:210,durSpread:90,size:1,sizeSpread:2,gravity:12});}if(seq.spec.name==="Fireball"&&seq.hasHit&&!seq.chargeOnly&&seq.t>=seq.impactAt&&seq.t<seq.impactAt+420&&seq.t-seq.lastEmit>54){seq.lastEmit=seq.t;const p=boardWorld(seq.c,seq.r);burst(p.x,p.y-18,"#ff8a3d",6,{speed:12,spread:26,vy:-24,dur:520,durSpread:180,size:1.5,sizeSpread:3,gravity:18});}if(!seq.chargeOnly&&seq.t>=seq.total)completeSequence(seq);}

   304	function completeSequence(seq){if(state.sequence!==seq)return;if(!seq.chargeOnly&&!seq.hitApplied)actionImpact(seq);if(state.speedMode===0){activeFloats.length=0;activeParticles.length=0;state.camera.punch=0;state.camera.shakeTime=0;state.camera.shakeAmp=0;}else{activeFloats.length=0;activeParticles.length=0;}state.hitstop=0;state.anim=null;state.sequence=null;state.mode="action-resolved";if(state.endPending){state.endPending=false;checkEnd();}else finishTurn();}
   305	function fastForwardSequence(){if(state.sequence)completeSequence(state.sequence);}
   306	function updateSequence(dt){const seq=state.sequence;if(!seq)return;if(state.speedMode===0){completeSequence(seq);return;}if(state.hitstop>0){state.hitstop-=dt*state.speedMode;return;}const rate=state.speedMode>1?2:1;seq.t+=dt*rate;if(!seq.chargeOnly&&seq.t>=seq.impactAt){if(!seq.hitApplied)actionImpact(seq);if(!seq.burstDone)emitSequenceExtras(seq);}if(seq.chargeOnly&&seq.t>=seq.total)completeSequence(seq);if(!seq.chargeOnly&&seq.projectile&&seq.t>=seq.commitAt&&seq.t<seq.impactAt&&seq.t-seq.projectileLast>34){seq.projectileLast=seq.t;const q=pathPoint(seq);burst(q.x,q.y,seq.palette.main,3,{speed:7,spread:13,vy:0,dur:210,durSpread:90,size:1,sizeSpread:2,gravity:12});}if(seq.spec.name==="Fireball"&&seq.hasHit&&!seq.chargeOnly&&seq.t>=seq.impactAt&&seq.t<seq.impactAt+420&&seq.t-seq.lastEmit>54){seq.lastEmit=seq.t;const p=boardWorld(seq.c,seq.r);burst(p.x,p.y-18,"#ff8a3d",6,{speed:12,spread:26,vy:-24,dur:520,durSpread:180,size:1.5,sizeSpread:3,gravity:18});}if(!seq.chargeOnly&&seq.t>=seq.total)completeSequence(seq);}

     1	/* Ridge Glider - main game */
     2	(function () {
     3	  'use strict';
     4	
     5	  var cv = document.getElementById('cv');
     6	  var ctx = cv.getContext('2d', { alpha: false });
     7	  var rotateEl = document.getElementById('rotate');
     8	  var W = 960, H = 540, DPR = 1;
     9	
    10	  // ---------------- physics constants ----------------
    11	  var MASS = 100, S = 15, RHO = 1.225, G = 9.81;
    12	  var CL0 = 0.35, CLA = 4.6, A_STALL = 0.145;
    13	  var CD0 = 0.032, KIND = 0.062;
    14	  var A_TRIM = 0.0, A_NEG = 0.055, A_POS = 0.155;
    15	  var BEST_KEY = 'ridgeGliderBest';
    16	
    17	  var best = 0;
    18	  try { best = parseInt(localStorage.getItem(BEST_KEY) || '0', 10) || 0; } catch (e) { }
    19	
    20	  // ---------------- state ----------------
    21	  var world, g, cam, particles = [], tmpTherm = [];
    22	  var shake = 0, flash = 0, flashCol = '#fff';
    23	  var state = 'fly';   // 'fly' | 'over'
    24	  var overInfo = null, overT = 0;
    25	  var tNow = 0, hintT = 0;
    26	
    27	  function rnd(a, b) { return a + Math.random() * (b - a); }
    28	
    29	  function newFlight() {
    30	    world = new window.RG.World((Math.random() * 1e9) | 0);
    31	    var y0 = world.h(0) + 300;
    32	    g = {
    33	      x: 0, y: y0, V: 17, gam: -0.06,
    34	      alpha: A_TRIM, input: 0, inTarget: 0,
    35	      stalled: 0, vy: 0, vx: 17, roll: 0,
    36	      trail: [], t: 0
    37	    };
    38	    cam = { x: -60, yTop: y0 + 120, scale: 2.4 };
    39	    particles.length = 0;
    40	    state = 'fly'; overInfo = null; shake = 0; flash = 0;
    41	    hintT = 6.5;
    42	    tNow = 0;
    43	  }
    44	
    45	  // ---------------- canvas sizing ----------------
    46	  function resize() {
    47	    var cw = window.innerWidth, ch = window.innerHeight;
    48	    DPR = Math.min(2, window.devicePixelRatio || 1);
    49	    var longCss = Math.max(cw, ch);
    50	    var scale = Math.min(DPR, 960 / longCss);
    51	    if (scale < 0.5) scale = 0.5;
    52	    W = Math.max(320, Math.round(cw * scale));
    53	    H = Math.max(200, Math.round(ch * scale));
    54	    cv.width = W; cv.height = H;
    55	    rotateEl.className = (ch > cw * 1.05) ? 'on' : '';
    56	  }
    57	  window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
    58	  window.addEventListener('orientationchange', function () { setTimeout(resize, 250); });
    59	
    60	  // ---------------- input ----------------
    61	  var drag = null, keyUp = false, keyDn = false;
    62	  var DRAG_PX = 90; // css px for full deflection
    63	
    64	  function pressStart(x, y) {
    65	    audioUnlock();
    66	    if (state === 'over' && overT > 0.45) { newFlight(); return; }
    67	    drag = { y0: y, cur: y };
    68	  }
    69	  function pressMove(y) { if (drag) drag.cur = y; }
    70	  function pressEnd() { drag = null; }
    71	
    72	  cv.addEventListener('touchstart', function (e) {
    73	    e.preventDefault();
    74	    var t = e.changedTouches[0];
    75	    pressStart(t.clientX, t.clientY);
    76	  }, { passive: false });
    77	  cv.addEventListener('touchmove', function (e) {
    78	    e.preventDefault();
    79	    pressMove(e.changedTouches[0].clientY);
    80	  }, { passive: false });
    81	  cv.addEventListener('touchend', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); pressEnd(); }, { passive: false });
    82	  cv.addEventListener('touchcancel', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); pressEnd(); }, { passive: false });
    83	  document.addEventListener('touchmove', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); }, { passive: false });
    84	
    85	  cv.addEventListener('mousedown', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); pressStart(e.clientX, e.clientY); });
    86	  window.addEventListener('mousemove', function (e) { pressMove(e.clientY); });
    87	  window.addEventListener('mouseup', function () { pressEnd(); });
    88	
    89	  window.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
    90	    var k = e.key;
    91	    if (k === 'ArrowUp' || k === 'w' || k === 'W') { keyUp = true; e.preventDefault(); }
    92	    else if (k === 'ArrowDown' || k === 's' || k === 'S') { keyDn = true; e.preventDefault(); }
    93	    else if (k === ' ' || k === 'Enter') {
    94	      e.preventDefault();
    95	      if (state === 'over' && overT > 0.45) newFlight();
    96	    }
    97	    audioUnlock();
    98	  });
    99	  window.addEventListener('keyup', function (e) {
   100	    var k = e.key;
   101	    if (k === 'ArrowUp' || k === 'w' || k === 'W') keyUp = false;
   102	    if (k === 'ArrowDown' || k === 's' || k === 'S') keyDn = false;
   103	  });
   104	
   105	  function readInput(dt) {
   106	    var target = 0, active = false;
   107	    if (drag) {
   108	      target = (drag.y0 - drag.cur) / DRAG_PX;
   109	      if (target > 1) target = 1; if (target < -1) target = -1;
   110	      active = true;
   111	    }
   112	    // keyboard stops just short of the stall so a held key mushes, not spins
   113	    if (keyUp) { target = 0.85; active = true; }
   114	    if (keyDn) { target = -1; active = true; }
   115	    if (!active) target = g.inTarget * Math.max(0, 1 - dt * 1.6);
   116	    g.inTarget = target;
   117	    var rate = 5.5;
   118	    g.input += (target - g.input) * Math.min(1, dt * rate);
   119	  }
   120	
   121	  // ---------------- audio (WebAudio only) ----------------
   122	  var AC = null, master = null, varioOsc = null, varioGain = null;
   123	  function audioUnlock() {
   124	    if (AC) { if (AC.state === 'suspended') AC.resume(); return; }
   125	    try {
   126	      var C = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
   127	      if (!C) return;
   128	      AC = new C();
   129	      master = AC.createGain(); master.gain.value = 0.18; master.connect(AC.destination);
   130	      varioOsc = AC.createOscillator(); varioOsc.type = 'square'; varioOsc.frequency.value = 700;
   131	      varioGain = AC.createGain(); varioGain.gain.value = 0;
   132	      varioOsc.connect(varioGain); varioGain.connect(master); varioOsc.start();
   133	    } catch (e) { AC = null; }
   134	  }
   135	  var beepAcc = 0;
   136	  function vario(dt, w) {
   137	    if (!AC) return;
   138	    if (w > 0.4 && state === 'fly') {
   139	      var rate = 1.2 + Math.min(4.5, w) * 1.5;
   140	      varioOsc.frequency.value = 620 + Math.min(5, w) * 150;
   141	      beepAcc += dt * rate;
   142	      var ph = beepAcc % 1;
   143	      varioGain.gain.value = ph < 0.45 ? 0.25 : 0;
   144	    } else {
   145	      varioGain.gain.value = 0; beepAcc = 0;
   146	    }
   147	  }
   148	  function thud(freq, dur, type, vol) {
   149	    if (!AC) return;
   150	    try {
   151	      var o = AC.createOscillator(), gn = AC.createGain();
   152	      o.type = type || 'sawtooth'; o.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, AC.currentTime);
   153	      o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(40, freq * 0.25), AC.currentTime + dur);
   154	      gn.gain.setValueAtTime(vol || 0.5, AC.currentTime);
   155	      gn.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, AC.currentTime + dur);
   156	      o.connect(gn); gn.connect(master); o.start(); o.stop(AC.currentTime + dur + 0.02);
   157	    } catch (e) { }
   158	  }
   159	
   160	  // ---------------- simulation ----------------
   161	  function step(dt) {
   162	    g.t += dt;
   163	    readInput(dt);
   164	
   165	    // weight-shift lag
   166	    var aCmd = A_TRIM + (g.input < 0 ? g.input * A_NEG : g.input * A_POS);
   167	    g.alpha += (aCmd - g.alpha) * Math.min(1, dt * 4.2);
   168	
   169	    var a = g.alpha;
   170	    var CL = CL0 + CLA * a;
   171	    var extraD = 0;
   172	    if (a > A_STALL) {
   173	      var ex = a - A_STALL;
   174	      CL = CL0 + CLA * A_STALL - 3.4 * ex;
   175	      extraD = 0.9 * ex;
   176	      g.stalled = Math.min(1, g.stalled + dt * 4);
   177	    } else {
   178	      g.stalled = Math.max(0, g.stalled - dt * 2.5);
   179	    }
   180	    if (CL < 0.10) CL = 0.10;
   181	
   182	    var V = g.V; if (V < 3) V = 3;
   183	    var q = 0.5 * RHO * V * V * S;
   184	    var CD = CD0 + KIND * CL * CL + extraD;
   185	    if (V > 32) { var o = (V - 32) / 10; CD += 0.022 * o * o; }
   186	
   187	    var L = q * CL, D = q * CD;
   188	    var sg = Math.sin(g.gam), cg = Math.cos(g.gam);
   189	
   190	    var dV = (-D - MASS * G * sg) / MASS;
   191	    var Vd = Math.max(6, g.V);
   192	    var dgam = (L - MASS * G * cg) / (MASS * Vd);
   193	    if (dgam > 2.8) dgam = 2.8; if (dgam < -2.8) dgam = -2.8;
   194	
   195	    g.V += dV * dt;
   196	    if (g.V < 4.5) g.V = 4.5;
   197	    if (g.V > 44) g.V = 44;
   198	    g.gam += dgam * dt;
   199	    if (g.gam > 1.35) g.gam = 1.35;
   200	    if (g.gam < -1.45) g.gam = -1.45;
   201	
   202	    var w = world.lift(g.x, g.y);
   203	    g.air = w;
   204	    g.vx = g.V * Math.cos(g.gam) + world.wind;
   205	    g.vy = g.V * Math.sin(g.gam) + w;
   206	
   207	    g.x += g.vx * dt;
   208	    g.y += g.vy * dt;
   209	
   210	    g.roll += ((g.input * 0.22) - g.roll) * Math.min(1, dt * 6);
   211	
   212	    // trail
   213	    if (g.trail.length === 0 || g.x - g.trail[g.trail.length - 1].x > 6) {
   214	      g.trail.push({ x: g.x, y: g.y });
   215	      if (g.trail.length > 120) g.trail.shift();
   216	    }
   217	
   218	    // wingtip vortices when fast, sparkles when climbing
   219	    if (g.V > 23 && Math.random() < dt * 30) {
   220	      particles.push({ x: g.x, y: g.y, vx: -rnd(2, 6), vy: rnd(-2, 2), l: 0.7, m: 0.7, k: 0 });
   221	    }
   222	    if (w > 1.0 && Math.random() < dt * (8 + w * 6)) {
   223	      particles.push({ x: g.x + rnd(-40, 40), y: g.y + rnd(-25, 25), vx: rnd(-1, 1), vy: w * rnd(0.5, 1.1), l: 1.4, m: 1.4, k: 1 });
   224	    }
   225	    if (g.stalled > 0.4) shake = Math.max(shake, 2 + g.stalled * 3);
   226	
   227	    for (var i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   228	      var p = particles[i];
   229	      p.l -= dt; if (p.l <= 0) { particles.splice(i, 1); continue; }
   230	      p.x += p.vx * dt; p.y += p.vy * dt;
   231	    }
   232	
   233	    // ground contact
   234	    var gh = world.h(g.x);
   235	    if (g.y <= gh) {
   236	      g.y = gh;
   237	      land(gh);
   238	    }
   239	    vario(dt, w);
   240	  }
   241	
   242	  function land(gh) {
   243	    var lz = world.lzAt(g.x);
   244	    var slope = Math.abs(world.slope(g.x));
   245	    var gentle = (g.vy > -3.4) && (g.V < 15.5) && (slope < 0.28) && (g.stalled < 0.5);
   246	    var dist = Math.max(0, Math.round(g.x));
   247	    var bonus = 0, msg, sub;
   248	
   249	    if (gentle && lz) {
   250	      var acc = 1 - Math.abs(lz.dx) / lz.half;
   251	      var soft = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (3.4 + g.vy) / 3.4));
   252	      bonus = Math.round(400 + 400 * acc + 300 * soft);
   253	      msg = 'SPOT LANDING';
   254	      sub = 'zone bonus +' + bonus;
   255	      flashCol = '#7dffb0'; flash = 0.6;
   256	      thud(520, 0.35, 'triangle', 0.4);
   257	    } else if (gentle) {
   258	      msg = 'LANDED OUT';
   259	      sub = 'no zone bonus';
   260	      flashCol = '#ffe08a'; flash = 0.4;
   261	      thud(260, 0.3, 'triangle', 0.35);
   262	    } else {
   263	      msg = g.stalled > 0.5 ? 'STALLED IN' : 'CRASHED';
   264	      sub = 'flew it into the hill';
   265	      flashCol = '#ff6b6b'; flash = 0.8; shake = 22;
   266	      thud(150, 0.55, 'sawtooth', 0.7);
   267	      for (var i = 0; i < 40; i++) {
   268	        particles.push({ x: g.x, y: gh + 4, vx: rnd(-30, 25), vy: rnd(2, 26), l: rnd(0.5, 1.3), m: 1.3, k: 2 });
   269	      }
   270	    }
   271	    var score = dist + bonus;
   272	    var isBest = score > best;
   273	    if (isBest) {
   274	      best = score;
   275	      try { localStorage.setItem(BEST_KEY, String(best)); } catch (e) { }
   276	    }
   277	    overInfo = { msg: msg, sub: sub, dist: dist, bonus: bonus, score: score, isBest: isBest };
   278	    state = 'over'; overT = 0;
   279	    if (varioGain) varioGain.gain.value = 0;
   280	  }
   281	
   282	  // ---------------- camera ----------------
   283	  function updateCam(dt) {
   284	    var gh = world.h(g.x);
   285	    var agl = g.y - gh;
   286	    var t = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (agl - 70) / 430));
   287	    var want = 2.9 - 1.75 * t;             // px per metre (in backing-store px)
   288	    want *= (W / 960);
   289	    if (want < 0.6) want = 0.6;
   290	    cam.scale += (want - cam.scale) * Math.min(1, dt * 1.6);
   291	
   292	    var s = cam.scale;
   293	    var wantX = g.x - (W * 0.32) / s;
   294	    var wantY = g.y + (H * 0.40) / s;
   295	    // keep some ground visible
   296	    var lowest = gh;
   297	    for (var i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
   298	      var hh = world.h(g.x + i * (W / s) / 6);
   299	      if (hh > lowest) lowest = hh;
   300	    }
   301	    var maxTop = lowest + H / s * 0.98;
   302	    if (wantY > maxTop && agl < 200) wantY = Math.max(g.y + 30 / s, maxTop);
   303	
   304	    var k = Math.min(1, dt * 6);
   305	    cam.x += (wantX - cam.x) * k;
   306	    cam.y = 0;
   307	    cam.yTop += (wantY - cam.yTop) * Math.min(1, dt * 4);
   308	  }
   309	
   310	  function sx(wx) { return (wx - cam.x) * cam.scale; }
   311	  function sy(wy) { return (cam.yTop - wy) * cam.scale; }
   312	
   313	  // ---------------- rendering ----------------
   314	  var skyGrad = null, skyKey = '', terrGrad = null, terrGradH = -1;
   315	  function drawSky() {
   316	    var key = W + 'x' + H;
   317	    if (skyKey !== key) {
   318	      skyGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
   319	      skyGrad.addColorStop(0, '#1a3f6b');
   320	      skyGrad.addColorStop(0.45, '#2f76a8');
   321	      skyGrad.addColorStop(0.8, '#7fb6cf');
   322	      skyGrad.addColorStop(1, '#c9dbe0');
   323	      skyKey = key;
   324	    }
   325	    ctx.fillStyle = skyGrad;
   326	    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
   327	  }
   328	
   329	  function drawClouds() {
   330	    // simple cumulus row near cloudbase, parallax
   331	    var base = 1150;
   332	    var pf = 0.35;
   333	    var step = 520;
   334	    var x0 = cam.x * pf;
   335	    var i0 = Math.floor(x0 / step) - 1;
   336	    ctx.save();
   337	    for (var i = i0; i < i0 + Math.ceil(W / cam.scale / step) + 3; i++) {
   338	      var r = ((Math.sin(i * 12.9898 + world.seed * 0.001) * 43758.5453) % 1 + 1) % 1;
   339	      if (r > 0.75) continue;
   340	      var cx = (i * step + r * 300 - x0) * cam.scale;
   341	      var cy = sy(base + r * 130) * pf + H * 0.10;
   342	      var rad = (34 + r * 26) * cam.scale;
   343	      if (cx < -rad * 3 || cx > W + rad * 3) continue;
   344	      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.55)';
   345	      ctx.beginPath();
   346	      ctx.arc(cx, cy, rad, 0, 6.283);
   347	      ctx.arc(cx + rad * 0.9, cy + rad * 0.15, rad * 0.75, 0, 6.283);
   348	      ctx.arc(cx - rad * 0.85, cy + rad * 0.2, rad * 0.65, 0, 6.283);
   349	      ctx.fill();
   350	    }
   351	    ctx.restore();
   352	  }
   353	
   354	  function drawBgRidge(pf, amp, off, col) {
   355	    var s = cam.scale;
   356	    ctx.fillStyle = col;
   357	    ctx.beginPath();
   358	    ctx.moveTo(0, H);
   359	    var stepPx = 10;
   360	    for (var px = 0; px <= W + stepPx; px += stepPx) {
   361	      var wx = cam.x * pf + px / s;
   362	      var hb = 120 + amp * world.n(wx / 900 + off, 5) + amp * 0.45 * world.n(wx / 320 + off * 2, 6);
   363	      var y = (cam.yTop - hb) * s * pf + H * (1 - pf) * 0.42;
   364	      ctx.lineTo(px, y);
   365	    }
   366	    ctx.lineTo(W, H);
   367	    ctx.closePath();
   368	    ctx.fill();
   369	  }
   370	
   371	  function drawTerrain() {
   372	    var s = cam.scale;
   373	    var stepPx = 4;
   374	    var pts = [];
   375	    for (var px = -stepPx; px <= W + stepPx; px += stepPx) {
   376	      var wx = cam.x + px / s;
   377	      pts.push([px, sy(world.h(wx)), wx]);
   378	    }
   379	    // body
   380	    if (!terrGrad || terrGradH !== H) {
   381	      terrGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
   382	      terrGrad.addColorStop(0, '#3c6b4a');
   383	      terrGrad.addColorStop(1, '#16261f');
   384	      terrGradH = H;
   385	    }
   386	    ctx.fillStyle = terrGrad;
   387	    ctx.beginPath();
   388	    ctx.moveTo(pts[0][0], H);
   389	    for (var i = 0; i < pts.length; i++) ctx.lineTo(pts[i][0], pts[i][1]);
   390	    ctx.lineTo(pts[pts.length - 1][0], H);
   391	    ctx.closePath();
   392	    ctx.fill();
   393	    // crest line
   394	    ctx.strokeStyle = '#8fd6a0';
   395	    ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1.5, 2 * (W / 960));
   396	    ctx.beginPath();
   397	    for (i = 0; i < pts.length; i++) { if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(pts[i][0], pts[i][1]); else ctx.lineTo(pts[i][0], pts[i][1]); }
   398	    ctx.stroke();
   399	
   400	    // windward lift band shading (banded fills - cheap, no per-column gradients)
   401	    ctx.fillStyle = '#96e1ff';
   402	    for (i = 0; i < pts.length - 1; i += 2) {
   403	      var wx2 = pts[i][2];
   404	      var sl = world.slope(wx2);
   405	      if (sl <= 0.09) continue;
   406	      var band = 70 + 190 * Math.min(1, sl);
   407	      var ghc = world.h(wx2);
   408	      var alpha = Math.min(0.26, (sl - 0.08) * 0.45);
   409	      var wpx = stepPx * 2 + 1;
   410	      for (var bq = 0; bq < 4; bq++) {
   411	        var f0 = bq / 4, f1 = (bq + 1) / 4;
   412	        var yA = sy(ghc + band * f1), yB = sy(ghc + band * f0);
   413	        ctx.globalAlpha = alpha * (1 - (f0 + f1) / 2);
   414	        ctx.fillRect(pts[i][0], yA, wpx, yB - yA + 1);
   415	      }
   416	    }
   417	    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   418	
   419	    // rising streaks over windward faces
   420	    ctx.save();

   485	  function drawThermals() {
   486	    var s = cam.scale;

   526	          var by = sy(alt);

   531	          ctx.quadraticCurveTo(bx - sz * 0.5, by - sz * 0.7, bx, by);
   532	          ctx.quadraticCurveTo(bx + sz * 0.5, by - sz * 0.7, bx + sz, by);

   536	    }

   697	  function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r) {
   698	    ctx.beginPath();
   699	    ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
   700	    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
   701	    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
   702	    ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
   703	    ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
   704	    ctx.closePath();
   705	  }

   743	  function render() {
   744	    ctx.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0);
   745	    drawSky();
   746	    var shx = 0, shy = 0;
   747	    if (shake > 0.05) { shx = rnd(-shake, shake); shy = rnd(-shake, shake); }
   748	    ctx.save();
   749	    ctx.translate(shx, shy);
   750	    drawClouds();
   751	    drawBgRidge(0.30, 210, 3.1, '#4d6f88');
   752	    drawBgRidge(0.55, 260, 8.4, '#3a5a63');
   753	    drawThermals();
   754	    drawTerrain();
   755	    drawLZ();
   756	    drawParticles();
   757	    drawGlider();
   758	    ctx.restore();
   759	
   760	    if (flash > 0.01) {
   761	      ctx.globalAlpha = Math.min(0.55, flash);
   762	      ctx.fillStyle = flashCol;
   763	      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
   764	      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   765	    }
   766	    if (state === 'fly') hud(); else { hud(); overlay(); }
   767	  }
   768	
   769	  // ---------------- loop ----------------
   770	  var last = 0;
   771	  function frame(ts) {
   772	    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
   773	    if (!last) last = ts;
   774	    var dt = (ts - last) / 1000;
   775	    last = ts;
   776	    if (dt > 0.1) dt = 0.1;
   777	    if (dt <= 0) dt = 0.0001;
   778	    tNow += dt;
   779	    if (hintT > 0) hintT -= dt;
   780	    shake *= Math.pow(0.02, dt);
   781	    flash *= Math.pow(0.02, dt);
   782	
   783	    if (state === 'fly') {
   784	      var rem = dt;
   785	      while (rem > 0 && state === 'fly') {
   786	        var h = Math.min(0.016, rem);
   787	        step(h);
   788	        rem -= h;
   789	      }
   790	      updateCam(dt);
   791	    } else {
   792	      overT += dt;
   793	      for (var i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   794	        var p = particles[i];
   795	        p.l -= dt; if (p.l <= 0) { particles.splice(i, 1); continue; }
   796	        p.x += p.vx * dt; p.y += p.vy * dt; p.vy -= 30 * dt;
   797	      }
   798	    }
   799	    render();
   800	  }
   801	
   802	  resize();
   803	  newFlight();
   804	  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
   805	})();

  function saveBest() { try { localStorage.setItem('ace-vector-best', String(Math.max(game.best, game.score))); } catch (_) {} }
  function rand() { game.seed = (game.seed * 1664525 + 1013904223) >>> 0; return game.seed / 4294967296; }
  function clamp(n, a, b) { return Math.max(a, Math.min(b, n)); }
  function lerp(a, b, n) { return a + (b - a) * n; }
  function dist(a, b, c, d) { return Math.hypot(a - c, b - d); }
  function angleDiff(a, b) { return Math.atan2(Math.sin(a - b), Math.cos(a - b)); }
  function announce(text, time = 1.6) { game.message = text; game.messageTime = time; }

  function resize() {
    const r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    view.w = Math.max(320, r.width);
    view.h = Math.max(240, r.height);
    view.dpr = Math.min(2, window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 960 / Math.max(view.w, view.h));
    canvas.width = Math.max(1, Math.round(view.w * view.dpr));
    canvas.height = Math.max(1, Math.round(view.h * view.dpr));
    ctx.setTransform(view.dpr, 0, 0, view.dpr, 0, 0);
    if (!game.player.y) game.player.y = view.h * .52;
    game.player.x = view.w * .32;
  }
  window.addEventListener('resize', resize, { passive: true });
  resize();

  function pointerPosition(e) {
    const r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    return { x: e.clientX - r.left, y: e.clientY - r.top };
  }
  function controlZones() {
    const s = Math.min(88, view.w * .13);
    return { stick: { x: s + 20, y: view.h - s - 20, r: s }, fire: { x: view.w - s - 18, y: view.h - s - 20, r: s * .74 }, flare: { x: view.w - s * 2.15 - 24, y: view.h - s - 20, r: s * .54 }, wing: { x: view.w - 54, y: 74, r: 33 } };
  }
  function setStick(p, z) {
    const dx = p.x - z.x, dy = p.y - z.y, m = Math.min(z.r, Math.hypot(dx, dy));
    const a = Math.atan2(dy, dx);
    input.stick = { x: Math.cos(a) * m / z.r, y: Math.sin(a) * m / z.r };
  }
  function requestFlare() { input.flareRequest = true; }
  function pointerDown(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (game.screen !== 'play') { reset(); return; }
    const p = pointerPosition(e), z = controlZones();
    let kind = 'other';
    if (dist(p.x, p.y, z.stick.x, z.stick.y) < z.stick.r * 1.45) { kind = 'stick'; setStick(p, z.stick); }
    else if (dist(p.x, p.y, z.fire.x, z.fire.y) < z.fire.r * 1.35) { kind = 'fire'; input.fire = true; }
    else if (dist(p.x, p.y, z.flare.x, z.flare.y) < z.flare.r * 1.5) { kind = 'flare'; requestFlare(); }
    else if (dist(p.x, p.y, z.wing.x, z.wing.y) < z.wing.r * 1.35) { kind = 'wing'; orderWingman(); }
    pointers.set(e.pointerId, kind);
    try { canvas.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); } catch (_) {}
  }
  function pointerMove(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (pointers.get(e.pointerId) === 'stick') setStick(pointerPosition(e), controlZones().stick);
  }
  function pointerUp(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    const kind = pointers.get(e.pointerId);
    if (kind === 'stick') input.stick = null;
    if (kind === 'fire') input.fire = false;
    pointers.delete(e.pointerId);
  }
  canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', pointerDown, { passive: false });
  canvas.addEventListener('pointermove', pointerMove, { passive: false });
  canvas.addEventListener('pointerup', pointerUp, { passive: false });
  canvas.addEventListener('pointercancel', pointerUp, { passive: false });
  canvas.addEventListener('contextmenu', e => e.preventDefault());
  window.addEventListener('touchmove', e => e.preventDefault(), { passive: false });
  window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
    const k = e.key.toLowerCase();
    if (['arrowup','arrowdown','arrowleft','arrowright','w','a','s','d',' ','f','shift','enter'].includes(k)) e.preventDefault();
    if (game.screen !== 'play' && (k === 'enter' || k === ' ')) { reset(); return; }
    input.keys.add(k);
    if (k === 'f' || k === 'shift') requestFlare();
  }, { passive: false });
  window.addEventListener('keyup', e => input.keys.delete(e.key.toLowerCase()));

  function steer() {
    let x = 0, y = 0;
    if (input.keys.has('arrowleft') || input.keys.has('a')) x -= 1;
    if (input.keys.has('arrowright') || input.keys.has('d')) x += 1;
    if (input.keys.has('arrowup') || input.keys.has('w')) y -= 1;
    if (input.keys.has('arrowdown') || input.keys.has('s')) y += 1;
    if (input.stick) { x = input.stick.x; y = input.stick.y; }
    return { x, y };
  }
  function isFiring() { return input.fire || input.keys.has(' ') || input.keys.has('enter'); }

  function reset() {
    saveBest();
    game.screen = 'play'; game.wave = 1; game.score = 0; game.kills = 0; game.style = 0; game.health = 3;
    game.t = 0; game.distance = 0; game.waveBanner = 2.8; game.waveClear = 0; game.message = ''; game.messageTime = 0;
    game.fireTimer = 0; game.flareCooldown = 0; game.flareGlow = 0; game.target = null; game.seed = 0xace2026; game.rng = null;
    game.player.x = view.w * .32; game.player.y = view.h * .52; game.player.bank = 0; game.player.loop = 0; game.player.hit = 0; game.player.invuln = 0;
    game.wingman.x = game.player.x - 68; game.wingman.y = game.player.y + 72; game.wingman.order = 0; game.wingman.shot = .5; game.wingman.call = 0;
    game.enemies.length = 0; game.bullets.length = 0; game.foeBullets.length = 0; game.missiles.length = 0; game.particles.length = 0; game.rings.length = 0;
    spawnWave();
  }

  function spawnWave() {
    const count = Math.min(6, 2 + Math.floor((game.wave - 1) * .58));
    game.waveBanner = 2.5; game.waveClear = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      const roll = rand(), type = game.wave >= 6 && roll > .55 ? 'ace' : (roll > .47 ? 'boomer' : 'turner');
      const color = colors[(game.wave + i + Math.floor(rand() * colors.length)) % colors.length];
      game.enemies.push({ id: game.nextId++, type, x: view.w + 60 + i * 92 + rand() * 90, y: 78 + rand() * Math.max(100, view.h - 190), vx: -72 - rand() * 38, vy: 0, hp: type === 'ace' ? 2 : 1, maxHp: type === 'ace' ? 2 : 1, phase: rand() * TAU, age: 0, shot: 1.5 + rand() * 2, missile: 4 + rand() * 3, angle: Math.PI, color, color2: colors[(i + 2) % colors.length], hit: 0, dead: false, boomered: false });
    }
    announce(`SORTIE ${game.wave}  •  ${count} BANDITS`, 1.8);
  }
  function nearestEnemy() {
    let chosen = null, best = Infinity;
    for (const e of game.enemies) if (!e.dead) {
      const d = dist(e.x, e.y, game.player.x, game.player.y);
      if (d < best) { best = d; chosen = e; }
    }
    return chosen;
  }
  function orderWingman() {
    const target = nearestEnemy();
    if (!target) return;
    game.target = target; game.wingman.order = 2.5; announce('WINGMAN: ATTACK RUN', 1.4);
  }
  function addParticle(x, y, color, amount = 1, speed = 90) {
    for (let i = 0; i < amount; i++) {
      const a = rand() * TAU, s = speed * (.35 + rand());
      game.particles.push({ x, y, vx: Math.cos(a) * s, vy: Math.sin(a) * s, life: .35 + rand() * .55, max: .9, size: 1.5 + rand() * 3.5, color });
    }
  }
  function addRing(x, y, color) { game.rings.push({ x, y, r: 8, life: .5, color }); }
  function shootPlayer() {
    if (game.fireTimer > 0) return;
    const s = steer(), t = game.target && !game.target.dead ? game.target : nearestEnemy();
    const aimY = t ? leadPoint(t).y : game.player.y + s.y * 80;
    const angle = Math.atan2(aimY - game.player.y, view.w * .48 + s.x * 70);
    const speed = 560;
    game.bullets.push({ x: game.player.x + 25, y: game.player.y - 2, vx: Math.cos(angle) * speed, vy: Math.sin(angle) * speed, life: 1.8, color: '#e7fbff' });
    game.fireTimer = .12;
    addParticle(game.player.x + 22, game.player.y, '#fff3b0', 1, 40);
  }
  function shootWingman(target) {
    if (!target) return;
    const angle = Math.atan2(target.y - game.wingman.y, target.x - game.wingman.x);
    game.bullets.push({ x: game.wingman.x + 20, y: game.wingman.y, vx: Math.cos(angle) * 430, vy: Math.sin(angle) * 430, life: 1.6, color: '#7fe9ff', wing: true });
  }
  function enemyShoot(e) {
    const dx = game.player.x - e.x;
    const speed = e.type === 'ace' ? 260 : 215;
    const lead = clamp(Math.abs(dx) / speed, .15, 1.2);
    const angle = Math.atan2(game.player.y + steer().y * 20 + e.vy * lead - e.y, dx);
    game.foeBullets.push({ x: e.x - 18, y: e.y, vx: Math.cos(angle) * speed, vy: Math.sin(angle) * speed, life: 3, color: e.color });
  }
  function launchMissile(e) {
    game.missiles.push({ x: e.x - 22, y: e.y, vx: -150, vy: 0, age: 0, life: 8, turn: 0, color: '#ff5c81' });
    announce('MISSILE LOCK  •  FLARE', 1.25); game.wingman.call = 1.7; announce('BANDIT ON YOU', 1.7);
  }
  function triggerFlare() {
    if (game.flareCooldown > 0) return;
    game.flareCooldown = 5; game.flareGlow = 1.15; game.shake = Math.max(game.shake, 4);
    for (let i = 0; i < 18; i++) addParticle(game.player.x - 14, game.player.y + 10, i % 2 ? '#ffbd5b' : '#fff2b0', 1, 150);
    for (const m of game.missiles) if (dist(m.x, m.y, game.player.x, game.player.y) < 190) { m.life = 0; game.score += 18; game.style += 1; addRing(m.x, m.y, '#ffc857'); }
    announce('FLARE OUT', 1.1);
  }
  function damagePlayer(amount = 1) {
    if (game.player.invuln > 0 || game.screen !== 'play') return;
    game.health -= amount; game.player.invuln = 1.1; game.player.hit = .28; game.shake = 12;
    addParticle(game.player.x, game.player.y, '#ff6b5f', 14, 180); addRing(game.player.x, game.player.y, '#ff6b5f');
    game.wingman.call = 1.5; announce('BANDIT ON YOU', 1.5);
    if (game.health <= 0) endGame(false);
  }
  function hitEnemy(e, bullet) {
    if (e.dead) return;
    e.hp--; e.hit = .18; addParticle(e.x, e.y, bullet.color, 5, 120); addRing(e.x, e.y, bullet.color);
    const shotAngle = Math.atan2(bullet.vy, bullet.vx);
    const deflection = Math.abs(angleDiff(shotAngle, e.angle)) > 1.25;
    if (deflection) { game.style += 1; game.score += 12; announce('DEFLECTION +12', .8); }
    if (e.hp <= 0) {
      e.dead = true; game.kills++; game.score += e.type === 'ace' ? 90 : e.type === 'boomer' ? 55 : 40;
      if (e.type === 'ace') { game.score += 20; announce('ACE BROKEN +110', 1.2); } else announce('BANDIT DOWN', .8);
      addParticle(e.x, e.y, e.color, 24, 220); addRing(e.x, e.y, '#fff3b0'); game.shake = Math.max(game.shake, 7);
    }
  }
  function leadPoint(e) {
    const speed = 560, d = Math.max(40, e.x - game.player.x), lead = clamp(d / speed, .1, 1.4);
    return { x: e.x + e.vx * lead, y: e.y + e.vy * lead };
  }
  function updatePlayer(dt) {
    const s = steer();
    game.player.x = lerp(game.player.x, view.w * .32 + s.x * 36, 1 - Math.pow(.001, dt));
    game.player.y = clamp(game.player.y + s.y * 220 * dt, 70, view.h - 116);
    game.player.bank = lerp(game.player.bank, s.x * .55, 1 - Math.pow(.002, dt));
    game.player.loop += Math.abs(s.y) * dt * 3.4;
    game.player.hit = Math.max(0, game.player.hit - dt); game.player.invuln = Math.max(0, game.player.invuln - dt);
    game.fireTimer = Math.max(0, game.fireTimer - dt); game.flareCooldown = Math.max(0, game.flareCooldown - dt); game.flareGlow = Math.max(0, game.flareGlow - dt);
    if (input.flareRequest) { input.flareRequest = false; triggerFlare(); }
    if (isFiring()) shootPlayer();
  }
  function updateWingman(dt) {
    const target = game.wingman.order > 0 && game.target && !game.target.dead ? game.target : null;
    game.wingman.order = Math.max(0, game.wingman.order - dt); game.wingman.call = Math.max(0, game.wingman.call - dt);
    const desiredX = target ? target.x - 100 : game.player.x - 74;
    const desiredY = target ? target.y + Math.sin(game.t * 5) * 20 : game.player.y + 72;
    game.wingman.x = lerp(game.wingman.x, desiredX, 1 - Math.pow(.0008, dt)); game.wingman.y = lerp(game.wingman.y, clamp(desiredY, 70, view.h - 120), 1 - Math.pow(.001, dt));
    game.wingman.shot -= dt;
    if (target && game.wingman.shot <= 0) { shootWingman(target); game.wingman.shot = .72; }
  }
  function updateEnemies(dt) {
    game.target = nearestEnemy();
    for (const e of game.enemies) {
      if (e.dead) continue;
      e.age += dt; e.hit = Math.max(0, e.hit - dt);
      if (e.type === 'turner') {
        const desired = game.player.y + Math.sin(e.age * 1.9 + e.phase) * 85;
        e.vy = lerp(e.vy, clamp((desired - e.y) * 1.3, -135, 135), 1 - Math.pow(.03, dt));
      } else if (e.type === 'boomer') {
        if (!e.boomered && e.x < view.w * .62) { e.boomered = true; e.vx = Math.abs(e.vx) + 120; announce('BOOMER BREAK', .8); }
        e.vy = Math.sin(e.age * 2 + e.phase) * 60;
      } else {
        e.vy = lerp(e.vy, (game.player.y - e.y) * .55, 1 - Math.pow(.08, dt));
      }
      e.x += e.vx * dt; e.y = clamp(e.y + e.vy * dt, 60, view.h - 118); e.angle = Math.atan2(e.vy, e.vx);
      e.shot -= dt;
      if (e.shot <= 0 && e.x < view.w + 80 && e.x > 40) { enemyShoot(e); e.shot = e.type === 'ace' ? 1.8 : 2.5 + rand() * 1.5; }
      if (e.type === 'ace') { e.missile -= dt; if (e.missile <= 0 && e.x < view.w + 40 && e.x > view.w * .3) { launchMissile(e); e.missile = 5.5 + rand() * 3; } }
      if (e.x < -110 || e.x > view.w + 180) { e.x = view.w + 110; e.y = 70 + rand() * Math.max(80, view.h - 180); if (e.type === 'boomer') e.boomered = false; }
    }
    const alive = game.enemies.some(e => !e.dead);
    if (!alive) {
      game.waveClear += dt;
      if (game.waveClear > 1.25) { if (game.wave >= 8) endGame(true); else { game.wave++; game.enemies.length = 0; spawnWave(); } }
    }
  }
  function updateCombat(dt) {
    for (const b of game.bullets) { b.x += b.vx * dt; b.y += b.vy * dt; b.life -= dt; for (const e of game.enemies) if (!e.dead && dist(b.x, b.y, e.x, e.y) < 23) { hitEnemy(e, b); b.life = 0; break; } }
    for (const b of game.foeBullets) { b.x += b.vx * dt; b.y += b.vy * dt; b.life -= dt; if (dist(b.x, b.y, game.player.x, game.player.y) < 18) { b.life = 0; damagePlayer(); } }
    for (const m of game.missiles) {
      m.age += dt; m.life -= dt;
      const desired = Math.atan2(game.player.y - m.y, game.player.x - m.x), current = Math.atan2(m.vy, m.vx), a = current + clamp(angleDiff(desired, current), -.95 * dt, .95 * dt);
      const speed = 170 + Math.min(100, m.age * 14); m.vx = Math.cos(a) * speed; m.vy = Math.sin(a) * speed; m.x += m.vx * dt; m.y += m.vy * dt;
      if (dist(m.x, m.y, game.player.x, game.player.y) < 25) { m.life = 0; damagePlayer(2); }
      if (rand() < dt * 12) addParticle(m.x, m.y, m.color, 1, 22);
    }
    game.bullets = game.bullets.filter(b => b.life > 0 && b.x > -80 && b.x < view.w + 80 && b.y > -80 && b.y < view.h + 80);
    game.foeBullets = game.foeBullets.filter(b => b.life > 0 && b.x > -100 && b.x < view.w + 100 && b.y > -100 && b.y < view.h + 100);
    game.missiles = game.missiles.filter(m => m.life > 0 && m.x > -120 && m.x < view.w + 120 && m.y > -120 && m.y < view.h + 120);
  }
  function updateFx(dt) {
    game.distance += dt * 180; game.shake = Math.max(0, game.shake - dt * 22); game.waveBanner = Math.max(0, game.waveBanner - dt); game.messageTime = Math.max(0, game.messageTime - dt);
    for (const p of game.particles) { p.x += p.vx * dt; p.y += p.vy * dt; p.vx *= Math.pow(.02, dt); p.vy *= Math.pow(.02, dt); p.life -= dt; }
    for (const r of game.rings) { r.r += dt * 90; r.life -= dt; }
    game.particles = game.particles.filter(p => p.life > 0); game.rings = game.rings.filter(r => r.life > 0);
  }
  function endGame(win) { game.screen = win ? 'win' : 'fail'; saveBest(); game.shake = win ? 5 : 14; addParticle(game.player.x, game.player.y, win ? '#85f29a' : '#ff6b5f', 30, 240); }
  function update(dt) {
    if (game.screen !== 'play') { updateFx(dt); return; }
    game.t += dt; updatePlayer(dt); updateWingman(dt); updateEnemies(dt); updateCombat(dt); updateFx(dt);
  }

  function drawSky() {
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, view.h); g.addColorStop(0, '#08142f'); g.addColorStop(.52, '#174c78'); g.addColorStop(1, '#f09373'); ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, view.w, view.h);
    ctx.globalAlpha = .12; ctx.fillStyle = '#ffe7ad'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(view.w * .77, view.h * .22, Math.min(view.w, view.h) * .16, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
    drawParallax(0.22, '#b9eaff', 24, 1); drawParallax(0.48, '#73b8d0', 34, 1); drawParallax(0.9, '#164166', 45, 2); ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(175,230,255,.13)'; ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) { const y = view.h * .35 + i * 34; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, y); ctx.lineTo(view.w, y - 65); ctx.stroke(); }
  }
  function drawParallax(speed, color, y, size) {
    const off = -(game.distance * speed) % (view.w + 140); ctx.fillStyle = color;
    for (let x = off - 140; x < view.w + 160; x += 160 + size * 28) {
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x, y + size * 20); ctx.lineTo(x + 34, y - size * 12); ctx.lineTo(x + 72, y + size * 14); ctx.lineTo(x + 126, y - size * 20); ctx.lineTo(x + 160, y + size * 22); ctx.lineTo(x + 160, y + size * 34); ctx.lineTo(x, y + size * 34); ctx.fill();
    }
  }
  function drawPlane(x, y, scale, rot, main, accent, player = false) {
    ctx.save(); ctx.translate(x, y); ctx.rotate(rot); ctx.scale(scale, scale);
    ctx.globalAlpha = .25; ctx.fillStyle = '#061020'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(-3, 16, 28, 7, 0, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = main; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(30, 0); ctx.lineTo(7, -7); ctx.lineTo(-20, -5); ctx.lineTo(-30, -17); ctx.lineTo(-26, -3); ctx.lineTo(-43, -9); ctx.lineTo(-26, 3); ctx.lineTo(-30, 17); ctx.lineTo(-18, 6); ctx.lineTo(8, 7); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = accent; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(4, -3); ctx.lineTo(-18, -28); ctx.lineTo(-7, -4); ctx.lineTo(-18, 28); ctx.lineTo(5, 3); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = player ? '#e8fcff' : '#fff1c1'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(7, -2, 8, 4, -.2, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#071126'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(9, -3, 5, 2.4, -.2, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
    if (player) { ctx.fillStyle = '#fff3a5'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(30, 0); ctx.lineTo(39, -3); ctx.lineTo(39, 3); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill(); }
    ctx.restore();
  }
  function drawEnemy(e) {
    if (e.dead) return; const s = .78 + (e.x % 90) / 500; drawPlane(e.x, e.y, s, e.angle + Math.PI, e.hit > 0 ? '#ffffff' : e.color, e.color2);
    if (e.type === 'ace') { ctx.strokeStyle = '#ff6683'; ctx.globalAlpha = .8; ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(e.x, e.y, 25, 0, TAU); ctx.stroke(); ctx.globalAlpha = 1; }
    if (e.hp < e.maxHp) { ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(3,8,20,.65)'; ctx.fillRect(e.x - 18, e.y - 34, 36, 3); ctx.fillStyle = '#ff7085'; ctx.fillRect(e.x - 18, e.y - 34, 18 * e.hp, 3); }
  }
  function drawBullets() {
    for (const b of game.bullets) { ctx.strokeStyle = b.color; ctx.lineWidth = b.wing ? 2 : 2.5; ctx.globalAlpha = .85; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(b.x, b.y); ctx.lineTo(b.x - b.vx * .045, b.y - b.vy * .045); ctx.stroke(); }
    for (const b of game.foeBullets) { ctx.fillStyle = b.color; ctx.globalAlpha = .9; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, 3, 0, TAU); ctx.fill(); }
    for (const m of game.missiles) { ctx.save(); ctx.translate(m.x, m.y); ctx.rotate(Math.atan2(m.vy, m.vx)); ctx.fillStyle = '#ff5c81'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(12, 0); ctx.lineTo(-9, -4); ctx.lineTo(-7, 4); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill(); ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd36b'; ctx.fillRect(-12, -2, 6, 4); ctx.restore(); }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }
  function drawEffects() {
    for (const r of game.rings) { ctx.globalAlpha = clamp(r.life * 2, 0, 1); ctx.strokeStyle = r.color; ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(r.x, r.y, r.r, 0, TAU); ctx.stroke(); }
    for (const p of game.particles) { ctx.globalAlpha = clamp(p.life / p.max, 0, 1); ctx.fillStyle = p.color; ctx.fillRect(p.x - p.size / 2, p.y - p.size / 2, p.size, p.size); }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }
  function drawLead() {

  function drawOverlay() {
    if (game.screen === 'play') return;
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(3, 9, 24, .72)'; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, view.w, view.h); ctx.textAlign = 'center'; ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillStyle = game.screen === 'win' ? '#b9ffcf' : '#ffb8aa'; ctx.font = '900 42px system-ui'; ctx.fillText(game.screen === 'win' ? 'SKY CLEARED' : 'SORTIE LOST', view.w * .5, view.h * .39);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#effaff'; ctx.font = '800 17px system-ui'; ctx.fillText(`SCORE ${game.score}   •   BEST ${Math.max(game.best, game.score)}`, view.w * .5, view.h * .51);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffdda2'; ctx.font = '800 14px system-ui'; ctx.fillText('TAP OR PRESS ENTER TO FLY AGAIN', view.w * .5, view.h * .62);
  }
  function render() {
    ctx.setTransform(view.dpr, 0, 0, view.dpr, 0, 0); ctx.clearRect(0, 0, view.w, view.h); drawSky();
    const sx = game.shake ? (rand() - .5) * game.shake : 0, sy = game.shake ? (rand() - .5) * game.shake : 0; ctx.save(); ctx.translate(sx, sy);
    for (const e of game.enemies) drawEnemy(e); drawLead(); drawBullets(); drawPlane(game.wingman.x, game.wingman.y, .8, Math.sin(game.t * 2) * .08, '#5fd5e8', '#ffe48a');

    drawEffects(); ctx.restore(); drawHud(); drawControls(); drawOverlay();
    if (game.flareGlow > 0) { ctx.globalAlpha = game.flareGlow * .12; ctx.fillStyle = '#fff0a1'; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, view.w, view.h); ctx.globalAlpha = 1; }
  }

  let last = performance.now();
  function frame(now) { const dt = Math.min(.033, Math.max(0, (now - last) / 1000)); last = now; update(dt); render(); requestAnimationFrame(frame); }
  reset(); requestAnimationFrame(frame);
})();

    82	  // Runs zero or more fixed 1/60s sim steps for the elapsed real time,
    83	  // then draws once. See module header for the accumulator contract.
    84	  _loop(ts) {
    85	    if (this._lastTs === null) this._lastTs = ts;
    86	    let dtMs = ts - this._lastTs;
    87	    this._lastTs = ts;
    88	    if (dtMs > FRAME_CLAMP_MS) dtMs = FRAME_CLAMP_MS; // clamp a big stall
    89	    if (dtMs < 0) dtMs = 0; // guard against a non-monotonic ts source
    90	
    91	    this._accumulatorMs += dtMs;
    92	
    93	    let steps = 0;
    94	    while (this._accumulatorMs >= STEP_MS && steps < MAX_STEPS_PER_FRAME) {
    95	      this._update();
    96	      this._traceStep();
    97	      // Input edges (pressed()) are consumed by the FIRST sim step that
    98	      // runs after the frame's input was latched. Snapshotting `prev`
    99	      // here, after that first step, means any further sim steps this
   100	      // same frame see those edges as already consumed (pressed() is
   101	      // false), while held state (left/right/up/down/A/B — read straight
   102	      // off `keys`) is unaffected and persists across all of them.
   103	      if (steps === 0) {
   104	        this.input.prev = { ...this.input.keys };
   105	        this.input.consumePressed();
   106	      }
   107	      this._accumulatorMs -= STEP_MS;
   108	      steps++;
   109	    }
   110	    // Remainder time (including any left over after hitting the 5-step
   111	    // cap during a catch-up spiral) intentionally carries into next frame
   112	    // rather than being discarded — no time is invented or dropped.
   113	
   114	    this._draw();
   115	    this.frame++;
   116	    requestAnimationFrame(this._loop);
   117	  }

    74	      };

    76	        e.preventDefault();

    86	      element.addEventListener('lostpointercapture', up, { passive: false });

    95	    const stickMove = (e) => {
    96	      if (this._stickPointer !== e.pointerId) return;
    97	      e.preventDefault();
    98	      const rect = stick.getBoundingClientRect();
    99	      const cx = rect.left + rect.width / 2;
   100	      const cy = rect.top + rect.height / 2;
   101	      const max = rect.width * 0.34;
   102	      const dx = e.clientX - cx;
   103	      const dy = e.clientY - cy;
   104	      const distance = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
   105	      const scale = Math.min(1, max / distance);
   106	      const knobX = dx * scale;
   107	      const knobY = dy * scale;
   108	      if (knob) knob.style.transform = `translate(calc(-50% + ${knobX}px), calc(-50% + ${knobY}px))`;
   109	      const dead = Math.max(8, rect.width * 0.12);
   110	      this.keys.TouchLeft = dx < -dead;
   111	      this.keys.TouchRight = dx > dead;
   112	      this.keys.TouchUp = dy < -dead;
   113	      this.keys.TouchDown = dy > dead;
   114	    };
   115	    const stickDown = (e) => {
   116	      e.preventDefault();
   117	      if (this._stickPointer !== null) return;
   118	      this._stickPointer = e.pointerId;
   119	      if (stick.setPointerCapture) stick.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
   120	      stickMove(e);
   121	    };
   122	    const stickUp = (e) => {
   123	      if (this._stickPointer !== e.pointerId) return;
   124	      e.preventDefault();
   125	      this._stickPointer = null;
   126	      this.keys.TouchLeft = false;
   127	      this.keys.TouchRight = false;
   128	      this.keys.TouchUp = false;
   129	      this.keys.TouchDown = false;
   130	      if (knob) knob.style.transform = 'translate(-50%, -50%)';
   131	    };
   132

   134	    stick.addEventListener('pointermove', stickMove, { passive: false });
   135	    stick.addEventListener('pointerup', stickUp, { passive: false });
   136	    stick.addEventListener('pointercancel', stickUp, { passive: false });

    56	  function terrain(s) {
    57	    var r = mulberry(s.seed), i, x, y;
    58	    // low-frequency value noise via random control points
    59	    var cw = 6, ch = 8, cp = [];
    60	    for (i = 0; i < cw * ch; i++) cp.push(r());
    61	    function samp(fx, fy) {
    62	      var gx = fx * (cw - 1), gy = fy * (ch - 1);
    63	      var x0 = Math.floor(gx), y0 = Math.floor(gy);
    64	      var x1 = Math.min(cw - 1, x0 + 1), y1 = Math.min(ch - 1, y0 + 1);
    65	      var tx = gx - x0, ty = gy - y0;
    66	      tx = tx * tx * (3 - 2 * tx); ty = ty * ty * (3 - 2 * ty);
    67	      var a = cp[y0 * cw + x0], b = cp[y0 * cw + x1], c = cp[y1 * cw + x0], d = cp[y1 * cw + x1];
    68	      return (a + (b - a) * tx) * (1 - ty) + (c + (d - c) * tx) * ty;
    69	    }

    71	    for (pass = 0; pass < 14; pass++) {

    73	      for (y = 0; y < H; y++) for (x = 0; x < W; x++) {
    74	        var v = samp(x / (W - 1), y / (H - 1));
    75	        var k = y * W + x;

    77	        if (s.t[k] === T.GRASS) open++;
